If you’re passionate about building smart, scalable, game changing solutions, this is your moment. We’re searching for Microsoft Dynamics Engineers to join our innovative and ambitious Customer Engagement Platform team at our Head Office in Skipton — officially named the happiest place to live in Great Britain for 2025/2026 by Rightmove’s annual Happy at Home survey. There’s no better place to grow your career and make an impact.

Who Are We?

Not just another building society. Not just another job.

We're the fourth biggest building society in the UK and what makes us a bit different is that we're a mutual organisation. We don't have shareholders; we're owned by our members.

Our colleagues say Skipton's a great place to work, and you could be one of them, bringing with you new ideas on how we can keep customers at the heart of what we do.

Whatever your background, and whatever your goals, we'll help you take the next step towards a better future.

Why This Role Matters

As a Dynamics Engineer, you’ll be at the heart of our digital evolution. You’ll develop, innovate, and maintain Dynamics solutions that streamline processes, empower colleagues, and enhance the experience of our members. You’ll collaborate with stakeholders across the business, turning ideas into powerful, automated products that make a real difference.

What’s In It For You?

Skipton values work/life balance and we are proud to support hybrid and flexible working, where possible. We have a newly refurbished head office which offers a vibrant and collaborative working space.

We have a range of other benefits available to you including

Annual discretionary bonus scheme

25 days standard annual leave + bank holidays + rising 1 day per year of service to a maximum of 30 days

Holiday trading scheme allowing the ability to buy and sell additional annual leave days

Matching employer pension contribution (up to 10% per annum)

Colleague mortgage (conditions apply)

Salary sacrifice scheme for hybrid & electric car

A commitment to training and development

Private medical insurance for all our colleagues

3 paid volunteering days per annum

Diverse and inclusive colleague networks available for you to join including our Carers and Pride Alliance groups

We care about your health and wellbeing – we provide a range of benefits that support this including cycle to work initiative and discounted gym membership

What Will You Be Doing?

You will lead end-to-end technical delivery of solutions for our Customer Engagement Platform built on Microsoft Dynamics 365. Ensure solutions are designed and engineered using appropriate methods and tools, aligned to organisational strategy, security, and standards. Drive adoption of best practices in solution architecture and ALM to meet business goals, deliver value to stakeholders, and manage technical risk. Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers, fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture.

What Do We Need From You?

Lead and take ownership across all stages and iterations of Dynamics delivery.
Plan, drive, and evaluate Dataverse solution construction (tables, relationships, forms, views, model-driven apps) aligning with engineering and security standards
Design and implement server-side extensions (C# plug-ins, custom workflow activities) and client-side behaviours (TypeScript/JavaScript, form/context APIs)
Define and execute robust integration patterns using Azure Functions, Service Bus, Webhooks, virtual tables and API Management; ensure observability with Application Insights
Automate business processes with Power Automate (cloud flows) with error handling
Establish ALM practices: solution layering, environment strategies, CI/CD using Power Platform Build Tools and Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions.
Assure security-by-design (environment roles, security roles, field security, DLP policies) and compliance (auditing, GDPR)
Set quality standards via reviews, Solution Checker, static analysis and test automation
Optimise performance and scalability (plugin pipeline optimisation, batching, concurrency controls, index strategy)
Provide production support leadership, troubleshooting complex incidents and driving root-cause remediation via controlled releases.
Evaluate emerging platform capabilities and their organisational impact. Champion continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for someone who blends technical expertise with curiosity, creativity, and a passion for improvement.

Ideally, You’ll Have

Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant Associate (PL-200)
Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Service Functional Consultant Associate (MB-230)
Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)

If you’re excited by the potential of automation and want to help shape the future of how we work, we’d love to hear from you.

Ready to Make an Impact?

Jo in us and help build the next generation of digital solutions at Skipton, the happiest place to live in Great Britain. This is your chance to innovate, collaborate, and create technology that truly matters.

jobs.description:
Engineering Manager — Own the Backend Behind the Data That Runs Modern Football

Every top-flight football club analyses the game differently now than it did five years ago and that shift runs through data infrastructure most fans will never see.

This is a chance to become the Engineering Manager and lead the team who are building it...

We are looking for a Engineering Manager to run two squads (~8 engineers) building the platform and API layer behind a market-leading football analytics product. This is the kind of tool used inside the walls of Premier League, La Liga, and Serie A clubs to make real tactical and recruitment decisions. Liverpool. Manchester City. Clubs competing at the very top of the European game, working off data your team ships.

The are looking for a former senior/staff engineer with deep hands-on technical depth who transitioned into engineering management, retaining the credibility to challenge system design decisions while now focusing on leading and growing the team.

Why this role is genuinely rare:

Most EM roles ask you to choose between staying technical and going all-in on people leadership. This one refuses that trade-off. You'll be deep enough in architecture and system design to challenge senior engineers and shape how the platform evolves.

At the same time, you're building and growing a high-performing team, not writing code day to day.

It also sits at a genuine intersection point that's hard to find elsewhere: a product with real end users and real commercial stakes (not internal tooling), an API-first data platform doing interesting engineering problems at scale, and a business that is actively investing in AI-augmented engineering as a working practice, not a slide in a strategy deck.

What you need:

Solid background in software engineering with backend depth - (C#/.NET or equivalent), TypeScript, and AWS or Azure)
3+ years managing engineering teams
A track record as a strong individual contributor or tech lead before moving into management
Experience designing APIs and platforms that other teams build on top of
A background shipping customer-facing product, not just internal infrastructure
Genuine, active use of AI tooling in your day-to-day workflow (this is a forward-leaning, AI-first engineering culture)

What makes it different

You won't be managing from a distance. You'll be trusted to get into the technical weeds, influence architecture decisions, and lead a team solving problems for one of the most demanding, highest-scrutiny data products in sport where the people using your platform are analysing matches at the elite end of the game.

London-based & hybrid

UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. We use frontier LLMs to turn all of that into structured data that automations and AI agents can act on. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance.

It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is "not well enough", is a large part of the job.

You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. We're looking for someone who loves building things, learns fast, and wants to own product outcomes rather than tickets.

What You'll Do At UiPath

Work with engineers, product managers and customers to design, build and operate the AI systems behind UiPath's document processing products.
Build across the pipeline: ingestion, parsing and extraction, indexing and retrieval, and the evaluation that tells us any of it is working.
Take features from idea to production and stay with them, measuring whether they actually worked, and improving them when they didn't.
Solve genuinely hard problems in concurrency, latency and distributed systems, so the platform holds up under high-volume production workloads.
Build for environments we don't control: multi-cloud, on-premises, air-gapped, and under strict security and compliance requirements.
Use coding agents as a serious part of your toolkit, and help the team get better at it. Where to trust them, where not to, and how to keep quality high as the tooling changes underneath us.
Work with teams across UiPath and across locations to innovate and build best-in-class document processing, and occasionally with customers directly. Because the fastest way to understand a product is to watch someone use it.
Contribute to our engineering culture: mentor, review, hire, and push back when something isn't good enough.

What You'll Bring To The Team

A solid track record (5+ years) building and operating large-scale commercial services that real customers depend on.
Strong programming ability and the confidence to pick up whatever language a problem calls for. You'll meet Python, Rust and C# here, but we don't expect you to arrive knowing them all.
Real-world experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and containerised deployment on Kubernetes. You understand how production systems get shipped, monitored and scaled, not just written.
Comfort with data at scale: SQL, and the trade-offs between different storage and search systems.
Experience working with coding agents, and opinions about them, What responsible use looks like, where they earn their keep and where they cost you, and how you keep evaluating them in an ecosystem that changes every few months.
An appreciation for tools that catch bugs before runtime — type systems, tests, and designs that make bad states unrepresentable. Especially in the age of coding agents.
A pragmatic grasp of computer science fundamentals. We care about solving real problems with the right data structure, not reciting one from a textbook.
Experience shipping LLM-backed products to production is a strong plus: prompting, evaluation, and everything else that turns a model into a feature people will trust.
Familiarity with document processing is a plus: OCR, layout, and the messy reality of documents as they actually arrive.
An opinion on what makes good code and good architecture, and the ability to argue it, including against us.
You're a builder and a problem-solver at heart.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Profile

Thermoteknix Systems Ltd, founded in 1982 and based in Cambridge, is a world leader in thermal imaging, night vision, and augmented reality systems. Our award-winning technologies are trusted by defence, security, and industrial customers in over 70 countries. With in-house R&D, cutting-edge innovation, and a global reputation for quality, we design and manufacture solutions that perform in the toughest environments.

Due to increasing market opportunities and an ever-growing product range, Thermoteknix is expanding its engineering capacity by expanding the New Product Introduction (NPI) team within R&D.

We are looking for an exceptionally motivated graduate software engineer who is passionate about software and enjoys solving difficult engineering problems. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to apply strong software engineering skills to real products, working at the intersection of software, electronics, firmware, automation, and manufacturing.

About You

As a member of the NPI team, you will be responsible for developing and supporting the software-driven automation and test systems used to transition products from development into scalable, repeatable manufacturing.

You will work closely with R&D, manufacturing, and quality teams, applying strong software engineering principles to implement comprehensive automated testing and validation processes.

Additionally, you will contribute to the enhancement of existing software to improve production test speed, reliability, and capability, ensuring that products are thoroughly tested and validated before reaching customers.

This is an opportunity for a graduate who wants to become an outstanding software engineer while working on real-world products and complex hardware/software systems.

Key Responsibilities

Support software and test design processes, ensuring DFT principles are applied throughout the product development lifecycle.
Support software and test workstreams within NPI projects, ensuring readiness for build and scale, and supporting the transition of products through to customer delivery.
Define and implement robust processes for firmware programming, product configuration, calibration data handling, and version control in production builds.
Define, develop, and document automated test processes during product development for new products and assemblies.
Work with mechanical and electronics engineers within the NPI team to design automated electromechanical test systems that optimise production throughput and ensure product quality.
Drive improvements in manufacturing readiness by identifying and implementing opportunities to streamline production test and build times.
Provide hands-on support during NPI builds, troubleshooting software, automation, and hardware-integrated system issues within the ECN framework.
Work with the quality department to support non-conformance investigations and product quality improvements during NPI phases.
Contribute to the development of the new NPI team's standards and processes.
Continuously look for opportunities to improve software quality, automation, test coverage, reliability, and development processes.

Required Skills & Experience

Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and solve complex technical problems.
Strong experience developing software in C#, with knowledge of WPF and MVVM methodologies.
Experience developing software tools, applications, or automation projects, ideally involving interaction with hardware or real-world systems, through academic, personal, or professional projects.
Understanding of software development practices including source control, testing, debugging, release processes, and configuration control.
Ability to troubleshoot software issues and communicate effectively with embedded hardware-integrated systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
Ability to create technical documentation and work within controlled software development and change management processes.
Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Commercial industry experience is not required. We are more interested in strong software engineering ability, technical curiosity, and the drive to learn than years of industry experience. Academic, personal, placement, and internship projects are all relevant.

Desirable Skills & Experience

Familiarity with embedded firmware programming tools.
Knowledge of manufacturing test systems, calibration workflows, and automation frameworks.
Knowledge of additional programming languages such as LabVIEW and C/C++.
Experience or academic/personal project exposure developing software that communicates with hardware, instruments, sensors, or embedded systems.
Understanding of engineering change control, ISO 9001 environments, and traceability requirements.
Exposure to thermal imaging products, or real-time embedded systems.
Exposure to the design or use of jigs, fixtures, tooling, or electronic test equipment through academic, personal, or project-based work.

Personal Attributes

Passionate about software and genuinely enjoys writing code.
Naturally curious and keen to understand how things work, from software through to electronics and hardware.
Hands-on, proactive, and solution-focused.
Enjoys tackling difficult technical problems and finding practical solutions.
Strong communication skills with engineering and production stakeholders.
Comfortable working across both software development and physical engineering environments.
Driven to improve processes and software quality and deliver manufacturing excellence.
Self-motivated and keen to learn from experienced engineers while contributing ideas of your own.

Who We Are Looking For

This role would suit a graduate who has gone beyond simply completing their degree and has demonstrated a genuine passion for software engineering.

Perhaps you have built software projects during university or in your own time, contributed to open-source projects, developed tools for yourself or others, competed in programming or engineering challenges, or simply spend your free time learning new technologies and understanding how things work.

You do not need to have years of manufacturing experience. What matters is that you have strong software fundamentals, intellectual curiosity, a high level of technical ability, and a desire to become an exceptional engineer.

If you love software, enjoy solving problems, and want to see your code interact with real products and hardware, we would like to hear from you.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

Why Us?

Opportunity to join and shape the developing NPI Team
A key software engineering role bridging cutting-edge R&D and real-world manufacturing
Develop software that directly interacts with advanced hardware and products.
Work alongside experienced software, electronics, mechanical, manufacturing and quality engineers.
Collaborative environment working on advanced thermal imaging technologies
Significant opportunity for learning, responsibility and career development.
Training and development opportunities
Career development and growth within a high-technology engineering organisation
Competitive salary and benefits package

Ofgem plays a vital role in the UK’s energy system, protecting consumers and enabling a more secure, fair and sustainable energy future, and a robust Architecture capability is central to this mission.

Within the Digital, Data and Security Services (DDSS) directorate, we are modernising our technology estate and expanding our use of Microsoft Azure as a core platform. This includes building secure, scalable and cost-effective solutions that support data, AI and digital services across the organisation.

As a Principal Technical Architect (Azure), you will play a key role in shaping how Azure is designed and used across Ofgem. You will define standards and governance, guide technical decision-making and support delivery teams to build high-quality cloud solutions. Working across programmes and domains, you will ensure architectural consistency, manage risk and embed architectural best practice across our Azure environment.

This is a highly influential technical role within a fast-paced and evolving environment, requiring deep Azure expertise and strong architectural capability.

Defining and shaping Azure architecture standards, aligned to organisational and government frameworks
Establishing and embedding architectural patterns, principles and governance
Providing oversight and assurance for complex cloud solutions
Supporting architectural decision-making and managing technical risk
Promoting reusable frameworks and best practice across teams
Collaborating with stakeholders to align technology and business needs
Evaluating emerging Azure capabilities and supporting their adoption
Mentoring architects and engineers, building capability across DDSS

A highly experienced technical architect who can shape and guide cloud architecture in a complex environment. You will bring strong Azure expertise alongside the ability to influence across teams.

Strong experience designing and delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure
Solid understanding of cloud architecture, governance and optimisation
Experience contributing to architectural standards and decision-making
Knowledge of security, identity and compliance in cloud environments
Ability to collaborate across teams and guide technical outcomes

Relevant certifications (e.g. Azure Solutions Architect Expert) is expected (or achievable).

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping Ofgem’s architecture capability and Azure cloud platform. You will help ensure systems are secure, scalable and fit for the future, supporting digital transformation and services that impact consumers across Great Britain.

Person specification

Essential Criteria

Extensive experience in design and delivery of complex solutions on Microsoft Azure (Lead Criteria).

Demonstrable proficiency in technical direction, team mentorship, and guidance across multi-disciplinary IT teams and architects (Lead Criteria).

Understanding Azure security frameworks, compliance standards, and identity management models.

Seeing the Big Picture
Making Effective Decisions
Leadership

Technical skills

Alongside your salary of £63,443, OFGEM contributes £18,379 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

This exciting blend of professional challenge and personal reward identifies career opportunities at Ofgem as something to get excited about.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Longshot Systems we build advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the team that owns and develops our trading platform. Longshot is a small, focused company and so the role suits someone who can architect and implement whatever is needed to meet our next product, performance or stability goal. The team owns the technical standards and coding guidelines, CI/CD, observability and security. This role suits someone who wants to ship features and contribute to the wider technical excellence in the team and platform.

The trading platform at Longshot handles integrations with many bookmakers and exchanges worldwide. It normalises and combines the global odds data for many sports and makes it available internally for strategies to trade on. We handle thousands of odds updates and trades per second and have very strict bounds on latency, correctness and overall quality of the feed and trading. You would be at the heart of this team: integrating more trading venues, optimising key parts of the platform, making trading safer and faster, etc. We also maintain a significant historical data repository and support wider trading and research efforts around the company.

Our key platform systems are all in Golang, with message buses and databases at the core of the architecture. You don't need to be fluent in Golang, but it would help. It's easy to learn and we have a team full of experts able to teach you.

We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and flexible the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals.

Interview Process

Intro call (30 mins) - your background + interests
1st Technical interview (30 mins) - live code review & pair programming
2nd Technical interview (60 mins) - deep dive technical questions
Full assessment day (10:30-5pm) - a one day systems programming exercise designed to be similar to the real work we do in the team. Meet some of the team, see the office, have a nice lunch (on us)

Requirements

Bachelors or Masters in a quantitative or technical subject (e.g. Maths, EE, Physics, Comp Sci) from a top university
2+ years experience building mission critical distributed systems (finance, gaming, telco, ad-tech, etc.) where throughput, correctness and availability are a hard requirement
Proven track record delivering and maintaining production systems in at least one systems language (Go, C++, Rust, Java, C#, etc.), with clear, idiomatic designs
Startup experience: shipping products in small, fast moving teams
Architecture & design: Able to reason about trade offs and produce clean, evolvable service boundaries
Cloud & DevOps: comfortable working in AWS, linux and wrangling build pipelines. We have dedicated DevOps people, but you do need to be competent in the core skills here
Fluent written and spoken English. Communicating with the team is as important as the technical work. You need to be able to effectively collaborate on everything from low level details to long term strategic planning

Trading, market making or exchange experience

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering
jobs.description:
The Role:

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 
The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system. 

What This Role Is Not: 

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title. 

What You Will Work On:

Technical Leadership 

Define and own the technical roadmap for autonomous constellation operations
Set the architectural direction for the data platform, reliability systems, and automation infrastructure
Stay hands-on: review code, prototype solutions, and get into the details when it matters
Establish engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing, and observability, and hold the team to them
Be the person engineers come to when the problem is genuinely hard

Team Building & Culture 

Recruit, develop, and retain a team of 6 to 10 world-class reliability and platform engineers
Set the pace, tone, and ambition for the team and make being on it feel like a privilege
Create an environment where engineers grow fast, own their work, and ship things they are proud of
Identify gaps and level up engineers through mentorship and not just management

Operational Transformation 

Lead the shift from manual, operator-driven processes to fully automated and self-healing operations
Define and drive toward SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets for the constellation
Partner with satellite operations and mission teams to translate pain into software solutions

Cross-Functional Influence 

Be the technical voice of the team in company-wide conversations about architecture, infrastructure, and platform strategy
Influence how Spire thinks about automation, data, and AI/ML across the broader engineering organization

Basic Qualifications: 

7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 in a technical leadership or staff-level individual contributor role
Demonstrated track record building and shipping reliable production systems at scale. You have owned things that could not go down.
Deep technical credibility. Engineers on your teams have respected your judgment and not just your title.
Experience with SRE principles, reliability engineering, or large-scale automation. You have reduced toil systematically and not just complained about it.
Strong foundation in Python, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
Experience hiring and developing engineers. You know what great looks like and how to find it.
The communication and influence skills to drive technical decisions across teams you do not directly control

Preferred Qualifications: 

Experience applying AI/ML or advanced analytics to operational or monitoring problems
Experience writing performance software in Rust
Background in space systems, aerospace, or highly constrained real-time environments
Experience building data lakes, telemetry platforms, or observability infrastructure at scale
A history of leading teams through technical transformations and not just maintaining the status quo

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.
Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying.

Global Perks

🛰️ Name Your Satellite Program (NYSP)
🚀 Launch Attendance
🌴 Generous Time Off Policy
🎓 Education Assistance Program
🥰 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
👣 Family Leave
💪 Fitness Reimbursement
🧡 Employee Referral Program
🍉 Healthy snacks & beverages in every office

About Spire

We   improve life on Earth with data from space.
Spire Global is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates the largest multi-purpose constellation of satellites. Its proprietary data and algorithms provide the most advanced maritime, aviation, and weather tracking in the world. In addition to its constellation, Spire’s data infrastructure includes a global ground station network and 24/7 operations that provide real-time global coverage of every point on Earth.

Spire is Global and our success draws upon the diverse viewpoints, skills and experiences of our employees. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.
To help maintain a safe and secure workplace for Spire employees, all candidates who receive a conditional offer will be required to complete a background check . This may include criminal history and employment verification.
Please take a moment to review Spire's Global Data Privacy Notice for Employees, Contractors, Candidates and Visitors, as well as  Spire's Privacy Policy.

Kindly be advised that communication regarding your application may come from @spire.com, @recruiting.spire.com, or from Candidate.fyi (our scheduling tool).

jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Build technology that solves real business problems
We are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
to work at the intersection of technology, data, AI and the business.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will work directly with our investment, operations and distribution teams, spending time with the people who use our technology to understand their workflows, identify meaningful problems and build solutions that make a measurable difference.

You will have the autonomy to take ideas from problem definition through to production, often moving from prototype to a working solution in days or weeks rather than months.

The role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.
Rapidly prototype solutions, test them with users and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Take successful prototypes through to production, building secure, reliable and maintainable services.
Work across the full technology stack, including backend services, APIs, data pipelines and user-facing applications.
Integrate data and systems across APIs, databases, files and message queues, turning complex and fragmented data into useful products and services.
Apply modern AI and LLM capabilities to accelerate delivery and create new ways of working.
Partner closely with engineering, data and platform teams to align with architecture, security and technology standards.
Maintain a strong focus on security, governance, data protection and operational resilience, particularly where solutions interact with client assets and regulated activity.

About you
You are a hands-on engineer and pragmatic problem solver who enjoys being close to the people you build for.
You are comfortable operating in environments where the problem is not always clearly defined. You can ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, make sensible trade-offs and move quickly from an idea to something users can actually work with.
You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, mapping a business process with a subject matter expert, or explaining a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
Most importantly, you care about building the right thing, not simply building things right.

Experience needed for the role:
4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and supporting production systems.
Experience taking projects end to end, from problem definition and design through development, deployment and ongoing improvement.
Experience working directly with users, clients or business stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong experience integrating APIs, databases, files and messaging systems, and working with complex or imperfect real-world data.
Experience in financial services, investment management, asset management or another regulated, data-intensive environment is highly desirable.
Experience using modern AI/LLM technologies, or a demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to adopt them quickly.

Technical skills
We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals rather than a specific technology background. Experience with one or more of the following is valuable:
Programming: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# or Go.
Full stack development: backend services, APIs and modern web applications.
Data: SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, data modelling, cloud storage and graph technologies, including GraphRAG.
Cloud and infrastructure: Azure, containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
Security: authentication, authorisation, data isolation, input validation and secure handling of sensitive information.
AI: LLMs, AI-assisted development, intelligent automation and emerging AI application patterns.

If you are an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working directly with users and turning ideas into production technology, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 2 (.NET/C#) - OneBox Backservices
jobs.description:
About the job:

Impact at Scale
: We are part of Allegro, developing high-performance IT systems for OneBox backend.
Massive Scale
: Design and build high-availability systems used by tens of thousands of users. This is high-performance engineering in practice.
Modern Tech Stack
: Work with a world-class environment using C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, REST, PostgreSQL, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, EntityFramework, and Redis.
True Ownership & Autonomy
: We live by a "you build it, you run it" philosophy. You'll join an autonomous team with full ownership of the services you create, from design to deployment.
Complex Challenges
: You will tackle complex backend problems, using technology to solve real-world business challenges.

Join the team building the backend powering our OneBox network! Imagine walking down the street, spotting a OneBox parcel locker, and knowing that your code helps drive it – that's the kind of impactful project you'll be working on. Our systems process millions of parcels, operating at high scale, high complexity, and deep integration close to the hardware.

In this role, you will work with physical machines, shape our backend architecture, and scale our infrastructure to support a continuously growing fleet of OneBoxes. We prioritize high reliability, modern engineering practices, and a supportive team culture, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex real-world challenges at scale.

Important things for you

Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):
PLN 14 600 - 20 825

Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
Our team is based in Warsaw.

We are looking for people who:

Have solid, fluent proficiency in C# and .NET Core / ASP.NET
for building reliable, maintainable backend systems;
Demonstrate solid proficiency in designing and maintaining REST APIs
and microservices;
Work confidently with relational databases like PostgreSQL
, including data modeling and basic database performance tuning;
Have hands-on experience with cloud-native tooling such as Docker and Kubernetes
;
Have experience working with asynchronous messaging systems like Azure Service Bus
or similar message brokers;
Understand caching concepts and usage of tools like Redis
to support system performance;
Have experience with large IoT device networks or similar systems (a plus), or are open, excited, and aware of working with such device ecosystems;
Enjoy sharing knowledge, and encouraging good engineering practices;
Are eager to grow toward end-to-end task ownership across the software development lifecycle with mentorship from senior engineers;
Are comfortable participating in architectural discussions and contributing to overall system design;
Are proficient in Polish and English (at least B2 level).

What's in it for you:

Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
A 16" or 14" Dell with Windows and all the necessary accessories.
A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.

#goodtobehere means that:

You will join a team you can count on
- we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.
You will love our level of autonomy
in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.
You will value our Developer Experience
and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.
You will be equipped with modern AI tools
to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).
You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!)
by your friends, family and millions of our customers.
You will meet the Allegro Scale
, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning.
You will become part of Allegro Tech
- We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!

Send us your CV and… see you at Allegro!

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with OAuth
jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why.

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.
Take ownership of technical designs and implementation approaches for assigned capabilities, identifying dependencies, risks and trade-offs and following work through to a production-ready outcome.
Lead focused technical work packages and provide practical guidance to other engineers contributing to the same capability.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.
Promote engineering best practices including Clean Code, automated testing and secure software development.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers and Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
Support less experienced engineers through constructive reviews, knowledge sharing and technical mentoring.

Operations & Collaboration

Participate in third-line production support and on-call rotation.
Investigate production issues and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
Work closely with multiple product teams integrating with the platform.
Share knowledge and contribute to establishing long-term Endava ownership of the Authentication & Authorization capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

6+ years of commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET.
Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications or shared platform services.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or OpenTofu.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience developing Angular applications using TypeScript.
Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration and API testing).
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple product teams.
Ability to influence technical outcomes across team boundaries, communicate delivery risks and contribute to decisions affecting shared platform consumers.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Auth0
Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA)
Google Zanzibar authorization model
Azure API Management (APIM)
SCIM integrations
Identity Federation Datadog
Playwright
Trivy
GitLeaks
Invicti
Experience building reusable developer platforms
Experience working with enterprise shared services

Additional Information

Our benefits offering typically include private medical insurance, dental plan, and glasses reimbursement. All remuneration and benefits decisions are based on non-discriminatory, gender-neutral criteria, and in accordance with the Polish Labour Code amendments implementing Directive on pay transparency, we do not request or consider candidates’ current or past remuneration during the recruitment process.”

jobs.description:
About Lumilens

At Lumilens we are building the critical photonics infrastructure that powers tomorrow’s AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing faster, cooler, and massively more efficient.

We’re a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by veterans who’ve built and scaled some of the most transformative technologies in the industry. This isn’t incremental innovation, it’s a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. You’ll work alongside a team of world-class engineers solving some of the hardest challenges in optics, systems, and scale. Every line of code, every design decision, every breakthrough you help deliver will shape the infrastructure of tomorrow.

If you're looking for mission, momentum, and the chance to make an outsized impact—jump on the rocket ship. We’re just getting started … and we are building a team in Kraków
.

About The Role

We are building a next-generation Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to power high-volume production of advanced silicon photonics devices (800G, 1.6T, and beyond). This system will serve as the operational backbone of our manufacturing—integrating shopfloor control, data systems, and external platforms (ERP, vendors, contract manufacturers).

This is a foundational, greenfield opportunity to design and build a large-scale enterprise platform from the ground up. You will operate in a highly dynamic, R&D-driven environment—shaping system architecture, defining requirements, and rapidly iterating through prototypes and production systems.

We are hiring across multiple profiles (Senior, Staff, and Technical Lead/Architect) for engineers who thrive in ambiguity and want to build systems that directly impact real-world hardware and manufacturing at scale.

Key Responsibilities

System Architecture & Development

Design and build distributed backend systems supporting MES and shopfloor control
Define system architecture, APIs, and data models for high-scale, high-reliability environments
Develop microservices and integrations connecting internal systems with ERP, vendors, and manufacturing partners

R&D & Problem Solving

Analyze existing MES and enterprise solutions (commercial and open-source) to inform system design
Translate evolving, loosely defined requirements into robust technical solutions
Lead prototyping, proof-of-concept development, and iterative system refinement

Data & Workflow Integration

Design and implement data pipelines and workflows across multiple systems
Enable real-time data movement, transformation, and event-driven automation
Build integrations that connect manufacturing systems, external partners, and internal tools

Engineering Excellence

Apply best practices in clean architecture, code quality, and system design
Conduct code reviews and enforce strong development standards
Ensure scalability, performance, and reliability through testing and optimization

Qualifications

5+ years of experience building backend or distributed systems
Strong programming experience in languages such as C#, Java, or Go
Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and API design
Strong database design skills (relational models, normalization, performance)
Experience with concurrency, parallelism, and scalable system design
Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, and modern development workflows
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to operate in evolving, ambiguous environments
Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally

Preferred Qualifications

Technical Lead / Architect (Enterprise Systems)

Experience designing and scaling complex enterprise platforms
Strong system design and architecture leadership
Deep understanding of performance, reliability, and distributed systems trade-offs

Data / Integration Engineer

Experience building data pipelines, workflows, and system integrations
Familiarity with ETL frameworks (e.g., Airflow, n8n, or similar)
Strong experience in data transformation, mapping, and automation

Nice to Have

Experience with MES or manufacturing systems
Familiarity with manufacturing concepts:
BOM, work orders, MRP, production planning
Shopfloor operations, quality, traceability, inventory
Experience integrating with industrial equipment or IoT systems
Exposure to frontend technologies (React, Vue)

What we offer

Competitive compensation and meaningful equity
Opportunity to build a greenfield, mission-critical system from the ground up
Direct impact on cutting-edge AI and photonics infrastructure
Collaborative, high-caliber engineering team
Fast-paced, high-growth environment with significant ownership

.

WHY WESTWING

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.

At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here Is What You Can Look Forward To

A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
A flexible hybrid setup with 2 office days per week - because strong connections and quick collaboration make great ideas happen

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. jobs.description:
Project Description:

Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft.

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
AI Labs is a sub-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self-serve access to the AI-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

Your Skills And Experiences

- BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
- Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
- Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C#, PowerShell, Python
- Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
- Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
- Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
- Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
- Proactive thinking, excellent problem-solving, and analytical skills
- Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
- Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
- Fluent in English

- Strong coding skills (e.g. C#, PowerShell)
- Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
- Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
- Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions

Responsibilities:

- Shape customer's architectural strategy to create a secure, scalable, and compliant cloud environment
- Act as a trusted advisor for the customer to ensure alignment with strategic goals, advocate customer's interests when working in a diverse team of various stakeholders, and promote cutting-edge cloud technologies.

- Coordination of team resources to solve problems and technical issues
- Work in Agile (Scrum, Kanban), defining, estimating, and delivering stories

jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Who we are looking for

📌 This is a future-oriented recruitment process. While we may not have an immediate opening, we're building a network of talented engineers interested in future opportunities with Deloitte. We expect demand to grow in the coming months, so we'd love to get to know great candidates in advance.

We are looking for a strong Backend Engineer or Full-Stack Engineer with deep backend expertise who can combine software engineering
excellence with a Forward Deployed Engineer
mindset.

This person will work closely with clients, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to rapidly understand problems, design practical solutions, build prototypes, and deliver production-ready applications.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in ambiguous environments, translating business needs into technical solutions, and using modern AI development tools to accelerate design, coding, testing, documentation, and delivery. A person who enjoys solving complex business problems rather than working with a predefined technology stack.

Required experience and skills:

Experience in consulting, client-facing engineering, solution engineering, or Forward Deployed Engineering.
Approximately 5+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong backend development experience using technologies such as Java, C#, Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar.
Experience designing REST APIs, event-driven services, integrations, and distributed systems.
Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and modern development practices.
Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems and quickly become productive.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to work directly with clients and operate effectively when requirements are incomplete or rapidly evolving.
Practical experience using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar.
Valid work permit

AI Engineering capabilities:

Understanding of LLM-based application architecture.
Experience with prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, agents, and RAG patterns.
Ability to evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
Experience using AI tools to accelerate the complete software-development lifecycle.
Ability to move quickly from an idea or natural-language requirement to a working prototype without compromising production engineering standards.

Additional experience that will help you succeed:

Frontend experience with React, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless platforms, or microservices.
Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft, Creatio, or comparable systems.
Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent enterprise applications.
Familiarity with observability, infrastructure as code, API management, and integration platforms.

Your future role

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, integrations, and data-processing solutions.
Build full-stack applications when required, with primary ownership of backend architecture and implementation.
Work directly with clients and business stakeholders to understand challenges and translate them into working software.
Rapidly prototype, validate, and roll out new solutions.
Take end-to-end ownership, from requirements discovery and solution design to deployment and operational support.
Integrate enterprise platforms, cloud services, databases, APIs, and AI capabilities.
Use AI-assisted development tools for code generation, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and rapid experimentation.
Apply rapid “vibe coding” techniques responsibly while maintaining security, maintainability, testing, and engineering quality.
Build AI-enabled applications using LLMs, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, and structured data.
Establish reusable development patterns, accelerators, templates, and engineering standards.
Support CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, observability, and production troubleshooting.
Collaborate with architects, DevOps engineers, data engineers, frontend developers, and client delivery teams.
Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Selection process

What you only must do is to take the first step – press the apply button and send us your CV, go through all the stages of the recruitment process:

CV check and then HR screening

Technical interview
with our Architects
Meeting with Business

jobs.description:
What is Box?

Box (NYSE: BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together — and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

Why Box needs you:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Desktop Applications team at Box, you'll be at the heart of building and evolving the products that millions of users rely on every day - Box Drive, Box Tools, and Box for Office on both Windows and macOS. You'll work across the full depth of the desktop stack, from virtual file systems and OS integrations to sync, networking, and UI, helping shape how enterprise content comes to life on the desktop. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA engineers, and designers to deliver features that are fast, reliable, and secure - and you'll bring a growth mindset and a passion for leveraging AI tools to accelerate your impact.

What you'll do:

Design, develop, and ship high-quality features for Box's desktop applications (Box Drive, Box Tools, Box for Office) on Windows and macOS, ensuring they are performant, user-friendly, and secure
Work across the full desktop stack — including virtual file systems, data persistence, OS integrations, network and sync layers, and UI — to solve complex technical challenges at scale
Contribute to cross-platform development using React Native, bridging front-end and native desktop experiences
Collaborate daily with Product Managers, QA engineers, and designers to translate requirements into robust, well-tested software
Lead and participate in design discussions, architecture reviews, and code reviews to uphold engineering quality and share knowledge across the team
Diagnose and resolve complex performance, reliability, and compatibility issues affecting millions of end users
Attend and engage in weekly stand-ups, team meetings, and manager 1:1s
Work collaboratively with other engineers, team members, and across teams
Play a role in developing and fostering Box culture in the Warsaw office and represent Box Poland internally and externally
Participate in our on-call rotation, available at all times while on-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise

Who you are:

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

5+ years of professional desktop software development experience
Proficient in C++, C#, and/or Swift, with a strong command of software design and architecture principles
Demonstrated experience building and shipping desktop applications on Windows and/or macOS
Comfortable working across the full desktop stack: virtual file systems, OS integrations, networking, sync, and UI
Experienced with unit testing and functional testing practices in an agile team environment
Passionate about building software that is user-friendly, performant, and secure
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
Able to assess, communicate, and complete project milestones with your manager and team members in a time-sensitive manner
Must speak English proficiently

Preferred Skills:

Experience with Windows systems-level programming (Win32 APIs, multi-threading, IPC, COM)
Cross-platform development experience across both macOS and Windows
Prior experience using AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of your daily workflow

Percentage of Time Spent:

15% design and architecture
60% coding, code reviews, and testing
15% bug fixes
5% documentation
5% meetings

Methodology:

Agile management — Scrum
Issue tracking — Jira
Knowledge repository — Box / Confluence / GitHub Enterprise
Code reviews — GitHub Enterprise
Version control — GIT
CI/CD — Jenkins
Communication — Slack / Zoom

Benefits

Check out the overview of Life at Box which include general perks and benefits.

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. Senior SQA Engineer – Test Automation / Manual Testing

Job Title:

Senior SQA Engineer – Test Automation / Manual Testing

About us:

Accuris launched in May 2023 as a standalone company and was formerly known as S&P Global’s Engineering Solutions division. Accuris has been an integral part of the engineering ecosystem for more than 60 years and is valued for standards content and workflow solutions including Engineering Workbench, Goldfire, Haystack, and Parts Management Solutions.

The Team:

The Engineering Workbench team builds and evolves a flagship Accuris product used globally by engineering professionals. The team focuses on delivering robust, scalable, and secure cloud-based solutions in AWS, supported by strong software quality practices across manual testing, automation, defect management, and CI/CD validation.

You will collaborate closely with software developers, QA specialists, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders. The team values ownership, practical test automation, clear communication, continuous improvement, and proactive collaboration across disciplines.

The Impact:

As a Senior SQA Engineer, you will design software testing plans, create and execute manual and automated tests, and help ensure the quality of web applications and services throughout the full product lifecycle, including Production.

You will guide the team on when and how to automate effectively, influence testability during design and development phases, coordinate defect management, and provide clear test results, regression feedback, and quality insights to development teams.

Responsibilities:

Design software testing plans and create and execute both manual and automated tests using test automation tools including, but not limited to Selenium and Playwright.
Understand the concepts behind automation, know when automation is appropriate, and guide the team on how to create the right tests.
Coordinate team members to solve issues assigned to the team and support timely resolution of quality risks.
Monitor Production quality and coordinate resolution of issues assigned to teams.
Ensure compliance of team testing activities with project rules, quality standards, and agreed processes.
Participate in functional testing during CI/CD processes and support reliable product releases.
Organize and monitor defect management processes within teams.
Influence the inclusion of testability during design, grooming, and development phases.
Test the product in all phases of its lifecycle, including Production.
Interface with developers in the project by providing clear test results and identifying regression areas.

What We’re Looking For:

Key qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years of automation engineering experience with Selenium WebDriver and/or Playwright using C#/.NET and xUnit frameworks.
Experience testing web applications built with .NET Core, microservices, and AngularJS, including cross-browser and cross-device validation using automated tools.
Solid knowledge of databases, including the ability to write CRUD operations, work with JOINs, and validate data-driven application behavior.

Key soft skills:

Strong collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate testing activities, defect management, and issue resolution across development teams.
Clear, structured communication with developers, including the ability to provide test results, regression areas, and actionable defect information.
Proactive approach to quality, testability, production monitoring, and continuous improvement throughout the software development lifecycle.
Good spoken and written English.

Required Knowledge / Technologies:

Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, C#/.NET, xUnit frameworks, manual testing, automated testing, functional testing, and test case/script design and execution.
Testing of web applications in .NET Core, microservices, AngularJS, client-server application architecture, RESTful APIs, and CI/CD processes.
Databases and SQL, including CRUD operations, JOINs, data validation, and practical understanding of application data flows.
Docker containerization basics, AWS cloud services such as EC2, S3, RDS, or similar, and development tools such as Visual Studio, VS Code, or Rider.
Agile software development, Azure DevOps / ADOPS bug tracking, defect management, and exposure to performance and load testing tools such as CloudTest, Cloud Testing using ADOPS, or K6 are considered a plus.

What’s in it for you:

Opportunity to shape testing strategy and improve automation practices for a flagship product used globally.
Hands-on work across manual testing, automation, API testing, CI/CD validation, production quality monitoring, and defect management.
Close collaboration with experienced developers, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders in an Agile environment.
Corporate support for personal growth and career development, provision of all necessary equipment, and benefits including medical package, Multisport, life insurance, and the internal Wellbeing program.

The Location:

Poland.

Budget:

PLN 20,000–24,000 gross per month, with flexibility depending on seniority and experience, plus 5% bonus.

Compensation/Benefits Information

Accuris states that the anticipated base salary / budget for this position is PLN 20,000–24,000 gross per month, with flexibility depending on seniority and experience. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographical location as well as experience and qualifications for the role. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for a 5% bonus as well as comprehensive benefits. For more information on benefits, please reach out to the recruiter assigned to the role.

Benefits include a medical package, Multisport, life insurance, internal Wellbeing program, corporate support for personal growth and career development, and provision of all necessary equipment.

Accuris delivers essential intelligence that powers decision making. We provide the world’s leading organizations with the right data, connected technologies, and expertise they need to move ahead. We think differently, combining the knowledge and resources of an established company with the unapologetic boldness of a startup. https://accuristech.com/https://accuristech.com/

jobs.description:
About the job:

Are you excited about leading high-scale platform engineering in the core fintech sector? We are searching for a dynamic Engineering Manager who leads the platform engineering team responsible for JVM and .NET platform health, DevOps tooling, CI/CD, observability, and deployment infrastructure across all FinTech products.

You will be accountable for platform reliability, cost efficiency, developer velocity, and AI readiness across the FinTech engineering organization. For this position, the candidate must be an engineer specializing in either .NET or Java.

Important things for you:

Flexible working hours
in the hybrid model (4/1) — working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
Depending on your annual assessment and the company's results we offer:
Annual bonus
based on your annual performance and company results.
Long term discretionary incentive plan
based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).
Our team is based in Warsaw
.

Your responsibilities:

Leads and manages a cross-functional platform engineering team.
Drives platform adoption and removes technical and operational blockers across product teams.
Oversees infrastructure provisioning, cloud resource management, and container orchestration on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Coordinates fleet-scale migrations, including JVM and .NET platform development, Java, .NET, and Spring Boot upgrades.
Optimizes CI/CD pipelines, GitOps deployment safety (canary releases, configuration versioning), and infrastructure cost efficiency.
Integrates AI tools into platform engineering workflows to accelerate developer velocity company-wide.

High cloud logging and observability costs requiring validation and deployment of alternative logging backends like VictoriaLogs.
Scaling pipeline throughput and deployment safety to match the accelerated development speed driven by AI tools.
Modernizing JVM and .NET platform and tracking library adoption across products.
Balancing tight roadmap deadlines with team capacity and high operational interrupt volumes.
