jobs.title: AI- lösningsarkitekt inom Dynamics 365 & Power Platform
jobs.description:
Som lösningsarkitekt får du kombinera verksamhetsförståelse med teknisk konfigurering, automatisering och utveckling av AI-stödda CRM-lösningar i Microsofts moderna molnplattform. Du arbetar nära kundens verksamhet för att omsätta affärsbehov till effektiva och säkra lösningar baserade på Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM), Power Platform, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Services och Microsofts agentplattformar.
En viktig del av rollen är att hjälpa kunder att etablera och utveckla AI-funktionalitet genom Copilot Studio, AI-agenter, generativ AI och automatiserade processer samtidigt som du säkerställer governance, säkerhet, identitetshantering och efterlevnad av organisationens regelverk. Du blir en nyckelperson i implementations- och förvaltningsprojekt där du hjälper kunder att digitalisera, automatisera och AI-förstärka sina verksamhetsprocesser med hjälp av Microsofts ekosystem och Power Platform.
I rollen kommer du bland annat:

Leda workshops, kravinsamling och verksamhetsanalyser för att identifiera hur AI-agenter, Copilot-lösningar och generativ AI kan skapa affärsvärde och stödja verksamhetsprocesser.
Designa AI- och agentarkitekturer baserade på Microsofts plattform, inklusive Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Dynamics 365, Power Platform och Dataverse.
Identifiera och definiera användningsfall för AI-agenter samt omsätta affärsbehov till lösningsarkitekturer med fokus på automatisering, beslutsstöd, självbetjäning och produktivitet.
Ansvara för den tekniska lösningsdesignen av AI-agenter, inklusive orkestrering mellan agenter, integrationsmönster, datakällor, kunskapsbaser, RAG-lösningar (Retrieval Augmented Generation), agentinstruktioner och eskaleringsmekanismer.
Utforma säkra och skalbara lösningar med fokus på governance, säkerhet, identitetshantering (Microsoft Entra ID), dataskydd, regelefterlevnad och ansvarsfull AI.
Leda implementation och kvalitetssäkring av lösningar genom nära samarbete med utvecklare, verksamhetsexperter och lösningsarkitekter inom Dynamics 365 och Power Platform.
Driva innovation och rådgivning kring nya möjligheter inom agentbaserad AI, Copilot Studio, Azure AI och Microsofts AI-plattformar.
Stötta kunder i deras AI-resa genom utbildning, förändringsledning, arkitekturrådgivning och etablering av best practices för AI och agentutveckling.

Vi söker dig med:

Mycket goda kunskaper i konfigurering av Dynamics 365 CE/CRM och/eller Power Platform-verktygen, exempelvis Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse och Power BI.
2-4 års erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 och/eller Power Platform, exempelvis som konsult, systemansvarig eller superuser.
Praktisk erfarenhet av att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla AI-agenter och Copilot-lösningar med hjälp av Copilot Studio, Azure AI och Microsofts AI-plattformar. Förståelse för agentarkitektur, generativ AI, orkestrering, integrationsmönster och ansvarsfull AI.
God verksamhetsförståelse inom områden som försäljning, kundservice, marknadsföring eller ekonomi.
Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.

Om oss:

Vi är ett ledande nordiskt IT-bolag som stärker våra kunders IT-förmåga i en allt mer komplex digital värld. Med bred och djup kompetens hjälper vi organisationer att skapa stabila, säkra och moderna lösningar från applikationsutveckling och integration till infrastruktur, drift och säkerhet. Vi tar ett helhetsansvar för IT och arbetar långsiktigt, både med våra kunder och med varandra. Hos oss är gemenskap, engagemang och utveckling en självklar del av vardagen. När vi trivs och växer tillsammans skapar vi också större värde.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.

 We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Design, develop, test and maintain scalable software applications across front-end and back-end systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product management, architecture and quality assurance, to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
Develop user-centred front-end interfaces and secure back-end systems.
Implement and maintain APIs and integration solutions to support efficient data exchange between systems.
Participate in code reviews, testing activities and continuous improvement initiatives to achieve agreed quality standards.
Troubleshoot, debug and resolve software defects and performance issues.
Maintain up-to-date documentation covering code, architecture and user guidance to support ongoing maintenance and future enhancements.

Qualifications

Essential Criteria

Proficient in multiple programming languages such as C#, JavaScript and TypeScript.
Sound understanding of software development best practices, design patterns and coding principles.
Experience with front-end frameworks (e.g. React, Angular, Vue.js) and associated libraries.
Experience with back-end development frameworks (e.g. Node.js, Django, Spring) and API development (RESTful, GraphQL).
Experience of relational databases (e.g. SQL Server) and data modelling.
Experience with version control systems (e.g. Git), CI/CD tools (e.g. Azure DevOps) and agile development methodologies and tooling (e.g. Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira).
Knowledge of cloud technologies (e.g. Microsoft Azure).
Ability to identify, troubleshoot and resolve software issues and improve application performance and scalability.
Experience with continuous integration and delivery pipelines and automated testing.

Desirable Criteria

Exposure to additional cloud, database or development technologies relevant to the role.
Experience working across both front-end and back-end development environments.

Specialisms

Depending on business needs, the assignment may require experience in one of the following specialisms:

Front-End Specialism

Responsive web design.
UI/UX principles.
Accessibility.
Low-code platform development (e.g. Power Platform).
Performance optimisation.

Back-End Specialism

Server-side application development.
Database design.
API integration.
SharePoint.
Development and security best practices.

Full Stack Specialism

Front-end and back-end development experience to deliver end-to-end solutions that support effective user experiences and efficient data management.

Additional Information

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Version 1 Pension with a 5% employee-matched contribution, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more.
24 days holiday allowance plus Public Holidays, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & quarterly Star Awards.
Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact ekta.bahl@version1.com. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

Job Description

As a Senior CRM Developer
at Version 1, you will contribute to the design, development and support of Microsoft Dynamics CRM solutions for large-scale enterprise and public sector organisations. Working closely with business stakeholders, technical teams and customers, you will help deliver CRM solutions that support business processes, regulatory requirements and data-driven decision making.

You will use your expertise in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, .NET, SQL Server and related technologies to build, customise and integrate CRM solutions while supporting the ongoing evolution of business-critical systems.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop and maintain Microsoft Dynamics CRM (v9.2 On-Premise or similar) solutions.
Configure, customise and extend Dynamics CRM using supported APIs, JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
Design and develop CRM plugins, workflows and integrations with enterprise systems.
Develop and maintain C# .NET applications, Web APIs and supporting components that integrate with CRM.
Work with SQL Server databases, including database design, stored procedures, functions and T-SQL development.
Develop and maintain CRM data models, security models and solution configurations.
Support data migration, data integration and system enhancement activities.
Collaborate with Business Analysts, Architects and project stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Participate in Agile delivery activities including sprint planning, estimation, reviews and retrospectives.
Contribute to unit testing, integration testing and quality assurance activities.

Description

Looking to be part of a team building hyper-scale database services in the cloud? Do you want to revolutionize the way people manage vast volumes of data in the cloud where you have direct and immediate impact on hundreds of thousands of users who use AWS database services?

Aurora is a distributed, fault-tolerant database service, leveraging a self-healing storage system which performs up to five times faster than standard MySQL databases and three times faster than standard PostgreSQL databases.

Aurora is one of the fastest-growing AWS services, with business and engineering decisions having a widespread impact across many of the world's fastest growing businesses! Our customers depend on the performance of our services to scale and support their mission-critical workloads.

Operating much like a start-up, we have a very flat organizational structure and a casual office vibe, but leverage all the resources and stability of being the largest cloud provider.

We are looking for Software Development Engineers who have built software and shipped products. You should be passionate about optimizing the software development experience at a very large scale, using your strong technical skills and motivation to achieve results. You are naturally enthusiastic about learning new technologies and industry trends and are excited by the idea of solving hard technical challenges.

Aurora is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Come, join us in reinventing database systems for the cloud!

Key job responsibilities

These are core systems development positions where you will grow to own the design and development of significant system software components critical to our industry leading database services architected for the cloud. You will be part of the team that architects, designs, and implements highly scalable distributed database systems that provide availability, reliability and performance guarantees. This is a hands-on position where you will be asked to do everything from building rock-solid components to mentoring other engineers. You need to be not only a top software developer with a good track record of delivering, but also excel in communication, leadership and customer focus. This is a unique and rare opportunity to get in on the ground floor within a fast-growing business and help shape the technology and the product.

An AWS Senior Software Development Engineer on the Aurora Developer Experience team drives the architecture, design, and implementation of high-performance, fault-tolerant database services. They lead cross-organizational projects, mentor engineers, and own the full software development lifecycle to improve customer experience at scale.

About The Team

The Amazon Aurora Control Plane team builds and manages the essential service components, APIs, and workflows that orchestrate, scale, and secure Aurora’s distributed database infrastructure. Operating like a startup within AWS, the team focuses on reliability, high availability, and performance for cloud-native databases.

Focus Area: The team focuses on enhancing developer experience, operational ownership, and creating intelligent tools to make Aurora faster.

Culture: It is described as having a flat structure with a "startup-like" environment, high-ownership, and a collaborative, fast-paced atmosphere.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

Demonstrates strong understanding of software engineering processes such as agile methodologies, code-reviews, writing functional specifications

jobs.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

What You Can Expect

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Cloud Engineer to support the provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of cloud infrastructure within our Microsoft Azure environment. In this hands-on role, you will work alongside experienced engineers to automate deployments, manage containerized workloads, and contribute to secure, scalable, and efficient cloud operations. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically curious individual eager to build a career in cloud engineering.

How You'll Create Impact

Provision, configure, and maintain Azure cloud resources across development, QA, staging, and production environments.
Implement and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Bicep and ARM templates, following established standards and approval processes.
Monitor cloud environments for performance, availability, cost optimization, and application health using Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure Application Insights.
Assist in analyzing logs, metrics, traces, and alerts to support incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
Participate in day-to-day cloud operations including incident response, change management, access reviews, and cloud resource tagging.
Deploy, operate, and support containerized applications on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with an emphasis on secure-by-default and safety-focused configurations.
Support AKS safety and security features including:
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and least-privilege access
Network policies and private cluster configurations
Pod and container security best practices
Cluster and workload observability using logs, metrics, and alerts
Patch management and Kubernetes version upgrades under guidance

Perform scaling, health monitoring, and basic troubleshooting of Kubernetes workloads using kubectl, Helm, and Azure CLI.
Contribute to CI/CD workflows and deployment automation in collaboration with developers using GitHub Actions, with attention to deployment safety, validation, and rollback strategies.
Create and maintain documentation for cloud infrastructure, deployment processes, observability standards, security controls, and operational procedures.
Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, retrospectives, and internal knowledge-sharing sessions.

Your Background

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and core services such as Virtual Machines, App Services, Storage, Networking, and identity services.
Practical understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals (pods, deployments, services, namespaces) and container orchestration concepts.
Experience using Docker and container deployment tools such as Helm.
Familiarity with application monitoring and observability tools, including Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure Application Insights.
Experience with scripting or automation using PowerShell, Bash, or programming languages such as Python or C#.
Understanding of cloud security fundamentals including RBAC, identity management, network segmentation, and least-privilege principles.
Ability to follow defined processes and controls while progressively taking ownership of assigned systems and tasks.
Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset.

Travel Expectations

Occasional overnight travel as necessary.

This is a full-time position and it may reasonably require additional hours during the week and weekend; specific requirements will be determined with Manager.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Plenty of developers have tried an AI agent. Fewer have run several in parallel, built their own tooling to keep them on track, and worked out exactly where they shine and where they still fall over. If you are on top of these things and want to contribute to the build-up of an agentic software organization, we should talk.

Getinge is looking for Senior .NET Developers in Copenhagen. You will be building software that hospitals around the world depend on every day, and you will be helping shape how a large software organization adopts AI. We have several positions open.

What You Would Be Building

Getinge is a global MedTech company, and our teams in Copenhagen, Hamburg and Aarhus build software that runs at the heart of a modern hospital. Our solutions track surgical instruments through sterile reprocessing with full traceability, orchestrate fleets of robots and reprocessing equipment, plan and optimize the surgical day, coordinate patient flow and staff in real time, and keep thousands of connected medical devices running in the field.

Our software is mission-critical, deeply integrated with hospital IT and physical equipment, and built to a high standard of quality. It is also software where the impact is immediate and real: better use of an operating room, an instrument set that arrives on time, a surgery that goes ahead instead of being cancelled. Not everyone gets to end the week knowing their work helped someone get treated.

What We Work With

Our teams work primarily in C#/.Net &Blazor, with focus on containerization and cloud deployment to Azure, across the organization that spans web and mobile applications, cloud services, real-time systems, and integration with physical equipment.

We are not looking for a checklist match for all of it. What matters is that you are strong in .NET, that you are comfortable working across a stack rather than in one corner of it, and that you pick new things up quickly. The exact mix varies by team, and we will find the right fit together.

Where we are with AI

We are currently in the process of accelerating our software factory with AI. Our teams have been exploring AI-assisted and agentic development processes for some time and are implementing our learnings. However, we are seeking additional fresh perspectives on the matter. This is where you come in.

If you have real experience here and strong opinions about what works, you will find both room to use them and colleagues who will argue back.

Our developers have access to the latest models and a meaningful budget for AI tooling and usage, and we are also looking at introducing new and improved methods and tools to improve our way of working.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and maintain robust .NET services and applications for mission-critical hospital software.
Build and integrate agentic AI capabilities – designing, orchestrating, and evaluating AI agents and LLM-driven workflows in our products and in how we work.
Drive AI adoption in your team and across the organization, setting the standard for how modern tooling improves quality, speed, and value delivered.
Contribute to system architecture, code quality, and engineering practices.
Work closely with product owners, architects, UX/UI, and developers across multiple sites.

You will bring

Strong .NET expertise – deep, hands-on experience building and maintaining production software in C# and modern .NET.
Breadth and adaptability – you are happy to work across the stack and into the cloud, and you are not thrown by a technology you have not used before.
Real depth with AI in practice – you use AI tools in your daily work, you are hands-on with agents and LLM-driven workflows, and you can point to things you have actually built with them. We care more about what you have done and how you think about it than about years on a CV.
A proactive, positive, and constructive mindset – you take ownership from start to finish, communicate openly, and make the people around you better.
The ability to build maintainable, high-quality solutions and to work independently as well as in a team.

Nice to have

Experience with hardware–software integration, robotics, or embedded systems.
Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging, or distributed systems.
Experience working in Agile teams on regulated or safety-critical products.

What We Offer

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that improve healthcare quality and efficiency, with the ambition to be the most desired MedTech company in the world. You would join our Digital Health Solutions department, which counts around 165 people across Denmark, Germany, and the UK, plus a further 100 colleagues in Getinge offices globally.

A smart working environment with shared desks, several work-from-home days per week, and a budget for your home office setup.
Flexible working hours.
Competitive benefits including health insurance and pension.
Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
A collaborative, inclusive, and motivating culture.

Application

Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 17-10-2026

We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

About Us 

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

jobs.description:
Start your software development career building real products used by professionals around the world.

Are you about to finish – or have you recently finished – your Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or a related field?

At Dalux, you will join a product team where you can develop your technical skills while taking real responsibility from the the outset. You will work alongside experienced developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers to build software used across the global construction industry.

Your role

As a Full-Stack Software Developer, you will work across our technology stack and take part in developing features end-to-end – from understanding the problem and designing a solution to implementation and delivery.

You will not be expected to know everything when you join.

Instead, we expect you to be curious, willing to learn, and ready to take increasing ownership as your skills develop. You will have experienced colleagues around you for daily technical sparring, code reviews, and support.

Your work will include:

Designing and developing new product functionality
Working across both front-end and back-end technologies
Collaborating with developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers
Writing maintainable, reliable, and high-quality software
Learning our products, architecture, and engineering practices
Taking increasing ownership of features and technical decisions as you develop
Contributing ideas for how we can improve our products and the way we build them

Developing software with AI

AI-assisted development is becoming an increasingly important part of how we build software at Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can help developers understand code, explore solutions, implement and refactor functionality, create tests, debug problems, and automate repetitive work.

You do not need to be an AI expert. But we are looking for developers who are curious about these tools, willing to experiment, and able to think critically about when AI improves a solution – and when it does not.

If you have already experimented with AI-assisted development through your studies, student job, personal projects, or other work, we would be interested to hear what you learned.

Technologies we work with

Our main full-stack technologies include:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
GitHub CoPilot
MSSQL
Elasticsearch
Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You are not expected to know our entire stack when you join. Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn are more important.

Product development at Dalux

Our developers do more than implement specifications.

You will work in a product team together with a Product Manager and Product Designer, combining different perspectives on user value, usability, technical feasibility, and business viability.

This means understanding why we build something, contributing to how we solve the problem, and seeing your work become part of a product used by professionals worldwide.

We work according to agile principles and maintain a strong focus on quality, stability, and long-term maintainability.

Your background

We expect that you:

Have, or are about to complete, a Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or a similar technical field
Have a solid foundation in software development and computer science
Are curious and motivated to learn new technologies
Enjoy solving problems and understanding how things work
Care about building good software, not simply making code compile
Are comfortable asking questions, receiving feedback, and challenging yourself
Want to take ownership and responsibility as your skills grow

Professional experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What matters most is your technical potential, curiosity, interest in software craftsmanship, and willingness to learn.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart, and software development is central to what we do.

You can expect:

Meaningful product responsibility early in your career
Daily sparring with skilled and experienced developers
Short paths between ideas, technical decisions, and implementation
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
Close collaboration with Product Management and Design
The opportunity to learn how AI-assisted development is changing software engineering
A social development environment with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All our software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. We believe working together makes learning, technical collaboration, and knowledge sharing significantly easier – particularly at the beginning of your career.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house at Dalux.

Ready to start your development career?

If you are looking for a place where you can learn quickly, take real responsibility, and build software with visible impact, we would like to hear from you.

Application

Job offer

We hire several Software Developers throughout the year as Dalux continues to grow.

jobs.location: Brøndby Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Vi søger en backend-udvikler til Product Engineering, der har lyst til at være med fra bunden – og som samtidig kan bygge løsninger, der holder, når belastningen topper.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor app og backend arbejder som ét hold. Her er der kort fra idé til kode, og du får mandat til at træffe de arkitekturvalg, der skal bære os de næste mange år.

Om jobbet

Som .NET-udvikler sidder du tæt på både app-udviklerne, produktet og forretningen. Du kommer blandt andet til at:

Designe og udvikle skalerbare, sikre og hurtige API’er i C# og moderne .NET
Bygge det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser
Sikre fremdrift i app-teamet med mock-API’er og prototyper, mens den robuste løsning modnes
Bruge moderne AI-kodeværktøjer til at effektivisere boilerplate, test og optimering
Sikre driftssikkerhed og performance i løsninger, der skal klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du genkender dig selv i flere af nedenstående punkter:

Dyb .NET-ekspertise: Du er en stærk håndværker i C# og moderne .NET, og du forstår at bygge skalerbare, sikre og lynhurtige API’er.
Frontend-empati: Du forstår, at dit API er fundamentet for app-oplevelsen. Du tænker over latency og smarte payloads og bygger API’er, der gør livet let og hurtigt for den iOS-udvikler, der skal konsumere dem.
Pragmatisk fremdrift: Du kender vigtigheden af at sikre fremdrift for dine aftagere. Du leverer hurtigt mock-API’er og prototyper, der sikrer fremdrift, mens du bygger den langsigtede og robuste arkitektur under kølerhjelmen.
Agentic AI-kompetence: Du har praktisk erfaring med – eller stor nysgerrighed for – at udnytte agentic workflows, prompt engineering og AI-værktøjer til at accelerere din kode- og udviklingsproces.
Product Engineer-mindset: Du tænker som en Product Engineer. Du koder ikke bare kravspecifikationer, men engagerer dig i brugerrejsen og forretningsværdien.

Om Product Engineering

Product Engineering er produktfokuseret, eksekverende, samarbejdsorienteret, autonom og ambitiøs. Vi bygger for brugeren frem for systemets skyld, vi arbejder som ét team på tværs af app og backend, og vi har mandatet til selv at træffe de rigtige arkitekturvalg. Ambitionen er driftssikre løsninger, der kan håndtere massiv skala.

Hvorfor Danske Spil?

Hos Danske Spil får du en ret unik mulighed: startup-viben ved at være med til at bygge et nyt, stærkt in-house app-udviklingsmiljø op fra bunden – men med skalaen, tyngden og volumen fra en af Danmarks største digitale forretninger.

Som backend-udvikler i Product Engineering bliver du ikke gemt væk i en silo. Du sidder helt tæt på app-udviklerne og forretningen og får direkte indflydelse på det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser. Du arbejder agilt og autonomt med moderne, AI-støttede værktøjer. Det er den perfekte legeplads, hvis du motiveres af at bygge API’er, der både kræver høj fart og innovation i hverdagen, og som samtidig skal kunne klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger uden at blinke.

Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?

Vi læser ansøgninger igennem løbende, men deadline for at søge er den 9. oktober 2026. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Persson på jepe@danskespil.dk. Hvis du har spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner, Mette Overgaard Holm på MEHO@danskespil.dk.

Til glæde og til gavn

Du kender sikkert vores navn og nogle af vores spil. Men ved du også, hvordan Danske Spil er til glæde og til gavn for hele Danmark?

Vi er markedsleder inden for lotteri, sportsspil og casino i Danmark – og det er staten og de store idrætsforeninger, DGI og DIF, der ejer Danske Spil. Med andre ord ejer vi alle sammen Danske Spil.

Og med det ejerskab følger et særligt ansvar. Et ansvar for at finansiere det idræts-, kultur- og foreningsliv, vi er rundet af. Og et ansvar for at modarbejde spilafhængighed og sørge for, at det hele går ordentligt til.

Vores historie begyndte i 1948, da 20.000 idrætsfolk demonstrerede på Rådhuspladsen for en ny lov, som gav sporten del i overskuddet fra væddemål. Året efter blev Danske Spil grundlagt – og siden har vi hvert år sendt hele vores overskud tilbage til fællesskabet. Hvert år spiller mere end 1,9 millioner danskere hos os – online eller hos en af vores 3.700 forhandlere. Og vi er knap 500 medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder med at balancere konkurrencedygtighed og ansvarlighed. For vi er hele Danmarks spilleselskab – til glæde og til gavn

jobs.description:
I Domestic Payment Capturing har vi ansvaret for brugeroplevelsen og de services, der gør det muligt at oprette indlandsbetalinger sikkert, stabilt og effektivt for både privat og erhverv.

Det er et område med stor betydning for både brugere, banker og forretning og med mange spændende tekniske og domænemæssige problemstillinger.

Rollen: Byg robuste services med fokus på både kode, brugere og drift

Som Senior Backend Developer bliver du en del af teamet bag oprettelse af indlandsbetalinger. Du kommer til at udvikle API’er, arbejde med test, vedligeholde eksisterende kode og bidrage til nyudvikling af moderne services i et agilt setup.

Du indgår i en rolle, hvor du både løser opgaver på egen hånd og samarbejder tæt med andre. Du er med til at planlægge og eksekvere opgaver i sprint, bryde større problemstillinger ned i mindre leverancer og skabe fremdrift på en måde, hvor teamet kan følge med, bidrage og bygge videre.

En vigtig del af rollen er at bidrage til høj kvalitet gennem clean code, automatisering af test og drift samt en god forståelse for security, compliance, observability og robusthed. Du er også med til at udvikle teamets arbejde med Domain Driven Design, Event Driven Design og moderne servicearkitektur.

Hvordan succes ser ud efter 6–12 måneder

Efter 6–12 måneder har du opbygget en solid forståelse for betalingsdomænet og kan finde rundt i centrale data, flows og afhængigheder:

Du leverer på udviklingsopgaver og bidrager i refinement, reviews, retrospectives og teamets løbende prioriteringer.
Du hjælper med at omsætte komplekse behov til tekniske løsninger, der kan udvikles, testes og releases sikkert.
Du gør risici, afhængigheder og usikkerheder synlige i tide og bidrager med forslag til, hvordan teamet kan håndtere dem.
Du bidrager også til teamets arbejde med DDD og moderne serviceudvikling – både gennem kode, sparring, reviews og konkrete forbedringsforslag.

Succes handler ikke om at kende alt fra start, men om at lære domænet, dele viden og skabe værdi sammen med teamet.

Teamet: Et engageret fagligt fællesskab, hvor viden deles åbent

Du bliver en del af Domestic Payment Capturing, et team på 14 personer med høj faglighed og dyb domæneviden: en Product Owner, to forretningskonsulenter, ti softwareudviklere og en manager.

Vi arbejder i et agilt setup inspireret af Scrum med to-ugers sprint, daglige standups og faste ceremonier. Hverdagen er præget af tæt samarbejde, åben sparring og en kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, når opgaverne bliver komplekse. Det er helt forventeligt at stille spørgsmål, dele synspunkter og udfordre løsninger på en respektfuld måde – både i hverdagen og i forbindelse med reviews og retrospectives.

Som seniorprofil bidrager du ikke kun med kode, men også med ro, overblik og faglig sparring. Du kommunikerer tekniske emner klart til både udviklere, forretningskolleger og andre interessenter, og du hjælper med at skabe en arbejdsform, hvor flere kan bidrage og løfte nye opgaver.

Teamet har p.t. faste hjemmearbejdsdage tirsdag og fredag og arbejder fleksibelt, når hverdagen kræver det.

Profilen vi søger: Solid backend-erfaring og lyst til at udvikle andre

Du har mindst fem års professionel erfaring som softwareudvikler og en relevant baggrund som eksempelvis datalog, softwareingeniør eller datamatiker.
Du har solid erfaring med Spring Boot eller andet OOP som C#/.NET, Node.js eller lignend.
Du har praktisk erfaring med API-design, test og værktøjer som Postman eller Insomnia.
Du arbejder med CI/CD, automatisering og kvalitet som en naturlig del af udviklingsprocessen.
Derudover ser vi, at du har arbejdet med microservices, observability og drift af services i et komplekst miljø - og måske også haft de første erfaringer med Agentic AI.

Som person er du nysgerrig, omhyggelig og motiveret af at skabe løsninger, der fungerer i praksis. Du trives med at forstå både teknik, brugerbehov og forretningsmæssig kontekst, og du deler gerne din viden, så andre kan bygge videre på den. Du behøver ikke kunne alt på forhånd, men du skal have lyst til at lære, stille gode spørgsmål og bidrage til fælles tekniske valg.

Udviklingsmuligheder: Fordyb dig i komplekse systemer og moderne arkitektur

Rollen giver dig mulighed for at udvikle dig i et komplekst betalingsdomæne med store datamængder, høj samfundsmæssig relevans og tydelige krav til kvalitet, sikkerhed og stabilitet.

Du får mulighed for at tage ansvar for egne services og produkter og fordybe dig fagligt inden for moderne backendudvikling, cloud, eventbaseret arkitektur, DDD, observability og automatisering.

Du får også mulighed for at påvirke teamets tekniske retning og bidrage til best practices i et område med mange nye opgaver og høj ledelsesmæssig opmærksomhed.

Klar til at være med til at forme indlandsbetalinger?

Har du lyst til at bruge din backend-erfaring til at bygge robuste services, dele viden og bidrage til et team, der lykkes sammen, vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Velkommen til Bankdata

Bankdata bygger software til finanssektoren. Vi er næsten 1000 kolleger på holdet, og vi udvikler digitale produkter, platforme og infrastruktur, som ca. hver tredje dansker, 200.000 virksomheder og flere tusinde bankansatte bruger hver dag.

Vi tror på struktureret personlig udvikling, et solidt kollegialt fællesskab og at ambitiøse medarbejdere med fleksible og bæredygtige arbejdsliv præsterer bedre. Bliv klogere på arbejdslivet i Bankdata her
.

Hos Bankdata arbejder vi målrettet med at fremme mangfoldighed og diversitet blandt vores medarbejdere, og vi opfordrer derfor alle uanset kønsidentitet, alder og kulturel baggrund til at søge job hos os.

Bankdata er en af Danmarks vigtigste teknologivirksomheder. Vi går på arbejde for at finde teknologiske svar på finanssektorens forretningsproblemer. For at udvikle og bygge fremtidens digitale bank.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective
Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job Requirements

The Ideal Candidate

Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)
Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems
Golf knowledge or broader sports interest — you don't need to be a pro, but a genuine passion for sports helps!

We Offer

A senior, high-impact role in which you will directly shape Trackman's quality engineering culture and practices
The chance to work with and test the world's leading sports tracking technology, trusted by elite athletes across golf, baseball, and football
A collaborative, cross-functional team with 40+ highly skilled colleagues from more than 35 nationalities
Exposure to cutting-edge technology — radar, computer vision, real-time data, and AI — in a unique product domain
An open, informal, and ambitious company culture where great ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged
Continuous learning and growth opportunities as Trackman scales
Social activities and a vibrant team culture

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
Game Engineer - Tech Pod

SYBO
is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

Hundreds of millions of players play Subway Surfers
each month, and enjoy smooth gameplay, new features and a concept that’s now worked for over fourteen (Yes, 14!) years - and we’re looking for a talented Game Engineer for our Tech Pod
to make sure the game and the technology behind it keeps running.

As a Game Engineer - Tech Pod, you’ll work closely with engineers and other disciplines to develop the systems, integrations, and technical foundations behind Subway Surfers. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continuously improve the game, its technology, and the way we build it.

Nothing’s worse than playing an unstable game. If unstable gaming annoys you, make you'll take enjoyment in making stable games for others. More below!

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain systems, platform capabilities, and SDK integrations that enable us to deliver new features and content for Subway Surfers using Unity, C#, and native code
Collaborate with other Engineers to take technical solutions from concept through implementation and release
Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to the long-term health of the Subway Surfers codebase
Review code and collaborate with other Engineers to share knowledge and maintain engineering quality
Debug and resolve issues across Unity, native platform code, backend integrations, and live systems
Integrate Subway Surfers with SYBO's platform and backend services, bringing shared platform capabilities into the game
Integrate and maintain third-party SDKs and services across iOS and Android
Contribute to improving our CI/CD pipelines, tools, workflows, and development practices, including Jenkins

Life at SYBO

In your first month
, you’ll get to know SYBO, Subway Surfers, our technology, and how the team works. You’ll work closely with the Technical Owner and other Engineers in the Tech Pod, familiarize yourself with the codebase, development and release pipelines, platform integrations, and key technical systems, and start making your first contributions.

In your first three months
, you’ll be contributing independently to systems and integrations and taking an active role in the team’s development process. You’ll work with both SYBO platform services and third-party SDKs, participate in technical discussions around implementation, system design, and architecture, and become increasingly comfortable working across the Subway Surfers technology stack.

In your first twelve months
, you’ll be a trusted and impactful member of the Subway Surfers team, contributing to technical systems and integrations from planning through release. You’ll help shape solutions across the game, platform integrations, and development pipeline that allow us to reliably deliver Subway Surfers to hundreds of millions of players.

Requirements

Strong knowledge of OOP languages, primarily C#
Solid experience developing games in Unity, ideally for mobile
Good understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and common design patterns
Experience writing native code for iOS and Android
Experience working with version control systems such as Git
Experience integrating client applications with backend services and APIs
Experience working in Agile methodologies

Bonus points

Experience with mobile build and release processes for the App Store and Google Play
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins

About SYBO

We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Are you at the beginning of your software development career and motivated to develop reliable solutions that support research and drug development?

Minerva Imaging is seeking a Junior Python Developer with an interest in backend development to join our innovative Digital Solutions and Technology department.
Whether you are newly graduated or have a few years of experience, we offer the opportunity to grow your skills while working with experienced colleagues in a collaborative development team.

About the Role

In this role, you will primarily work with our core internal application for managing and streamlining data capture and reporting across research workflows, and a new initiative using data from this application. You will work closely with the development team on shared solutions while also taking responsibility for smaller, clearly defined development tasks of your own. Together, you will develop new features, improve existing functionality, and help ensure that our applications remain reliable, maintainable, and aligned with real operational needs. You will also collaborate with colleagues across the organization to understand requirements and continuously improve our internal solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain functionality in our internal Python applications as part of the development team.
Collaborate with operations, research and other departments to understand requirements and contribute to practical solutions.
Develop clear, maintainable, and efficient code in Python and Django with guidance from senior colleagues.
Create and maintain documentation for the solutions you help develop.
Participate in testing, troubleshooting, code reviews, and continuous improvement of code quality and development practices.
Use AI-assisted development tools in a structured, secure, compliant, and measurable way.
Contribute actively to the development team by asking questions, sharing knowledge, and learning from feedback.

Qualifications

A completed Datamatiker education, Datatekniker med speciale i programmering education, or a comparable software development education.
Experience with Python from education, an internship, student work, personal projects, or professional employment.
Basic understanding of object-oriented programming, databases, APIs, and version control.
Interest in backend and frontend development and web applications. Experience with Django is an advantage but not a requirement.
A structured and curious approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to learn and ask for help when needed.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Professional communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Django or another web framework.
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Basic experience with SQL and relational databases.
Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTMX, Alpine.js, or modern front-end frameworks.
Familiarity with automated testing, DevOps, or CI/CD.
Experience with AI-assisted software development.
Understanding of secure and compliant AI usage, including traceability and avoidance of data leakage.
Experience within life sciences or regulated environments.
Professional communication skills in Danish, as you will collaborate mostly with Danish-speaking colleagues and users.

On-Site Requirement
This position is on-site, and the successful candidate must be able to participate in on-site interviews and work at the offices in our facility in Ølstykke.

Minerva offers:

We believe in creating an agile working environment, so we have flexible working options including the option of working from home. We care about our employees’ well-being and offer health insurance and a quality conscious lunch scheme and monthly social activities.
We are an informal organization with a strong focus on open and honest communication. We value humour and a natural care for one another.

Application:

Please submit your application to us no later than 31-10-2026. The application must include a motivated cover letter and a CV addressing the listed qualifications. Applications will be evaluated continuously.
If you have questions regarding the position, please contact Jacob Breiting Sönnichsen at jbs@minervaimaging.com

About Minerva Imaging:

Minerva Imaging is a scientifically driven and fully integrated Contract Research Organization (CRO) and Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) specializing in targeted radionuclide therapies.

We support translational research and drug development through the use of advanced preclinical animal models within oncology and cardiovascular diseases, combined with state-of-the-art in vivo molecular imaging. By working in close partnership with our sponsors, we seek to understand their scientific challenges and jointly identify how our expertise, technologies, and methods can deliver robust and meaningful answers.

Our modern facility in Ølstykke, Denmark offers best-in-class, fully integrated radiopharmaceutical research, development, and manufacturing capabilities - covering the entire value chain from early research to clinical supply.

Backed by Nordic Capital since 2026, Minerva Imaging is executing an ambitious growth strategy aimed at strengthening our position as a market leader within targeted radionuclide therapies. This growth journey offers exciting opportunities for individuals who want to contribute to cutting-edge science in a dynamic and international environment.

Minerva Imaging is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of background or experience. In accordance with our recruitment policy, all candidates are required to provide a personal criminal record as part of the hiring process.

Follow us on LinkedIn for the latest news updates or visit www.minervaimaging.com for more information.

Festina Finance develops modern, high‑performance software used by banks and financial institutions across the Nordics and Europe. Our Advisor platform is a 360° financial advisory solution that helps bank and pension advisors guide customers through credit, mortgage, pension, wealth, and investment decisions.
Advisor is designed to be country‑agnostic and is already live in Denmark, with active expansion into the Nordics, EU, and the UK. We are now looking for a skilled Software Developer to help shape the next generation of the platform.

Why This Role Matters

Financial advisors rely on Advisor to deliver precise, compliant, and trustworthy guidance to their customers. The platform must handle complex financial logic, integrate seamlessly with banking systems, and scale across countries, products, and regulatory environments.

As a developer on the Advisor team, you will:
build the financial modelling foundation that powers real advisory conversations
ensure that forecasts, key figures, and recommendations are correct and explainable
design integrations that connect Advisor to the broader banking ecosystem
contribute to a platform used daily by advisors across multiple markets

Your work directly influences how financial decisions are made, from mortgages and pensions to investments and long‑term planning.

jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Plenty of developers have tried an AI agent. Fewer have run several in parallel, built their own tooling to keep them on track, and worked out exactly where they shine and where they still fall over. If you are on top of these things and want to contribute to the build-up of an agentic software organization, we should talk.

Getinge is looking for Senior .NET Developers in Copenhagen. You will be building software that hospitals around the world depend on every day, and you will be helping shape how a large software organization adopts AI. We have several positions open.

What You Would Be Building

Getinge is a global MedTech company, and our teams in Copenhagen, Hamburg and Aarhus build software that runs at the heart of a modern hospital. Our solutions track surgical instruments through sterile reprocessing with full traceability, orchestrate fleets of robots and reprocessing equipment, plan and optimize the surgical day, coordinate patient flow and staff in real time, and keep thousands of connected medical devices running in the field.

Our software is mission-critical, deeply integrated with hospital IT and physical equipment, and built to a high standard of quality. It is also software where the impact is immediate and real: better use of an operating room, an instrument set that arrives on time, a surgery that goes ahead instead of being cancelled. Not everyone gets to end the week knowing their work helped someone get treated.

What We Work With

Our teams work primarily in C#/.Net &Blazor, with focus on containerization and cloud deployment to Azure, across the organization that spans web and mobile applications, cloud services, real-time systems, and integration with physical equipment.

We are not looking for a checklist match for all of it. What matters is that you are strong in .NET, that you are comfortable working across a stack rather than in one corner of it, and that you pick new things up quickly. The exact mix varies by team, and we will find the right fit together.

Where we are with AI

We are currently in the process of accelerating our software factory with AI. Our teams have been exploring AI-assisted and agentic development processes for some time and are implementing our learnings. However, we are seeking additional fresh perspectives on the matter. This is where you come in.

If you have real experience here and strong opinions about what works, you will find both room to use them and colleagues who will argue back.

Our developers have access to the latest models and a meaningful budget for AI tooling and usage, and we are also looking at introducing new and improved methods and tools to improve our way of working.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and maintain robust .NET services and applications for mission-critical hospital software.
Build and integrate agentic AI capabilities – designing, orchestrating, and evaluating AI agents and LLM-driven workflows in our products and in how we work.
Drive AI adoption in your team and across the organization, setting the standard for how modern tooling improves quality, speed, and value delivered.
Contribute to system architecture, code quality, and engineering practices.
Work closely with product owners, architects, UX/UI, and developers across multiple sites.

You will bring

Strong .NET expertise – deep, hands-on experience building and maintaining production software in C# and modern .NET.
Breadth and adaptability – you are happy to work across the stack and into the cloud, and you are not thrown by a technology you have not used before.
Real depth with AI in practice – you use AI tools in your daily work, you are hands-on with agents and LLM-driven workflows, and you can point to things you have actually built with them. We care more about what you have done and how you think about it than about years on a CV.
A proactive, positive, and constructive mindset – you take ownership from start to finish, communicate openly, and make the people around you better.
The ability to build maintainable, high-quality solutions and to work independently as well as in a team.

Nice to have

Experience with hardware–software integration, robotics, or embedded systems.
Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging, or distributed systems.
Experience working in Agile teams on regulated or safety-critical products.

What We Offer

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that improve healthcare quality and efficiency, with the ambition to be the most desired MedTech company in the world. You would join our Digital Health Solutions department, which counts around 165 people across Denmark, Germany, and the UK, plus a further 100 colleagues in Getinge offices globally.

A smart working environment with shared desks, several work-from-home days per week, and a budget for your home office setup.
Flexible working hours.
Competitive benefits including health insurance and pension.
Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
A collaborative, inclusive, and motivating culture.

Application

Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 17-10-2026

We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

About Us 

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

jobs.title: Optical Manufacturing Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Position Overview

As an Optical Manufacturing Automation Engineer
, you will play a critical role in developing and scaling the automation infrastructure that supports the manufacturing of Lumilens’ next-generation silicon photonics and optical transceiver products. This role sits at the intersection of manufacturing, test engineering, software development, and data analytics, with responsibility for designing, deploying, and optimizing automated production systems that improve throughput, yield, quality, and operational efficiency.

You will work closely with manufacturing, process engineering, optical design, quality, and software teams to develop automated test and manufacturing solutions that support both new product introduction (NPI) and high-volume production. The ideal candidate combines hands-on experience with optical manufacturing environments and strong software development capabilities, enabling the creation of robust automation frameworks, equipment integration solutions, manufacturing data systems, and intelligent workflows that accelerate production scale-up and continuous improvement.

Duties/Responsibilities

Develop and implement automation solutions that support optical transceiver, silicon photonics, and advanced packaging manufacturing processes from prototype through high-volume production.
Design, develop, and maintain software applications, automation frameworks, and control systems used for manufacturing equipment, test stations, calibration systems, and process monitoring.
Integrate manufacturing equipment, optical test systems, robotics, motion control platforms, and factory automation tools using standard communication protocols and software interfaces.
Partner with manufacturing, process, and test engineering teams to automate manual production activities, improve cycle time, reduce operator dependency, and enhance process repeatability.
Develop automated workflows for data collection, traceability, process control, and production reporting across manufacturing operations.
Create and maintain software tools that support manufacturing execution, equipment monitoring, yield analysis, statistical process control (SPC), and production performance tracking.
Lead automation efforts supporting new product introduction (NPI), ensuring manufacturing systems, test platforms, and process controls are production-ready at launch.
Collaborate with quality and engineering teams to implement automated validation, calibration, and qualification processes that improve product quality and manufacturing consistency.
Develop dashboards, reporting tools, and analytics solutions that provide visibility into manufacturing performance, equipment utilization, yield trends, and operational bottlenecks.
Ensure all manufacturing automation software follows established quality management system (QMS) requirements, including version control, change management, documentation, validation, and release procedures.
Support troubleshooting and root cause investigations related to manufacturing equipment, automation systems, test stations, and production software.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, factory digitization, throughput optimization, yield improvement, and cost reduction.
Collaborate with software engineers, IT teams, database architects, and manufacturing leaders to define scalable automation architectures that support future manufacturing growth.
Generate technical documentation, operating procedures, validation plans, and training materials supporting manufacturing automation systems.

SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field with 7+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing automation, test automation, or industrial software development.
Experience supporting optical transceiver, silicon photonics, semiconductor, advanced packaging, or high-volume electronics manufacturing environments.
Strong software development experience using Python, C#, C++, LabVIEW, or similar languages for manufacturing automation and equipment integration.
Experience developing software interfaces for manufacturing equipment, automated test systems, robotics, motion control platforms, and production hardware.
Strong understanding of manufacturing automation architectures, industrial communication protocols, and equipment integration methodologies.
Hands-on experience with manufacturing data systems, database development, and production analytics using SQL, NoSQL, or equivalent technologies.
Experience implementing automated data collection, process monitoring, statistical process control (SPC), yield analysis, and reporting solutions.
Familiarity with manufacturing execution systems (MES), ERP systems, factory automation platforms, and production traceability requirements.
Experience with source code management and software lifecycle processes using GitHub, Bitbucket, SVN, or similar version control tools.
Strong understanding of software quality practices including validation, regression testing, release management, bug tracking, and change control.
Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI), manufacturing scale-up, and production ramp activities.
Knowledge of optical manufacturing processes, transceiver assembly, silicon photonics production, automated optical alignment, calibration systems, or high-speed optical testing is highly desirable.
Understanding of quality systems, reliability requirements, and manufacturing compliance standards.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify opportunities for automation and operational improvement.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, rapidly scaling manufacturing environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across global engineering, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams.
International travel may be required.
