jobs.title: AVP/VP, Product Engineer (Developer Acceleration), Technology Group
jobs.description:
About GIC

GIC is one of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world's industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we work at the Point of Impact for Singapore's financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

Technology Group

We experiment, design, and lead a 24×7 global business where we support core capabilities in asset management, trading, investment operations, and risk management. We deliver secure, reliable, and integrated solutions, and provide insights on new and emerging technologies.

Strategy, Architecture, and Transformation Group

The Strategy, Architecture & Transformation (SAT) group shapes and drives GIC’s technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business priorities and enterprise goals. Bringing together expertise in strategy, architecture, engineering, and transformation, the team strengthens governance, promotes consistency, and accelerates delivery across the Technology Group. Through modern practices and close collaboration, SAT leads the development of an architectural strategy that reinforces oversight and accountability while enabling reliable, scalable solutions and informed decision making across the Technology Group and, more broadly, across GIC.

Developer Experience

The Developer Experience team builds and operates the products and platforms that support the developer experience across GIC's Technology Group. The team is organised around three product pillars:

Project Management Tooling — Platforms such as Jira and Confluence that support project tracking, collaboration, and workflow management across the Technology Group.
Cloud Development Environments & IDEs — Cloud-based development environments, AI-assisted coding tools, developer toolchains (CLIs, SDKs, IDE extensions, devcontainer features), and agentic development capabilities.
DevSecOps & CI/CD — CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, security scanning integration, infrastructure-as-code, and secure software delivery tooling.

What impact can you make in this role?

As a Product Engineer responsible for Developer Acceleration, you will build and operate the infrastructure that enables hundreds of employees to be productive through our agentic cloud development platform. By joining this team, you will have a direct impact on the velocity and quality of software engineering at GIC. You will evolve our agentic cloud development platform, shape the next generation of the agentic SDLC, and transform how software is built and delivered across GIC.

You are a platform engineer who is also an AI-native developer: you use coding agents as core engineering tools across specification, design, implementation, testing, and review, while applying sound engineering judgement and remaining accountable for the quality, security, and operability of the software you ship.

What will you do as a Product Engineer (Developer Acceleration)?

You will work across three connected areas: platform and infrastructure engineering, developer tooling and governance, and AI-native development and agent enablement.
Operate and evolve the agentic cloud development platform, covering infrastructure, networking, deployment automation, devcontainer lifecycle, observability, security, and governance.
Address developer needs, resolve platform issues, and build processes and integrations that connect the platform with enterprise development services and systems.
Govern the developer tools estate — evaluate, onboard, secure, and manage the lifecycle of IDEs, extensions, SDKs, CLIs, and AI coding tools through clear guardrails and paved paths.
Drive AI-native development across GIC — establish reusable practices, context engineering, MCP integrations, and reference workflows, and provide clear guidance and enablement to accelerate adoption across teams.
Build and integrate the agentic SDLC platform — develop agent execution and human review workflows that connect project management tools, source control, and CI/CD to enable end-to-end delivery.
Collaborate with infra and security teams to ensure platform capabilities meet requirements for observability, resilience, and compliance.

What makes you a successful candidate?

Experience
6+ years of experience in software, platform, or infrastructure engineering, including hands-on ownership of developer platforms or large-scale distributed systems in production.
2+ years of experience leading complex, cross-team engineering initiatives as an engineer or technical lead.
Strong programming proficiency in one or more of Python, Java, C#/.NET, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
Strong AWS expertise, including EC2, VPC networking, IAM, EKS or ECS, CloudWatch, and S3.
Strong experience with infrastructure as code and automation using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, and GitOps practices.
Deep familiarity with containerised development, including devcontainers, image build pipelines, and dependency management.
Security-first engineering experience covering network segmentation, least-privilege access, and operation in regulated technology environments.
Demonstrated AI-native development practice — hands-on use of coding agents across the software development lifecycle, with the ability to recognise their limitations and validate AI-generated code before release.
Clear technical communication — able to write guidance, run enablement sessions, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Product & Delivery Mindset
Demonstrated ability to think about engineering work through a product lens — understanding users, measuring outcomes, and iterating based on feedback.
Comfortable owning a product backlog and making prioritisation decisions.
Experience working in agile teams with a focus on incremental delivery.

Governance & Ways of Working
Ability to balance developer experience and autonomy with enterprise requirements for security, standardisation, and cost control.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across engineering, platform, and cybersecurity teams.
Comfortable navigating competing priorities and driving alignment.

Personal Attributes
Clear and effective communicator, both written and verbal.
Pragmatic, structured, and outcome-focused.
Consistently demonstrates GIC's PRIME values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit, and Excellence.

Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

Flexibility at GIC

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

GIC is an equal opportunity employer

GIC is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Learn more about our Technology Group here:

https://gic.careers/group/technology-group/
Our PRIME Values

GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

Experiență cu backend (ideal .NET Core, dar nu obligatoriu);

Capacitatea de a lucra pe probleme care nu sunt complet definite;
Interes pentru produs și modul în care este folosit de utilizatori;

Salariu competitiv (în funcție de nivel);

Critical Software Engineering Skills

Python: Critical Requirement. Expert proficiency for AI/LLM tooling, data processing, and scripting agentic or web-based automation workflows (e.g., Playwright, LangChain).
C# .NET: Critical Requirement. Robust experience for building enterprise-grade backend integrations, custom automation solutions, and handling native desktop interactions via FlaUI.
TypeScript: Critical Requirement. Strong proficiency for modern web-based automation with Playwright, cloud functions, and front-end/API orchestration within advanced AI platforms.

Mandatory Database & SQL Competency

PostgreSQL: Mandatory Requirement. Advanced experience in designing, querying, and managing relational databases for transactional logging, configuration, and enterprise scaling.
MS SQL: Mandatory Requirement. Deep proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server, complex queries, indexing, and stored procedures to support backend enterprise systems.

Generative AI & Intelligent Automation

AI Development Tools: Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Anthropic APIs, and open-source AI frameworks to build autonomous systems.
Platform Integration: Proficiency in integrating enterprise environments, WHQ Agents, and Digital Workers with cloud-based AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI).
Data Transformation: Expert knowledge in processing complex, unstructured data (emails, multi-page PDFs, legal documents) using GenAI extraction and advanced OCR tools.
Prompt Engineering: Deep understanding of advanced prompting techniques (Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot, Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and token management.

Core Platform & Framework Infrastructure

UI Automation Libraries: Advanced, hands-on experience with Playwright for high-performance web testing/automation and FlaUI for reliable accessibility-based desktop automation.
Blue Prism Ecosystem: Strong experience with Blue Prism Enterprise v7.x (v7.4 or above preferred) with an emphasis on Control Room management, deployment, and backend API usage rather than traditional client-side studio development.
Queue Architecture: Mastery of Work Queues (Work HQ) configuration, priority tagging, and multi-robot queue consumption models.

Preferred Experience

Vector Databases: Nice-to-have experience with vector storage systems (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector) to implement semantic search and advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns.
Blue Prism Professional Developer Certification.
Experience transitioning traditional RPA architectures into code-first, AI-driven automation ecosystems involving hybrid WHQ Agents and Digital Workers.
Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and LLMOps/DevOps practices.
Understanding of VPC environments (Azure / AWS)

PALMET Bilgi Teknolojileri, yaklaşık 2,5 milyonmüşteriye hizmet veren PALMET Grubu'nun teknoloji motorudur. Doğalgaz dağıtımından enerji üretimine uzanan kritik operasyonları destekleyen kurumsal yazılım ürünleri geliştiririz. Yüksek erişilebilirlik, veri yoğunluklu işlemler ve yapay zekâ entegrasyonu gündemimizin merkezindedir.

Bu rolde katman geliştiren değil; mimari kararlar alan, sistemin bütününü sahiplenen ve ekibin teknik kalitesini yukarı taşıyan bir Senior Fullstack Software Engineer arıyoruz. Altyapı ve DevSecOps süreçleri ayrı bir ekip tarafından yönetilmektedir; bu rol geliştirdiği mikroservislerin doğru containerize edilmesinden, GitLab CI/CD pipeline'ına uyumlu teslim edilmesinden ve platform standartlarına uymaktan sorumludur.

Sorumluluklar

• Kurumsal enerji uygulamalarının uçtan uca (frontend + backend + veritabanı) tasarımı ve geliştirilmesi
• Domain-Driven Design (DDD) prensipleriyle bounded context, aggregate ve domain event modellemesi yapmak
• Microservice mimarisi kapsamında servis sınırlarını belirlemek, servisler arası iletişim (REST / gRPC / message queue) tasarlamak
• RabbitMQ / Kafka gibi mesaj kuyruğu altyapılarıyla event-driven akışlar kurmak ve yönetmek
• Redis / distributed cache stratejileri tasarlamak; cache invalidation ve consistency politikalarını uygulamak
• MinIO / S3-uyumlu nesne depolama entegrasyonu; bucket politikaları, presigned URL ve uygulama katmanı kullanımı
• Entity Framework Core ile ORM katmanı kurmak; migration yönetimi, lazy/eager loading optimizasyonu ve N+1 sorunu çözümü
• MSSQL üzerinde T-SQL, stored procedure ve sorgu optimizasyonu; index stratejisi geliştirmek
• Geliştirdiği servisleri Dockerfile standartlarına uygun containerize etmek; DevOps ekibinin belirlediği GitLab CI/CD pipeline'ına uyumlu çalışmak
• CORS politikalarını uygulama katmanında doğru yapılandırmak; reverse proxy ve API gateway arkasında çalışacak servisleri buna göre tasarlamak
• Load balancer ve reverse proxy önünde çalışacak servislerin stateless, health-check uyumlu ve graceful shutdown destekli geliştirilmesini sağlamak
• Unit / integration test yazımı; code coverage hedeflerini belirlemek ve karşılamak (xUnit, NUnit, Moq)
• RESTful API tasarımı (OpenAPI/Swagger), versiyonlama ve geriye dönük uyumluluk yönetimi
• Yapay zekâ destekli özelliklerin ürünlere entegrasyonu; log analizi, anomali tespiti ve akıllı öneri mekanizmaları geliştirmek
• Code review kültürünü sürdürmek; teknik dokümantasyon ve ADR (Architecture Decision Record) yazmak

Aranan Nitelikler

• Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümden mezun
• En az 5 yıl yazılım geliştirme deneyimi; bunun en az 2 yılı üretim ortamında fullstack projelerde
• Backend: C# / .NET 6+ — DDD, CQRS, Clean Architecture deneyimi
• ORM: Entity Framework Core — migration, performans optimizasyonu, repository pattern
• Frontend: React, Angular veya Vue.js ile üretim ölçekli SPA geliştirme deneyimi
• Mesajlaşma: RabbitMQ veya Kafka ile event-driven / async iletişim deneyimi
• Cache: Redis veya benzeri distributed cache altyapısı kullanımı
• Nesne Depolama: MinIO (S3-uyumlu) — SDK entegrasyonu, bucket yönetimi, presigned URL kullanımı
• Veritabanı: MSSQL / PostgreSQL — T-SQL, stored procedure, index ve sorgu optimizasyonu
• API & Ağ: REST API tasarımı, CORS yönetimi; reverse proxy ve API gateway arkasında çalışacak servis geliştirme
• Test: Unit ve integration test yazımı, code coverage metrikleri takibi
• Containerization: Dockerfile yazımı, image optimizasyonu, multi-stage build
• CI/CD: GitLab CI pipeline'ına uyumlu çalışma; merge request, branch stratejisi, environment değişkeni yönetimi
• Versiyon Kontrol: Git-flow, branch stratejisi, GitLab merge request süreci
• Analitik düşünce yapısı, teknik sahiplenme ve çözüm odaklılık

Tercihen

• gRPC ile servisler arası iletişim deneyimi
• Kubernetes ortamında çalışan servisler geliştirme deneyimi (Helm values, liveness/readiness probe, resource limit tanımları)
• OpenTelemetry ile distributed tracing ve structured logging deneyimi

• Enerji, finans veya telecom gibi regulated / mission-critical sektörlerde proje deneyimi
• Teknik mentorluk veya küçük ekip yönlendirme tecrübesi

Enerji altyapısının dijital omurgasını cloud-native ve event-driven mimarilerle yeniden inşa ederken, yapay zekâ destekli yeni nesil ürünler geliştirmek isteyen mühendisleri ekibimize bekliyoruz.

Yapay zekâyı sadece kullanan değil, onunla birlikte üreten bir stajyer arıyoruz.

Vegasoft, Londra merkezli bir yazılım stüdyosu. B2B müşteriler için yüksek performanslı web platformları, özel yazılım çözümleri ve dönüşüm odaklı e-ticaret sistemleri geliştiriyoruz. Şu anda iki ürünümüzü aynı anda inşa ediyoruz ve ekibimizi büyütüyoruz.

Bu pozisyonda geleneksel anlamda sadece kod yazmayacaksın. Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, v0 gibi araçları kullanarak gerçek projeler üzerinde çalışacak ve ortaya canlıya çıkan ürünler koyacaksın.

Üzerinde çalışacağın ürünler

İki ekipten birinde yer alacaksın:

AI Sesli Asistan — işletmelerin gelen telefonlarını karşılayan, bilgi veren ve rezervasyon alan bir sistem. Konuşma tabanlı yapay zekâ, güncel işletme verisi üzerinden doğru cevap üretme, backend servisleri ve telefon entegrasyonu.

Üretim Operasyon Kulesi — fabrikalar için üretim izleme platformu. Makine ve sensörlerden veri toplama, gerçek zamanlı gösterge ekranları ve arıza daha duruşa yol açmadan tahmin edilmesi.

Ayrıca stajyerlerden biri vegasoft.co.uk sitesinin yeniden yapımını uçtan uca üstlenecek: tasarım, geliştirme, yayına alma. Herkese açık, adının geçtiği ve ileride her işverene gösterebileceğin bir referans işi.

Bu rolde neler yapacaksın

- AI destekli geliştirme süreçleriyle gerçek projeler üzerinde çalışacaksın
- Fikirleri hızlıca prototiplere ve çalışan uygulamalara dönüştüreceksin
- AI'ın ürettiği kodu inceleyecek, test edecek, hatasını bulacak ve sahipleneceksin
- API'ler ve farklı servisler arasında entegrasyonlar geliştireceksin
- Denediğin yeni AI araçlarını ekiple paylaşacaksın
- Ürettiğin çözümün gerçek kullanıcılara ulaşmasını göreceksin

İki teknik parkurdan birini seçebilirsin

Web ve ürün parkuru: React / TypeScript, Node.js veya .NET / C#, REST API, SQL.
Yapay zekâ ve veri parkuru: Python, dil modelleriyle çalışma, güncel veri üzerinden cevap üretme (RAG), veri işleme.

Her ikisinde de uzman olman gerekmiyor. Birinde temel bilgin olması veya öğrenmeye ciddi istekli olman yeterli.

Senden ne bekliyoruz

AI ile üretme alışkanlığı. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot gibi araçları kullanıyor olman ya da öğrenmeye gerçekten istekli olman. Sadece prompt yazmak değil: çıkan sonucu değerlendirebilmen, düzeltebilmen ve ortaya çalışan bir şey koyabilmen. AI'ın yazdığı kod senin sorumluluğundur — "AI böyle yazdı" bir açıklama değildir.

Problem çözme. Karşına çıkan bir problemi araştırmayı, denemeyi ve çözüm üretmeyi sevmen.

Öğrenme isteği. Bilmediğin bir konuya girmekten çekinmemen.

İletişim. Uzaktan çalışan bir ekipte net yazmak ve tıkandığında sormak. Sessizce beklemek burada en pahalı alışkanlık.

Git ve GitHub. Temel seviye yeterli.

İngilizce. Teknik dokümantasyon okuyabilecek seviye.

Artı değer sayılır, zorunlu değil

Docker · GitHub Actions / CI-CD · Next.js · ASP.NET Core · Flutter ile mobil · vektör veritabanları · gömülü sistemler veya endüstriyel haberleşme protokolleri · Figma ile arayüz tasarımı

Bizim için ne önemli

Her şeyi biliyor olmanı beklemiyoruz. Merakın, öğrenme hızın ve bir şeyler üretme isteğin çok daha önemli.

Daha önce yaptığın bir web sitesi, mobil uygulama, GitHub projesi ya da AI ile geliştirdiğin küçük bir çalışma varsa paylaş. Kusursuz bir portfolyo beklemiyoruz; bir şeyler denemiş ve ortaya bir şey çıkarmış olman yeterli.

Sana ne sunuyoruz

- Alıştırma değil, canlıya çıkan ticari ürünler üzerinde gerçek geliştirme işi
- Mühendislik liderimizden kod incelemesi ve teknik mentorluk
- Kendi işini sunduğun haftalık demolar
- Staj sonunda uluslararası geçerliliği olan referans mektubu
- AI-first bir geliştirme kültürünün içinde çalışma imkanı
- Tamamen uzaktan, esnek saatler

Koşullar, açıkça

Bu staj gönüllü ve ücretsizdir. Zorunlu staj başvurularına da açığız. Erken aşama bir stüdyoyuz ve şu an ne sunabildiğimiz konusunda dürüst olmayı tercih ediyoruz: gerçek sorumluluk, gerçek mentorluk ve gösterebileceğin iş. Haftada yaklaşık 15-20 saat ve en az üç ay bekliyoruz. Bu sana uymuyorsa gayet anlayışla karşılarız.

Başvuru

CV'ni ve varsa GitHub hesabını hr@vegasoft.co.uk adresine gönder. İki üç cümleyle hangi ekibe ilgi duyduğunu ve nedenini yaz. AI araçlarını kullanarak bir şey geliştirdiysen bağlantısını ekle.

to join our Information Technology team. The Software Engineer position will work on a team focused on Financial Systems and modernization of aging applications. Strong attention to detail, desire for process ownership, and interest in implementing new technology are highly valued.

To meet our global and innovation demands, Medpace is rapidly growing our software development footprint beyond the US. To support our growth, we are expanding our existing office in Leuven to build our first non-US innovation center. This is an incredible opportunity to join, contribute, and shape a new team, while also being a part of a large, fast-growing organization. Our custom software is a key component to our success. You will be joining an organization where your contribution makes a significant impact in positively impacting people's lives, as new treatments and therapeutics are developed.

Responsibilities

Collect, analyze and document user requirements;
Design, modify, develop and support software applications;
Participate in software validation process through development, review, and/or execution of test plan/cases/scripts;
Create software applications by following software development life-cycle, which includes requirements gathering, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance;
Communicate with team members regarding projects, development, tools, and procedures;
Utilize skills in development areas including object oriented programming (C#), databases (SQL) web applications (ASP.NET);
Potential opportunities to lead software development projects.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science;
At least 2 years of software development experience using technologies such as C#, Angular, Webservices, GraphQL, Git, relational databases;
Experience in Entity Framework, Azure DevOps is advantageous;
Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and software release management;
Prior experience modernizing systems to a cloud-based platform (Azure) is a plus;
Excellent analytical, written and oral communication skills in English.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Office based environment with on-site mentors
Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
Company-sponsored social events

Please note benefits may vary based on country.

What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

jobs.title: Agentic Software Delivery Architect
jobs.description:
Company Description

Inetum is a European leader supporting organizations as they navigate continuous technological change.

With deep industry expertise, a strong innovation culture, and a scalable international model, we help clients transform their operations and generate sustainable impact across business and society.

Guided by European values, we empower local businesses to create positive impact and unlock society’s full potential. This vision drives us to deliver on our promises, attract the best talent, and turn uncertainty into opportunity, building a future where technology unleashes the possibilities within us all.

Job Description

Software engineering is being fundamentally redefined.

Artificial Intelligence is no longer a supporting tool that helps developers write code faster. It is becoming an active participant in how software is designed, built, tested, secured, modernized, deployed and operated.

Organizations that succeed in the coming years will not simply adopt AI tools. They will transform how software delivery works by combining human expertise, intelligent agents, automation and modern engineering practices into a new operating model.

At Inetum Belgium, we are building that future through our Agentic Software Delivery Factory
.

We envision an environment where architects, engineers, AI agents and delivery teams collaborate to accelerate innovation, improve quality, increase predictability and create greater business value. Beyond transforming software delivery, we help organizations design and build the next generation of Agentic and AI-infused applications, combining intelligent agents, enterprise data and modern cloud platforms to deliver adaptive and business-aware solutions.

To help shape this transformation, the Cloud & Application Unit
within our Technology Division is looking for an Agentic Software Delivery Architect
.

This is not a traditional architecture role.

This is a leadership role focused on defining, implementing and scaling AI-enabled software delivery, while architecting the next generation of Agentic and AI-infused applications that combine human expertise, intelligent agents, enterprise data and modern cloud services.

You will help customers and teams navigate one of the biggest technology shifts of our generation and define what software engineering looks like in the age of Agentic AI.

Your Mission

As an Agentic Software Delivery Architect
, your primary mission is to accelerate the adoption of AI-native software engineering and help organizations evolve towards next-generation delivery models.

You will help organizations evolve their software and solution delivery capabilities across the spectrum of AI-assisted, AI-augmented and AI-native engineering
, enabling teams to leverage AI as a true force multiplier throughout the software development lifecycle.

You will act as a bridge between business strategy, engineering excellence, AI innovation and delivery transformation.

You will help define how AI agents, engineering platforms, automation capabilities and human expertise work together throughout the Software Development Lifecycle.

While architecture remains an important part of the role, your impact will be measured by your ability to transform software delivery, drive adoption and create tangible business outcomes through AI-enabled engineering.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You lead by example, working alongside delivery teams, architects and engineers to validate emerging practices, experiment with new AI capabilities and turn innovation into scalable delivery outcomes. You operate at the frontline of AI innovation, continuously exploring how Agentic AI can reshape the way software is designed, built, tested and operated.

You will not simply design solutions.

You will design the future of software delivery itself.

What You Will Do

AI & Agentic Software Delivery Leadership

Drive the evolution of our Agentic Software Delivery Factory.
Define and promote AI-native software delivery practices.
Identify opportunities where AI agents can augment engineering teams and delivery processes.
Establish reusable frameworks, methodologies and patterns for AI-enabled delivery.
Help delivery teams operationalize AI throughout the Software Development Lifecycle.
Drive measurable improvements in productivity, quality, predictability and customer outcomes.
Promote responsible, secure and governed use of AI.

Software Delivery Transformation

Help customers redefine their software delivery operating models.
Guide organizations through AI adoption and engineering transformation journeys.
Identify opportunities to optimize delivery processes using automation and intelligent agents.
Support the implementation of modern engineering practices and platform-based delivery models.
Help organizations move from traditional software development approaches towards AI-assisted and AI-native engineering.

Architecture & Modernization

Design modern solution architectures that enable AI-enabled delivery and business innovation.
Guide application modernization initiatives leveraging cloud, automation and AI.
Support architecture decisions across cloud-native, distributed and enterprise platforms.
Define scalable, secure and maintainable technology landscapes.
Ensure architectural decisions support long-term business objectives and delivery efficiency.

AI Strategy & Innovation

Track emerging developments in AI, Agentic Systems and software engineering.
Translate innovation into practical customer solutions.
Experiment with new approaches that improve engineering effectiveness.
Contribute to the creation of new services, offerings and differentiators around AI-enabled delivery.
Support strategic initiatives that position Inetum as a leader in AI-driven software engineering.

Customer Advisory & Pre-Sales

Act as a trusted advisor to customers and stakeholders.
Facilitate workshops on AI adoption, delivery transformation and modernization.
Help customers understand the impact of Agentic AI on software delivery organizations.
Shape solution approaches and transformation roadmaps.
Support pre-sales activities and contribute to winning new business opportunities.
Translate technical capabilities into measurable business value.

Community & Thought Leadership

Lead knowledge-sharing initiatives across engineering communities.
Mentor architects, engineers and technical leaders.
Create reusable assets, accelerators and best practices.
Promote a culture of experimentation, learning and innovation.
Represent Inetum in customer engagements, industry events and technical communities.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for technology leaders who understand that software engineering is entering a new era.

You do not need to have all the answers.

But you should be excited by the opportunity to help shape them.

Essential Experience

Proven experience as a Software Architect, Technical Leader, Engineering Lead, Transformation Consultant or Senior Technology Advisor.
Strong understanding of modern software engineering and software delivery practices.
Experience with cloud-native platforms, DevOps, CI/CD and automation.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical transformation initiatives.
Strong stakeholder management and customer-facing skills.
Ability to connect technology decisions with business outcomes.
Experience driving change across teams, departments or organizations.
Strong communication, workshop facilitation and advisory capabilities.
Passion for innovation and continuous learning.

AI-Focused Capabilities

Strong interest in AI-enabled software engineering and Agentic AI.
Understanding of how AI can transform software delivery and engineering organizations.
Experience with GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted development tools or software engineering automation platforms.
Ability to identify practical opportunities for AI adoption.
Understanding of responsible AI, governance, security and risk considerations.
Ability to guide organizations through the people, process and technology aspects of AI transformation.
Curiosity regarding emerging AI capabilities and future engineering practices.

Experience In One Or More Of The Following Areas

Microsoft Azure and .NET ecosystems.
Java and cloud-native platforms.
Integration and API platforms.
Event-driven architecture and distributed systems.
Platform engineering.
Application modernization.
Software Quality Engineering.
DevOps and DevSecOps practices.
Cloud transformation programs.

What Makes You Successful

You see beyond today's software delivery practices.

You understand that the future is not about replacing people with AI.

It is about creating high-performing engineering systems where people and intelligent agents collaborate effectively.

You

Think strategically while remaining hands-on.
Are comfortable leading change and challenging established ways of working.
Inspire teams to embrace innovation.
Balance experimentation with governance and business value.
Translate emerging technologies into practical outcomes.
Build trust with customers and stakeholders.
Focus on measurable impact rather than technology for technology's sake.
Continuously explore new possibilities and share what you learn.

Most importantly, you are passionate about shaping the future of software engineering.

Additional Information

Why Join Us?

You will help shape some of the most important transformations for our customers.

The transition from traditional organizations toward modern enterprises where people, data and AI work together to create value.

You Will Work At The Intersection Of

Business Transformation
Product Innovation
Digital Strategy
Artificial Intelligence
Modern Operating Models
Human-AI Collaboration
Customer Experience
Software Delivery and Technology

Most importantly, you will help organizations create meaningful business outcomes by combining the best of human expertise, proven delivery practices, and emerging technologies.

Technology is not the destination. Value is.

And your role will be to help customers get there.

Je komt terecht in een tweetalige IT-omgeving waar agile wordt gewerkt volgens de scrummethodologie. In deze combinatiefunctie combineer je de rol van Test Coördinator (30%) met die van Test Analist (70%) binnen een multidisciplinair scrumteam.

Als Test Coördinator organiseer en volg je de testactiviteiten op om kwaliteitsvolle software op te leveren die aansluit bij de behoeften van de business. Je stemt de testaanpak en planning af met testers, ontwikkelaars, analisten en business stakeholders.

Je bouwt inzicht op in de technische context en de functionele noden om een doeltreffende teststrategie en testaanpak uit te werken.

Je stemt end-to-end testactiviteiten en business acceptatietesten af met betrokken stakeholders.
Je neemt initiatief om repetitieve testen te automatiseren en documenteert de gebruikte principes, tools en werkwijze.
Je rapporteert helder over de voortgang van de testactiviteiten en over de kwaliteit van de opgeleverde ontwikkelingen.
Je geeft dagelijks richting aan 1 à 2 testers binnen het team.

Als Test Analist sta je in voor het voorbereiden, uitvoeren en opvolgen van testen om kwalitatieve software op te leveren.

Je analyseert de technische omgeving en functionele vereisten grondig.
Je stelt testscenario's en testcases op voor interne ICT-testen en end-to-end tests met gebruikers.
Je bereidt testdata voor en voert functionele en niet-functionele testen uit, zoals performantiegerichte testen.
Je coördineert en ondersteunt acceptatietesten en begeleidt gebruikers tijdens dit proces.
Je analyseert, documenteert en rapporteert testresultaten efficiënt aan business analisten en developers.
Je volgt correcties op met de betrokken partijen.
Je werkt met API-testing voor SOAP- en REST-API's en zet waar mogelijk geautomatiseerde testen op.
Je gebruikt tools zoals SoapUI, ReadyAPI, Postman of gelijkaardige oplossingen.
Je werkt met complexe query's in SQL, XML en JSON.
Je werkt in Azure DevOps binnen een agile/scrumcontext.

Je hebt ervaring als test analist (5 jaar) en als test coördinator (3 jaar).

This includes building custom applications (canvas and model-driven apps), automating workflows, and creating insightful dashboards that meet customer requirements.
Integration & Innovation: You will integrate Power Platform solutions with Microsoft 365 services (like SharePoint Online, Teams) and external systems or APIs. You ensure data flows securely between systems using tools like Azure Logic Apps or custom connectors. You stay up to date on the latest features (e.g. Microsoft Dataverse, AI Builder, Copilot) and leverage them to provide innovative, AI-enabled capabilities to the business.
Governance & Best Practices: You will establish and enforce best practices for Power Platform usage across the organization. This includes setting up proper ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) using Azure DevOps, maintaining environment strategies, managing security roles and permissions (using Azure AD/Microsoft Entra ID), and ensuring solutions comply with data governance policies (Microsoft Purview/data loss prevention). You act as a Center of Excellence leader, implementing governance guardrails and guidelines for citizen developers and pro developers alike.
Collaboration & Requirements Gathering: You will work closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and users to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical specifications. You provide expert guidance and feasibility assessments, ensuring the proposed solutions align with business goals and IT standards. Throughout projects, you collaborate with other technical teams (developers, cloud engineers, etc.) to ensure seamless integration and deployment of solutions.
Project Leadership: You will lead the technical delivery of Power Platform projects, overseeing the complete project lifecycle from design and development to testing, deployment, and support. You coordinate with project managers to meet quality, timing, and budget requirements. You also mentor and support development teams, conducting code reviews or solution reviews to ensure maintainability and performance.
User Enablement & Support: You will champion user adoption of Power Platform solutions. This involves preparing training sessions or demo workshops to empower end-users and citizen developers. You provide tier-3 support and expert troubleshooting for the solutions you architect, and guide the team in debugging and resolving complex issues.
Continuous Improvement: Together with your team, you drive continuous improvement. You monitor solution performance and user feedback to identify enhancements. You keep abreast of evolving Power Platform capabilities and industry best practices, proactively introducing improvements to keep the digital solutions landscape modern and efficient.
Required Skills & Knowledge: Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven) – Power Automate – Power BI – Power Pages – Dataverse – Microsoft 365 integration (SharePoint, Teams) – Azure (Logic Apps, Functions, DevOps) – Azure AD (Entra ID) – Microsoft Graph API & REST APIs – Low-Code Architecture & Governance – Agile/Scrum Methodologies

Your profile

Work Experience: You have a strong background with a minimum of 5 years of experience in designing and building solutions on Microsoft Power Platform and related Microsoft technologies. You’ve played a lead role in multiple Power Platform implementations, developing both canvas and model-driven apps and automating processes with flows.
Technical Expertise: You possess deep knowledge of the Power Platform components and architecture. You are skilled in data modeling with Dataverse and integrating Power Apps/Automate with other systems and databases. Experience with Azure services (such as Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus) and Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams) is essential to build scalable enterprise solutions.
Solution Architecture: You think in terms of end-to-end architecture. You can design sustainable, secure, and scalable solutions, considering aspects like identity management, access control, and performance. You are comfortable defining technical architectures that incorporate custom connectors, API integrations (including Microsoft Graph), and have a good understanding of application lifecycle management for Power Platform solutions.
Governance & Strategy: You have hands-on experience with Power Platform governance and best practices. Perhaps you have helped establish a Center of Excellence or implemented governance frameworks (environments strategy, DLP policies, monitoring). You understand the importance of compliance and have utilized tools or practices to ensure data is properly managed and secured in Power Platform implementations.
Problem-Solving & Innovation: You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You can quickly diagnose issues in solutions and are adept at debugging technical problems. You are also innovative and curious – always exploring new features (for example, Power Platform AI capabilities or Copilot) and figuring out how they can benefit your solutions.
Communication & Leadership: You are a confident communicator who can translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly language. You excel at collaborating with cross-functional teams and can coordinate between business stakeholders and development teams. Your leadership skills allow you to mentor junior developers or citizen developers, fostering best practices and elevating the overall team capability.

Regular

1. Présentation de l’ETNIC

L’ETNIC (Entreprise pour les Technologies de l’Information et de la Communication) est l’opérateur informatique de la Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles. Organisme d’intérêt public, l’ETNIC a pour mission de concevoir, développer, maintenir et faire évoluer les systèmes d’information et les infrastructures technologiques au service des administrations et établissements de la FWB.

Acteur central de la transformation numérique du secteur public francophone belge, l’ETNIC intervient dans des domaines variés tels que :

La gestion des infrastructures IT (réseaux, sécurité, data centers, cloud),
Le développement d’applications métiers sur mesure,
L’accompagnement des projets digitaux (analyse fonctionnelle, UX/UI, gestion de projet),
La cybersécurité et la protection des données,
Le support utilisateurs et la formation.

Dans un souci constant d’innovation, de performance et de service public, l’ETNIC collabore régulièrement avec des partenaires externes pour renforcer ses équipes à travers des missions de consultance IT. Ces collaborations s’inscrivent dans un cadre éthique, professionnel et orienté vers la qualité et l’impact concret des solutions livrées

2. Mission

Dans le cadre du programme ZEPHYR de l’Office de la Naissance et de l’Enfance (ONE)
, la mission d’Application Architect / Leader Technique couvre de nombreux aspects tels que l’élaboration de propositions d'architecture applicative, le développement, l'expertise technique, l'identification de solutions pour l’implémentation de systèmes complexes.

En tant qu’Application Architect / Leader technique, vous êtes responsable de l’implémentation de la solution, de la qualité du code et de la cohérence technique, des performances et des livraisons du produit. En tant que responsable du développement des applications, vous travaillez en collaboration avec les analystes fonctionnels et métiers, les testeurs, le chef de projet et les spécialistes du middleware afin de mener à bien les implémentations. Vous êtes responsable de la qualité du livrable et de la diffusion des bonnes pratiques en matière de design et de développement.

Les projets du programme ZEPHYR :

DOMES V2

Ce projet s’inscrit dans le domaine de l’accompagnement des enfants de 0 à 6 ans. Il vise à permettre aux professionnels de l’ONE de gérer le dossier de l’enfant, de l’éditer, de créer des consultations et de planifier les rendez-vous dans l’Agenda en lien avec le suivi de l’enfant.

Prénatal V1

Dans le cadre de l’accueil et du suivi médico-social de la future mère, Prénatal V1
vise à digitaliser le dossier social de la future mère
. La solution permet de soutenir les professionnels de l’ONE dans le suivi et l’accompagnement social des futures mères, tout au long de leur parcours au sein des services concernés.

e-VAX 2.0

Le projet e-VAX 2.0 vise à remplacer l’actuelle solution e-VAX CCR et à moderniser la gestion des données de vaccination. Il permettra notamment d’améliorer la collecte et l’échange des données vaccinales, de mettre en place une carte de vaccination transversale
et de renforcer le suivi de la chaîne d’approvisionnement des vaccins. La solution contribuera également au pilotage du programme de vaccination grâce à l’exploitation des données et à des fonctionnalités d’aide à la décision.

La mission s’inscrit dans un environnement Agile / SCRUM, avec une architecture orientée services et un environnement technique principalement basé sur Java et Angular.

Le stack technologique repose sur : Angular 21, JAVA8 / JEE7, Java 21, Sprint Boot, NgRx, DB2, MySQL, Flyway, …

Les outils de build sont : Apache Maven, Git/GitLab CI/CD, Nexus.

3. Activités

Conception

Créer et mettre à jour le document d’architecture logicielle.
Elaborer la conception et l’analyse technique sur base du dossier fonctionnel.
Elaborer et faire appliquer les bonnes pratiques de développement : clean code, principes SOLID, DRY, ….

Réalisation

Collaborer en tant qu’expert technique, avec son équipe de développeurs.
Développer des modules applicatifs.
Optimiser le code en fonction de la gestion mémoire et des temps réponse.
Organiser le refactoring en simplifiant le code existant.
Organiser les revues de code.
Valider le développement et les tests unitaires.
Réaliser la maintenance corrective et évolutive.

Déploiement

Valider le déploiement et la livraison de la solution.
Veiller au bon comportement de l’application dans les différents environnements d’exécution.

Qualité

Veiller à la qualité des développements réalisés par l’équipe en lien avec les standards d’entreprise.
Appliquer et vérifier l’application des standards méthodologiques et technologiques définis par l’ETNIC.
Veiller au respect des délais.
Adopter les bonnes pratiques de réduction de la dette technologique (clean code, upgrade de librairies, frameworks…)
Assurer du coaching, du mentorat envers l’équipe de développeurs sous sa responsabilité technologique.

Communication

Communiquer avec les différents intervenants de la réalisation des lots de travaux et de donner un feedback régulier à son team leader sur les activités qui lui sont assignées.
Assister le team leader dans la qualification et l’évaluation des lots de travaux.

En tant que consultant, vous êtes soumis aux mêmes conditions de travail que notre personnel interne, soit un mode hybride alliant présentiel et télétravail, avec un minimum obligatoire de 50 % de présence dans nos bureaux.

La mission est en français exclusivement.

Actuellement, ces informations sont gérées manuellement dans un fichier Excel. L’Access Check Tool doit remplacer ce fichier par une interface web claire, structurée et facile à utiliser.

L’outil offrira une vue d’ensemble des accès de l’équipe et facilitera leur suivi lors de l’arrivée d’un collaborateur, d’un changement d’équipe ou de rôle, d’une revue périodique des accès et d’un départ.

Permettre la recherche et le filtrage des informations par collaborateur, équipe, outil ou type d’accès.
Prévoir l’ajout, la modification et la désactivation de collaborateurs ainsi que la mise à jour manuelle de leurs accès.

Dafür suchen wir eine verantwortungsbewusste Person mit viel Drive, technischer Neugier, Empathie und starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – jemanden, der ein neues Team formen, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit motivierten Engineers eine klare Produktvision in wirksame Lösungen übersetzen möchte.

Deine Anforderungen

Mit der Führung des Teams übernimmst du die Verantwortung für eine erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit sowie die Weiterentwicklung der Produkte
Einen wesentlichen Teil deiner Zeit arbeitest du hands-on mit, entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team skalierbare Features und wirkst bei architektonischen Entscheidungen mit. Dabei sorgst du für eine gemeinsame technische und fachliche Ausrichtung im Team
Gemeinsam mit deinem Team setzt du Verhaltensdaten und Machine-Learning-Modelle sinnvoll ein. Damit entwickelt ihr Lösungen, die über klassische regelbasierte Ansätze hinausgehen und eine weitgehend automatisierte, personalisierte Ausspielung von Inhalten ermöglichen
Als Sparringpartner für Product Owner, UX Designer, Data Analysts, Data Scientists und Software-Architekten erklärst du technische Themen so, dass sie auch ausserhalb des Engineerings verständlich sind
Themen treibst du im Team und darüber hinaus voran, hältst Stakeholder auf dem Laufenden und machst die Erfolge deines Teams sichtbar. Als Bindeglied zum Head of Engineering trägst du Entscheidungen zurück ins Team
Die fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung deiner Teammitglieder liegt in deiner Verantwortung
Als verlässliche Führungskraft befähigst du dein Team, selbst Entscheidungen zu treffen, nimmst seine Anliegen ernst und schaffst ein motivierendes und positives Umfeld

KI-gestützte Entwicklung mit Claude Code, Agents und Skills gehört zu deinem Arbeitsalltag – von der Analyse über die Implementierung bis zum Testing. Dabei setzt du diese Tools reflektiert und verantwortungsvoll ein und prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch

Dein Interesse gilt dem Produkt und seiner Weiterentwicklung. Du orientierst dich an der Wirkung eurer Arbeit und hinterfragst den konkreten Nutzen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden
Positive Ausstrahlung, natürliche Motivationsfähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, Teams zu inspirieren sowie ein Umfeld psychologischer Sicherheit zu schaffen

Als Teil der V-ZUG Familie profitierst du von zeitgemässen Anstellungsbedingungen, vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, geeigneter Infrastruktur sowie zahlreichen Angeboten und Dienstleistungen für dein persönliches Wohlbefinden.

Du arbeitest dort, wo die Perfektion unserer Produkte tagtäglich spürbar ist – von der Produktentwicklung über die Produktion bis hin zum Vertrieb. Zudem profitierst du von der direkten Verkehrsanbindung für Bus, Bahn und Auto, einem Mobilitätsbeitrag und vergünstigten Parkplätzen. Auch das Vergnügen kommt nicht zu kurz: So geniesst du im eigenen Personalrestaurant ausgewogene Menüs oder entspannst bei einer Massage im Sitzen, beides zu vergünstigten Preisen.

Wir fördern dein Wohlbefinden und deinen optimalen Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Freizeit. Innerhalb regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen und entsprechend den Anforderungen der Arbeitsaufgaben hast du als Mitarbeiter:in der V-ZUG grösstmögliche Flexibilität. Egal, ob im Teilzeitmodell, Homeoffice oder Jobsharing – du arbeitest wann, wo und wie du am produktivsten bist.

Deine individuelle Entwicklung ist uns wichtig. Wir helfen dir dabei, deine Karriere durch kontinuierliche Aus- und Weiterbildungen, inspirierende Mentorinnen und Mentoren und eine Vielzahl an geeigneten Lernressourcen zu perfektionieren. Weiter bestehen zahlreiche Aktivitäten für ein unfallfreies und gesundes Arbeitsumfeld. So bleibst du als Profi rundum fit – heute und morgen.

Wir leben durchs Band den Grundsatz der Gleichstellung. Neben einer marktgerechten und fairen Entlöhnung trumpfen wir mit überdurchschnittlichen Sozialleistungen. Da wir auf einen Koordinationsabzug verzichten, profitieren auch Mitarbeitende mit Teilzeitarbeit von unserer Vorsorgelösung.

Eine weitere Selbstverständlichkeit ist für uns die vergünstigte Abgabe von V-ZUG Produkten an dich und deine Familienangehörigen.

Ausserdem stehen dir für deinen aktiven Ausgleich zur Arbeit vielfältige und attraktive Freizeitangebote zur Verfügung, bei welchen du von mehreren Vergünstigungen profitierst.

Bei V-ZUG hast du die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft eines traditionsreichen Unternehmens voranzutreiben. Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dein volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Gemeinsam leisten wir täglich einen Beitrag für unsere Vision „Wir bringen Leichtigkeit in Ihr Zuhause und Kreativität in Ihre Küche“. Darauf sind wir stolz.

Wir stehen für eine bunte V-ZUG ein, indem wir Rahmenbedingungen schaffen, um von der existierenden Diversität im Unternehmen gegenseitig profitieren zu können. Was uns alle verbindet, ist der Teamgeist und die Passion für die Marke V-ZUG. Wir arbeiten eng und kollaborativ zusammen, vertrauen uns gegenseitig und begegnen unseren Mitmenschen mit Respekt und Interesse. Wir akzeptieren keinerlei Diskriminierung und sind überzeugt: Inklusion und Diversität machen unser Unternehmen stark und attraktiv. Jeder Einzelne und jede Einzelne trägt dazu bei, das „wir“ voranzubringen.

Solche Initiativen sind nicht zuletzt eine hervorragende Gelegenheit für unsere Mitarbeitenden, eigene Anregungen für mehr Nachhaltigkeit bei V-ZUG einzubringen.

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. . You do not hesitate to prototype, demo, and build in order to accelerate delivery of products for your end users.

You thrive in environments where you can collaborate with scientists, product managers, and engineers
to transform complex scientific data into actionable outcomes. Your ability to engage with scientists and business leaders alike makes you a key player in maximizing the value of scientific data.

With rich experience applying cutting edge data methodologies to the biopharma R&D domain, you bridge understanding between present-day pain points and generalizable solutions.

You are an insatiable learner
, with a track record of deeply learning new tools, methods, and domains.

You fundamentally embody the principles of extreme ownership and have a demonstrated history of building extensible data models and applications for Biopharma end users to maximize value from their data via analysis and integration with AI/ML.

This role will require extreme self-discipline and determination as we forge a category that will fundamentally and forever change the life science industry.

PhD with +4 years or Masters with +8 years of industry experience in life sciences with extensive domain knowledge in drug discovery (target ID through lead optimization), preclinical development, CMC (all drug modalities), or product quality testing
Proven track record of defining, designing, prototyping, and implementing productized AI/ML-driven use cases in cloud environments

Rapidly learn new technologies (e.g., new AWS services or scientific analysis applications) to develop and troubleshoot use cases

jobs.title: Application Performance Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
triscon ist ein Expertenteam für Last- und Performancetesting sowie Monitoring und Observability. Seit 2018 sorgen wir dafür, dass die Software unserer Kunden nicht nur funktioniert, sondern auch unter Hochlast schnell, skalierbar und zuverlässig bleibt.

Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt in der Beratung und Umsetzung von Lasttests bzw. Performancetests (Load Testing). Aus unserer Sicht ist Erfahrung im Bereich der Softwareentwicklung eine Grundvoraussetzung, um in dieser Expertenrolle erfolgreich zu sein.

Zu deinen Aufgabenbereichen zählen…

die Planung, das Design und die Durchführung von Last- und Performancetests.
das Finden von Bottlenecks und bei Bedarf ebenfalls Unterstützung in der Ursachenanalyse z.B. durch Code-Analysen.
die zielgruppenadäquate Aufbereitung und Kommunikation der Testergebnisse (fachlich für Management, technisch für Entwicklungsteams).
die Unterstützung und Beratung von Performancetest-Teams bei Kunden vor Ort und remote.
die Durchführung von Tool-Schulungen und Workshops beim Kunden, nachdem du erfolgreich eine Trainer-Zertifizierung erlangt hast.
die Automatisierung von Tests mit Selenium zur automatischen Erstellung und Wartung von Lasttest-Skripten.

Wonach suchen wir? Du…

hast mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung bzw. im Performance Testing (z.B. mit Java, C# / .NET, Python oder JavaScript / TypeScript).
hast Spaß an technischen Herausforderungen und wirst gerne mit den unterschiedlichsten Technologien konfrontiert.
bist kommunikativ und arbeitest gerne in einem eingespielten Expertenteam.
bist beruflichen Reisen im DACH-Raum grundsätzlich nicht abgeneigt.
würdest es toll finden, ein geschätzter Experte bzw. eine geschätzte Expertin im Bereich Performance Engineering zu werden.
legst Wert darauf, strukturiert vorzugehen, und behältst leicht den Überblick.
hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Was bringst du im Idealfall bereits mit? Du hast bereits Erfahrung…

mit Tools zur Durchführung von Last- und Performancetests (z.B. NeoLoad, JMeter, LoadRunner, k6, etc.).
im Bereich Application Performance Monitoring bzw. Observability (z.B. Dynatrace, Datadog, New Relic, Grafana / OpenTelemetry).
im Bereich der Testautomatisierung (z.B. Selenium WebDriver).
mit Cloud- und Container-Technologien wie Kubernetes, AWS oder Azure sowie mit Microservice-Architekturen.

Warum dieser Job Spaß macht…

Bei uns wird es nie langweilig.
Du bekommst laufend Unterstützung in deiner Weiterentwicklung von einem erfahrenen Expertenteam.
Die Zielapplikationen ändern sich ständig und somit kommst du in kürzester Zeit mit den unterschiedlichsten Technologien in Berührung.
Die Haupttätigkeit liegt zwar in der Beratung bei Lasttests, deinen Weiterbildungsweg – inklusive Herstellerzertifizierungen, z.B. im Dynatrace-Umfeld – kannst du jedoch maßgeblich mitentscheiden.

jobs.title: Senior Product Software Engineer - AI Native
jobs.description:
Join us at Wolters Kluwer and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day. We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most.

We are currently looking for a Senior Product Software Engineer -
AI Native
to join our team.

About the Role:

The Senior Product Software Engineer (AI Native) will own software solutions from discovery through production, translating customer and business needs into secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable software products. Takes ambiguous team-level problems and works across stakeholders to define requirements, shape solution approaches, coordinate dependencies, and deliver successful outcomes. Exercises sound engineering judgment and uses approved AI-assisted development and automation tools where appropriate, while remaining accountable for the quality, correctness, security, and operational readiness of all work approved or released. Serves as a technical resource within the team and helps strengthen the capability of less experienced engineers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

End-to-End Solution Ownership: Own software solutions from discovery through production, translating customer, business, and technical requirements into sustainable outcomes.
Problem Definition and Solution Design: Analyze ambiguous requirements, clarify objectives, evaluate alternatives, and determine solution strategies.
Software Development: Design, develop, test, implement, maintain, and improve software applications, services, and platforms using direct and approved AI-assisted approaches.
AI-Assisted Engineering: Apply approved AI-assisted techniques while validating outputs and maintaining accountability for architecture, quality, security, and operational readiness.
Specification Development: Document requirements, design approaches, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and implementation considerations.
Verification and Validation: Determine and execute testing and verification approaches based on complexity, risk, and business impact.
Technical Guidance: Provide technical guidance through design reviews, code reviews, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and engineering best practices.
Troubleshooting and Production Support: Diagnose and resolve cross-component, production, and system-level issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Security and Compliance: Apply security, privacy, compliance, and data-protection requirements throughout the lifecycle.
Product and Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with product, design, architecture, operations, security, and business stakeholders to shape solutions.
Performance and Reliability Improvement: Improve performance, scalability, reliability, resiliency, and maintainability while reducing operational risk.
Continuous Improvement: Improve engineering processes, delivery effectiveness, and team capability through automation, standardization, and knowledge sharing.
Customer and Business Awareness: Consider customer impact, product strategy, operational implications, and business outcomes in technical decisions.

AI-Native Engineering Accountability:

Applies specification-driven and evaluation-driven approaches to ambiguous work. Provides context, constraints, and evaluation criteria, validates generated output, and coaches others on appropriate responsible use.

Verification and Quality Accountability:

Every engineer remains accountable for the work approved or released, regardless of whether the work was produced directly or with approved AI assistance. AI-generated output remains unverified input until it has been reviewed and validated through practices appropriate to the associated risk.

Determine the testing and validation needed within the assigned area.
Ensure solutions meet quality, reliability, security, compliance, and operational expectations.
Define and evaluate acceptance criteria.
Produce appropriate evidence of readiness for production use.
Identify, manage, and escalate technical risks.

Job Qualifications:

Education (Required): Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
Work Experience (Required): 4-6 years of relevant experience in product software engineering.

Skills:

Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test software, and resolve software-related issues.
Software Development: The ability to produce working software that meets its requirements, whether by writing it, directing approved tools that generate it, or reviewing and taking accountability for contributed work. Includes designing, testing, implementing, and the ability to read, trace, and diagnose code regardless of who or what produced it.
Programming: Ability to build software that achieves intended outcomes by writing code, directing approved code-generation tools, or both. Includes the ability to interpret specifications, apply specification-driven development (SDD) practices, and read, trace, test, debug, and improve code regardless of its origin.
Specification Driven Development: The ability to translate customer needs, business objectives, and product intent into clear, structured, and testable specifications that guide design, engineering, validation, and delivery. Uses specifications as the primary mechanism to align stakeholders, reduce ambiguity, enable AI-assisted development, and ensure solutions deliver the intended customer and business outcomes.
Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and choosing and implementing the most effective course of action.
Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them into smaller parts, and understand how the parts work together.
Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality.
Agile: The ability to respond to change swiftly and effectively, with emphasis on continuous improvement, adaptive planning, and flexibility.
Version Control: The ability to work effectively in a shared codebase using branching, review, and merge practices. Includes writing reviewable changes, reviewing others’ work, maintaining a clean history, and using the repository as a record of why a system is the way it is.
Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate relational databases, including proficiency in SQL, database management systems, and database design principles.
APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage application programming interfaces, including documentation, security, and testing practices that enable software systems to communicate.
Design: The ability to structure software so it is understandable, changeable, secure, operable, and fit for the problem. Includes decomposing systems, defining interfaces and contracts, selecting appropriate patterns, and designing for testability.
Framework: The ability to understand, use, design, and develop complex structures and systems in programming and related engineering contexts.
Documentation: The ability to create, organize, maintain, and communicate technical information so it is current, accessible, and useful.
Application Security Principles: The ability to apply application security controls that prevent, detect, and respond to vulnerabilities, including secure coding, access control, authentication, and security testing.
Advanced Technology Adoption and Utilization: Applies specification-driven and evaluation-driven approaches to ambiguous work. Provides context, constraints, and evaluation criteria, validates generated output, and coaches others on appropriate responsible use.

Competencies:

Ownership Mindset: Acts like an owner, takes accountability for outcomes beyond formal role boundaries, and creates disproportionate business value while respecting security, regulatory, financial, and delegated decision-making controls.
Organizational Velocity: Increases speed by removing friction, simplifying decisions, and accelerating execution.
Technical Innovation & Leverage: Creates innovative solutions whose impact far exceeds the effort required to build them.
Engineering Leverage: Improves engineering productivity through tools, platforms, frameworks, and automation.
AI-Native Thinking: Reimagines work and business models through AI-first thinking.
Learning Velocity: Rapidly acquires and applies new capabilities ahead of business needs.
Constructive Disruption: Improves outcomes by challenging assumptions with evidence, pragmatism, and low ego.
Product & Market Instinct: Balances technology decisions with customer, market, and business realities.
Talent Multiplier: Raises standards, attracts talent, develops future leaders, and builds excellence cultures.
Enterprise Mindset: Optimizes for enterprise outcomes rather than local team wins.
Strategic Judgment: Makes high-quality prioritization decisions, especially what not to pursue.
Courage to Take Smart Risks: Balances potential risk with impact, encourages thoughtful experimentation, and facilitates learning from responsible risk-taking.
Inclusive Collaboration: Models inclusion and collaboration by involving team members in decision making, respecting colleagues, and partnering across organizational boundaries.
Inspiration & Alignment: Motivates achievement by aligning individual, team, and organizational goals.
Analytical Skills: Takes a logical and systematic approach to solving problems and contributes quality alternative solutions that add value for the customer.
Functional Expertise: Maintains and applies current knowledge of relevant practices and science in the field of expertise.
Operational Expertise: Identifies opportunities for improved operational efficiency, applies quality standards, and ensures accuracy and completeness of work outputs.

Core Technical Skills:

Strong experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer
Advanced knowledge of:
C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API
Angular
RESTful APIs and microservices architectures
SQL and relational database design
Redis
Asynchronous messaging systems (RabbitMQ, MassTransit, Azure Service Bus)

Solid understanding of:
OOP, SOLID principles
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
Clean Code practices

If you think that you have the needed requirements click on the apply button to join us and be the difference
. If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or any other protected status, in accordance with local regulations.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Lear For You

We work hard for the people who work for us. We champion our teams and foster collaboration, inclusion, respect and excellence. Because we want to be more for you.

A path to a better career. A better future.

Our teams have invented groundbreaking technologies, manufactured millions of products and earned a long list of awards. Year after year, we’re named one of the World’s Most Admired Companies.

They’re the secret to our success—empowered, inventive and inclusive. Passionate about their craft. Driven to succeed. Because we win together.

Are you ready for a better career? A better future?

Job Description

As a Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain software solutions that power industrial automation systems in manufacturing environments. You will work closely with AI, controls, and mechanical engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and production-ready applications that support continuous plant operations and digital manufacturing initiatives.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain industrial software applications using C# (.NET) and Python.

Define software architecture and component designs, applying design patterns and documenting solutions with UML.

Develop multi-threaded and asynchronous applications for real-time image acquisition, processing, and data management.

Integrate software with industrial hardware, including cameras, PLCs, and field devices using standard industrial communication protocols.

Optimize application performance, focusing on latency, throughput, reliability, and memory efficiency in 24/7 production environments.

Design and maintain data persistence solutions and database integrations to support traceability and production reporting.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver and support automation, AI, and manufacturing solutions.

Participate in code reviews, maintain source control using Git, and contribute to testing and CI/CD practices.

Support software commissioning, deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement at manufacturing and customer sites.

Create and maintain technical documentation and share knowledge across engineering teams.

Experience Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

2+ years of experience in software development for industrial, embedded, real-time, or manufacturing environments.

Proficiency in C# (.NET) and Python, including object-oriented design and asynchronous programming.

Experience with software architecture, design patterns, UML modeling, concurrent programming, and performance optimization.

Experience with Git, relational databases (PostgreSQL or SQL Server), and collaborative software development practices.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Lear Corporation is committed to fair, merit‑based employment practices and equal opportunity.

We provide reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable law. For assistance during the application process, contact your recruiter directly.

Applicants must submit their resume for consideration using our applicant tracking system. Due to the high volume of applications received, only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the position is located. Unsolicited resumes from search firms, employment agencies, or similar, will not be paid a fee and will become the property of Lear Corporation.

jobs.description:
Softengine, Inc. is your trusted ERP partner, pioneering a truly client-first approach to business technology. With over two decades of world-class expertise, we proudly hold the distinction of being an SAP Business One Premier Partner and an Acumatica Cloud ERP Gold Partner.

Mission and Vision

Our mission at Softengine is short, sweet, and directly to the point.

It is to Make Business Simple.

Our Core Values

Collaborative
Driven
Transparent
Innovative
Customer Centric

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Consultant/Developer who can design, build, and deploy customizations and integrations across SAP Business One and Acumatica. You'll take technical requirements from discovery through development, testing, and deployment, working closely with functional consultants and project managers to deliver robust, maintainable solutions. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problem-solving, hands-on coding, and owning deliverables from design through go-live.

What You'll Do

Design, develop, and deploy customizations for SAP Business One (SDK, Service Layer, DI API, UDFs/UDTs, add-ons) and Acumatica (customization projects, generic inquiries, business events, integrations)
Gather and translate business requirements into technical specifications and solution designs
Build and maintain integrations with third-party systems (e.g., e-commerce, EDI, tax engines like Avalara/Avatax, CRM, WMS)
Configure core ERP modules (financials, inventory, sales, purchasing, production) to align with client processes
Write and maintain custom scripts, reports (Crystal Reports, SSRS), and workflow automations
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during implementation and post-go-live support
Document customizations, technical specifications, and configuration decisions for long-term maintainability
Collaborate with project managers and functional consultants to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery
Provide upgrade remediation support, assessing the impact of platform upgrades on existing customizations

What You Bring

10+ years of hands-on experience with SAP Business One development (SDK, DI API, Service Layer) or Acumatica customization (experience with both strongly preferred)
Proficiency in C#, .NET, SQL (T-SQL), JavaScript; familiarity with Acumatica's xRP framework a plus
Solid understanding of core ERP business processes: financials, inventory, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay
Experience integrating ERP systems with external platforms via APIs, web services, or middleware
Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work independently under project deadlines
Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications
Experience working within a consulting or VAR environment is a plus
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

Nice to Have

SAP Business One and/or Acumatica certification(s)
Experience with tax integration platforms (Avalara/Avatax)
Familiarity with EDI and e-commerce integrations
Prior experience supporting multi-tenant or hosted/private server environments
Experience with Boyum products, specifically Be.as

Why

Softengine

Work across a diverse portfolio of clients and industries — no two projects are the same
Deepen your expertise across two major ERP platforms rather than being siloed into one
Collaborative team environment with direct exposure to the full project lifecycle

FULL REMOTE desde cualquier punto de España o HÍBRIDA en Madrid o Barcelona (1 día/semana en oficina).

Tu misión será conectar las necesidades del cliente con la ejecución técnica. Participarás activamente en el ciclo de los proyectos: desde la toma de requerimientos y comprensión del negocio hasta el diseño, desarrollo de integraciones, automatizaciones y configuración avanzada sobre la plataforma.

¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Análisis y Diseño Técnico-Funcional: Entender los procesos del cliente (en áreas como Marketing, Sales, Customer Service o Field Service) para diseñar y proponer la mejor solución técnica sobre Dynamics 365.
Interlocución con Cliente: Actuar de puente entre el negocio y el equipo técnico, liderando sesiones de descubrimiento y definición de requerimientos.
Desarrollo y Customización: Supervisar y ejecutar desarrollos a medida utilizando C# (plugins) y JavaScript (formularios), asegurando un óptimo rendimiento en Dataverse.
Integraciones y Automatizaciones: Diseñar flujos de datos complejos y automatizaciones avanzadas utilizando Power Platform, Power Automate y herramientas de integración con sistemas externos.

¿Qué buscamos en ti? (Requisitos Imprescindibles)

Experiencia en el ecosistema: Mínimo 4 años de experiencia real trabajando con Dynamics 365 CRM y Power Platform.

Un equipo diverso. Respetamos las diferencias que nos hacen más humanos. 💜
