Nuestro equipo multicultural es el motor de nuestro éxito. Nos enorgullece llevar la moda más allá, conectando nuestro estilo único con personas de todo el mundo.

Somos un equipo muy dinámico, motivado por las nuevas tecnologías, con pasión por lo que hacemos y ganas de asumir grandes retos que nos permitan seguir creciendo y aportando valor a través de los datos.

TU NUEVO PUESTO

Gestionarás un área formada por 3 squads, siendo responsable de su rendimiento, cultura y evolución técnica. Parte esencial de tu rol es aprovechar las herramientas de IA disponibles para que tu equipo entregue más, mejor y más rápido, no como una opción, sino como una responsabilidad

Liderazgo de personas y equipos

Seguimiento continuo del equipo: 1:1s, evaluación del rendimiento, retención y desarrollo del talento.
Fomentar una cultura de colaboración, feedback y mejora continua, alineada con los valores de Mango.
Identificar dependencias, evitar bloqueos y resolver conflictos dentro y entre squads.
Liderar con el ejemplo: ownership real, capacidad de hacer que las cosas pasen.

Entrega de valor y ejecución

Parte esencial de tu rol es que tu equipo entregue más, mejor y más rápido. Para eso, aprovechar las herramientas de IA disponibles no es una opción, es una responsabilidad. No buscamos conocimiento teórico, sino impacto real en productividad, calidad y velocidad.

Balancear la productividad a corto plazo con la mantenibilidad y robustez a largo plazo.
Trabajar mano a mano con Product Owners para entender las necesidades de Retail Operations así como sus backlogs
Gestionar dependencias entre equipos del Departamento de Tecnología.
Adoptar y promover el uso de herramientas de IA en el día a día del equipo: code review asistido, generación de tests, documentación automática, análisis de incidencias, …
Ejecutar tú mismo: no solo delegar el uso de IA, sino usarla directamente para resolver problemas, generar prototipos, analizar datos o preparar propuestas.
Identificar oportunidades de automatización en los procesos del equipo y del negocio, y liderar su implementación de forma ágil.

Buscamos un Engineering Manager que no espere a que le lleguen las soluciones, sino que las genere y que contagie esa mentalidad a su equipo.

SOBRE TI

Gestión de personas y equipos

Experiencia en gestión de equipos: seguimiento, 1:1s, evaluación del rendimiento, retención del talento.
Experiencia dando feedback, incluyendo conversaciones difíciles.
Liderazgo, planificación y skills comunicativos sólidos.
Apasionado/a con las personas y con mejorar el entorno de trabajo en el que se desenvuelven.

Ejecución y entrega

Experiencia liderando la entrega de valor en el ciclo de desarrollo de software.
Experiencia en gestión y delivery de proyectos de alto impacto.
Capacidad para lidiar con bloqueos y resolverlos con autonomía.
Flexibilidad para adaptarse a cambios constantes (el mundo de la moda es muy cambiante).
Visión global, con capacidad de profundizar en los detalles cuando sea necesario.
Inglés alto.

Tecnología

Amplios conocimientos de plataforma .NET (Core y Framework).
Patrones de diseño y buenas prácticas, incluyendo MVC, MVVM y clean architecture.
Experiencia con C#, MAUI
Experiencia Entity Framework y SQL Server
Experiencia con RESTful APIs.
Uso avanzado de GIT y Bitbucket o similar.

Mentalidad AI-first

Buscamos a alguien que no espere a que la IA "llegue" a su equipo, sino que la traiga.

Experiencia práctica usando herramientas de IA generativa en el contexto de desarrollo de software (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.).
Capacidad para ejecutar tú mismo con IA: no solo supervisar, sino generar, prototipar y resolver de forma directa.
Mentalidad de ownership: si algo se puede automatizar o acelerar con IA, lo identificas, lo propones y lo llevas adelante.
Experiencia (o fuerte disposición) liderando iniciativas de adopción de IA en equipos de ingeniería.
Orientación a resultados: defines métricas, mides el impacto y comunicas los avances con claridad.
Curiosidad genuina por el ecosistema AI/ML y su aplicación en producto digital y plataformas tecnológicas.

TUS BENEFICIOS

Incorporación inmediata con contrato indefinido.
Ofrecemos horario flexible (puedes entrar de 8 a 9.30 y salir de 17 a 18.30) con jornada intensiva todos los viernes (puedes entrar de 8 a 9 y salir de 14 a 15) y la mayoría de las vigilias de festivos
Nuestras oficinas se encuentran en Palau- Solita i Plegamans.
Posibilidad de teletrabajo en un 40%.

Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement — Sustitución de Salesforce (SF Takeout), soluciones de Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) y despliegues estándar de CE (Sales, Customer Service y Field Service).
Extensibilidad de Copilot (M365 y D365) — Agentes de Copilot y Copilot Studio, orquestación multiagente (A2A), Microsoft Agent Framework y gobierno, experiencia profunda en Work IQ (datos, memoria e inferencia) y APIs, así como fundamentación de datos empresariales mediante Microsoft Graph, Dynamics 365 y conectores.
Azure Fabric y Azure AI Foundry — Gestión unificada de datos basada en OneLake, arquitecturas Lakehouse para analítica e IA, uso del catálogo de modelos para descubrimiento y ajuste fino (fine-tuning), desarrollo de agentes empresariales y orquestación multiagente mediante Foundry Agent Service, así como fundamentación de datos y soluciones RAG utilizando OneLake y Azure AI Search.

Integrarse con los grupos de interés del cliente para comprender los flujos de trabajo del negocio, sus restricciones y métricas de éxito; traducir necesidades ambiguas en requisitos claros, hipótesis de solución y entregables de sprint para escenarios de IA generativa (GenAI) y agentes inteligentes.

Diseñar e implementar soluciones de IA generativa y agentes inteligentes sobre plataformas Microsoft (por ejemplo, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Power Platform y Azure), incluyendo integraciones, APIs y automatizaciones que aceleren la adopción y generen resultados medibles.

Prototipar rápidamente y evolucionar hacia producción: construir pruebas de concepto (POCs) para flujos de trabajo basados en agentes (tareas de múltiples pasos, uso de herramientas y orquestación), validarlas con los usuarios y transformarlas en implementaciones listas para producción mediante pruebas, monitorización y patrones de despliegue seguros.

Liderar la entrega de extremo a extremo, desde la arquitectura hasta la implementación: definir especificaciones de desarrollo y pruebas, crear mecanismos de evaluación y controles de calidad para los resultados de GenAI, y elaborar guías operativas y procedimientos (runbooks) que garanticen fiabilidad, seguridad y mantenibilidad.

Identificar y mitigar riesgos de negocio y técnicos específicos de sistemas de IA (acceso a datos, inyección de prompts, alucinaciones, privacidad, cumplimiento normativo, latencia y costes); proponer salvaguardas y comportamientos alternativos para los flujos basados en agentes.

Dar soporte al despliegue y estabilización en producción: resolver problemas de integración y comportamiento de modelos en entornos reales, iterar con rapidez y asegurar una puesta en marcha exitosa mediante una gestión clara, monitorización y procedimientos de respuesta ante incidencias.

Equilibrar la configuración estándar de la plataforma con la extensibilidad para maximizar la velocidad de implementación y la mantenibilidad. Co-desarrollar con los equipos del cliente para garantizar la transferencia de conocimiento, la documentación y la reutilización de patrones.

Liderar los planes de entrega durante todo el ciclo de vida —descubrimiento, construcción, evaluación, despliegue y operaciones— teniendo en cuenta dependencias relacionadas con datos, seguridad y sistemas empresariales.

Construir flujos de trabajo basados en agentes que invoquen herramientas y APIs de forma segura (patrones de llamada a funciones), incorporando controles, validación y trazabilidad.
Implementar estrategias de evaluación (offline y online) para medir la calidad de las respuestas, su fundamentación en datos, seguridad e impacto de negocio.

Crear y mantener activos reutilizables (plantillas, arquitecturas de referencia y aceleradores) y compartir ciclos de retroalimentación con equipos internos.

Requisitos

Titulación universitaria en Informática, Ingeniería o disciplina relacionada, y experiencia demostrable en la entrega de soluciones software en producción (o experiencia equivalente).

Más de 10 años de experiencia implementando soluciones empresariales a gran escala sobre plataformas Microsoft (Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Power Platform y Azure), incluyendo integración, seguridad y despliegue en entornos de clientes.

Requisitos deseados

Experiencia demostrada en la entrega práctica de soluciones de nivel productivo a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida del proyecto, incluyendo gestión de requisitos ambiguos, desarrollo, despliegue y estabilización posterior a la puesta en marcha.
Experiencia contrastada en la implementación de soluciones con Dynamics 365 CE y Power Platform, soluciones basadas en Microsoft 365 Copilot y flujos de trabajo potenciados por IA (recomendaciones, resúmenes, enrutamiento de casos, asistencia para centros de contacto y copilotos para ventas o servicio), utilizando prácticas de ingeniería de nivel empresarial.
Experiencia en la construcción o ampliación de soluciones que incorporen Copilots, flujos de trabajo asistidos por IA o automatización inteligente; se considera una ventaja significativa.
Certificaciones y/o experiencia en soluciones Azure, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 Copilot y Power Platform; experiencia con servicios Azure AI y patrones de solución GenAI será altamente valorada.
Experiencia en metodologías ágiles, DevOps, CI/CD y preparación operativa (observabilidad y gestión de incidencias), especialmente en sistemas de IA.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior .NET Developer at IMPACT Commerce Portugal, you will play a crucial role in the development of large e‑commerce projects for some of our largest brands and retailers. From day one, you will experience a high involvement in the development of next-generation e-commerce platforms, contributing to technical execution and decision-making on a distributed team. We expect you to be an expert in turning designs into working deliverables and translating strategy and business needs into solution concepts.

You will work with a tech stack that includes .NET, Azure, and C#. We usually develop Composable Commerce solutions that require integration with other cloud platforms like CMS, e.g., Umbraco. You will be part of our team in Portugal, working collaboratively with our delivery and engineering teams across the group.

Your Responsibilities

Build and maintain complex e-commerce solutions using .NET and .NET Core frameworks, Azure, and C#.
Analyse client requests and adapt solutions that can fit both the technical team and the client's needs.
Participate in client meetings to clarify technical questions.
Collaborate with the delivery team on defining, estimating, documenting, and evaluating the technical solution of a project.
Collaborate cross-team and cross-platforms to share knowledge and solve problems.
Establish and promote best practices that will empower the team to build high-quality applications.
Work collaboratively with the delivery and engineering team to ensure that the solutions produced meet the quality and performance standards expected.
Lead and mentor junior team members when needed.
Work with the engineering team to set technical directions and ensure developmental progress for the organization.

Job Requirements

At least 5 years of experience developing web-based applications.
At least 3 years of experience working with .NET and .NET Core frameworks
Working experience with Azure DevOps and Azure
Knowledge of MACH Architecture (Microservices, API first, Cloud Native, and Headless).
Excellent knowledge of the C# language.
Experience in complex web development projects and/or digital transformation projects.
Experience in e-Commerce projects is a plus.
Experience in an agency/consultancy environment.
Working experience with Git, GitLab, and JIRA.
Curiosity about technology and ability to advocate for change when needed, with a constant focus on quality and usability.
Familiar with SCRUM processes and experienced in working in an agile way.
Willing to learn new things and to share knowledge with others.
Great problem-solving skills, with a solution-focused mindset.
Ability to adapt to a fast-paced environment.
Fluent in the English language, both written and spoken.

What We Offer

Opportunity to participate in innovative projects, creating disruptive digital experiences for our clients around Europe. Read some of our case studies here;
Possibility to work with a diverse technical ecosystem, with trending technologies and platforms in the market;
Flexible homework scheme: remote work available;
In-person team meet-ups several times a year (including team-building activities, Summer Event, Christmas Party, etc);
Health insurance;
Flex benefits Policy;
Possibility to attend industry events and take certifications on the platforms and technologies we work with;
Be part of a team where we value genuine human connections. Companionship is a word that everyone agrees would describe us as a company;

LIFE AT IMPACT

Commerce has never stood still. Neither have we. For more than 25 years, we have helped ambitious businesses turn change into growth by taking the time to understand what truly moves their business. What started in Aarhus, Denmark has grown into a European powerhouse with offices across the world.

From strategy and experience to technology, data, and execution, every capability sits under one roof. That’s how we move faster, align better, and build solutions that hold over time. We work close by. We think long-term. And we take responsibility for bringing technology, strategy, and execution together - helping brands grow with clarity and confidence in the next era of commerce.

IMPACT is built by specialists who care deeply about what they do, and take responsibility for what they deliver. Wherever commerce happens, we show up with the same standards, the same accountability, and the same ambition. Because consistency is what builds trust, across borders and over time.

APPLICATION

If you’re ready to take on a pivotal role in driving our success, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to join our journey in shaping the future of digital commerce!

For a more direct contact, please reach out to Cristina Silva (cristina.silva@impactcommerce.com), our People & Culture team representative in Portugal.

Je ontwerpt en realiseert robuuste en schaalbare architecturen op basis van Microsoft-technologieën, .NET en Azure. Je vertaalt businessdoelen naar technische oplossingen en begeleidt ontwikkelteams in het maken van de juiste designkeuzes. Je werkt aan projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties binnen diverse branches, waarbij je continu schakelt tussen strategie, techniek en teamdynamiek. Je bent in staat om architectuurprincipes helder over te brengen, risico’s te identificeren en mitigaties voor te stellen. Je hebt een sterke visie op softwarekwaliteit, DevOps, cloud-native development en security-by-design. Dankzij jouw ervaring en overtuigingskracht weet je stakeholders mee te nemen in jouw technische keuzes.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding en minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als Software Architect.
Gedegen kennis van Microsoft-technologieën (.NET, Azure, DevOps, etc.)
Ervaring met het opzetten van softwarearchitecturen en het begeleiden van ontwikkelteams
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en analytisch vermogen
Passie voor technologie en een drive om continu te leren en te verbeteren
Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal op minimaal C1-niveau.

   Een dienstverband van 40 uur per week, met flexibele mogelijkheden om parttime te werken.
   Een salaris tussen de E80.000 en E95.000 bruto per jaar (inclusief vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsbudget), exclusief bonus.
   Een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, met o.a. opties om elektrisch te rijden.
   Hybride werken en een goede werk-privébalans.
   Uitgebreide opleidings- en certificeringsmogelijkheden.
   Flexibiliteit in het ruilen van feestdagen, passend bij jouw persoonlijke voorkeuren.
   26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de optie om extra dagen bij te kopen.
   Uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties waarin jouw technische expertise het verschil maakt.
   Toegang tot onze kenniscommunity, meet-ups, hackathons en tech-events. En natuurlijk: ontspanning via game nights, skitrips en meer.

Hoe zorg jij ervoor dat duizenden collega’s binnen de Rechtspraak elke dag soepel (samen)werken? Als full-stack developer bij IVO Rechtspraak bouw je applicaties die dat mogelijk maken: van intranet en kennisdeling tot digitale handtekeningen en nieuwe tools voor samenwerking. Jouw oplossingen hebben impact. En je ideeën worden gewaardeerd!

Wat ga je doen bij IVO Rechtspraak?

Jij versterkt het DevOps-team “Kennis en Samenwerken”. Samen ontwikkelen en beheren jullie toepassingen die de hele organisatie draaiende houden. Je werkt aan bestaande SharePoint-oplossingen en bouwt nieuwe, generieke applicaties die de volgende stap in digitalisering mogelijk maken.

Houd je van variatie en uitdaging? Dan zit je hier goed. De ene dag verfijn je een applicatie die al jaren in gebruik is of analyseer je een incident. De andere dag bouw je een nieuw systeem vanaf nul.

Het ene moment werk je aan de front-end in Angular, het volgende moment bouw je een API in .NET – en alles wat daar tussenin zit. Je overlegt met architecten over technische keuzes, maar schakelt even vlot met gebruikers door de hele organisatie. Je werkt agile, met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Jouw inbreng als senior telt: je ervaring, je ideeën, je voorstellen voor oplossingsrichtingen. Wil je ook buiten je team kennis delen? Ben jij een ervaren full-stack developer die graag het voortouw neemt? Praat je net zo makkelijk met een rechter als met een architect? En vind je maatschappelijke impact minstens zo belangrijk als techniek? Dan is dit jouw volgende stap.

Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij:

Contract: een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
Salaris: je komt terecht in salarisschaal 10 of 11 (maximaal € 6.275,94 per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur). Inschaling vindt plaats op basis van je werkervaring.
Keuzebudget: 16,5% van je jaarsalaris (maximaal € 1.008 per maand) om je eigen arbeidsvoorwaarden samen te stellen. Zoals het kopen van verlof, het aanschaffen van een fiets of het verduurzamen van je woning.
Doorgroeimogelijkheden: je functie zit vol mogelijkheden om je kennis verder uit te breiden en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. En bij onze IVO Academie kun je allerlei trainingen en opleidingen doen.
Werk-privébalans: je bent vrij om je werkdagen flexibel in te delen. Zo kun je deels vanuit huis werken. We dragen € 750 bij aan het inrichten van een comfortabele thuiswerkplek.
Vakanties en vrije dagen: je hebt 144 vakantie- en 64 keuzebudget-uren op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Dat zijn dus in totaal 26 dagen.

Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je op www.p-direkt.nl (http://www.p-direkt.nl/).

Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in het programmeren met het .NET-platform, inclusief het ontwikkelen van backend oplossingen voor SharePoint-integraties (zowel on-premise als in M365)
Ervaring met front-end technologieën zoals Angular

to join the Identity & Access Management (IAM) team
at DataSnipper!

In this role, you'll be responsible for designing and building core platform systems
that power authentication, authorization, and access across our entire product. You’ll play a key role in shaping the architecture of our platform and enabling other teams to build on top of it.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.

Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now OFFICIALLY the fastest-growing software company in the Netherlands according to Deloitte Fast50 and recently achieved Unicorn status in our latest funding round. With over 400.000 users in 125+ countries and a second base in the heart of New York City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there. At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential.

What You Will Do

Design and build scalable, secure IAM (authentication, authorization, access management) platform services
Own and drive architecture decisions for backend systems
Work across teams to enable identity and access flows across the platform
Ensure high reliability, performance, and security
Handle ambiguous, high-level problems and turn them into structured solutions
Collaborate with stakeholders and communicate technical decisions and risks clearly
Participate in an on-call rotation (second line after tech support)

What You Bring

7+ years of backend development experience (C#, Java, Python, TypeScript, etc.)
Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure)
Proven track record of building scalable, reliable systems
Experience with system design and architecture
Strong communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders
Bias to action and sense of ownership
Ability to work independently on complex and ambiguous problems
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern development practices
Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools
Wealth of experience around testing and various methodologies

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Identity & Access Management systems
Strong understanding of security and authorization models
Experience with microservices architecture
Familiarity with container services (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience working in platform teams
Experience working in startups or scaleups

What We Offer

Make an impact by disrupting the audit industry with us
28 vacation days on a full-time basis
Excellent salary
Pension plan
Stock participation plan
Hybrid mode of work (at least 3 days onsite in Amsterdam)
International working environment
Daily lunch provided by our in-house chef 🍽️

Friday drinks and team events 🤩

Final interviews with Engineering leadership

Je werkt binnen een innovatief team waar je ideeën, kansen en gebruikersbehoeften vertaalt naar concrete digitale oplossingen. In deze rol ontwikkel je prototypes, demonstrators, Proof-of-Concepts en MVP’s waarmee je nieuwe concepten snel zichtbaar en toetsbaar maakt. Je beweegt je over de volle breedte van de stack en combineert techniek, experimenteren en gebruikersinzicht om waardevolle proposities te verkennen. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s en stakeholders en helpt bepalen welke ideeën kansrijk genoeg zijn voor verdere ontwikkeling.

Wat ga je doen

Je vertaalt ideeën, kansen en gebruikersbehoeften naar concrete en werkende oplossingen.
Je ontwikkelt prototypes, demonstrators, Proof-of-Concepts (PoC’s) en Minimal Viable Products (MVP’s).
Je werkt over de volle breedte van de stack: van gebruikersinterface en backend tot AI-componenten, databronnen en koppelingen met interne en externe systemen.
Je onderzoekt samen met gebruikers, stakeholders en collega’s welke nieuwe producten, diensten en AI-toepassingen waarde kunnen toevoegen.
Je presenteert resultaten aan stakeholders en verwerkt feedback in korte iteraties.
Je helpt de organisatie om snel te leren, kansen zichtbaar te maken en onderbouwde keuzes te maken over verdere ontwikkeling.

Over jou

Je bent nieuwsgierig, ondernemend en voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vaststaat.
Je hebt een brede technische basis en kunt een idee begeleiden van eerste concept tot werkend prototype.
Je begrijpt zowel de technische als de organisatorische kant van innovatie.
Je schakelt makkelijk tussen gebruikers, business stakeholders en technische specialisten.
Je hebt affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling, cloud, data en AI.
Je durft te experimenteren, keuzes ter discussie te stellen en alternatieven te verkennen.
Je hebt oog voor privacy, informatieveiligheid, compliance en stakeholdermanagement binnen een bestuurlijk complexe omgeving.

Eisen

Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding.
Je hebt een opleiding in een technische of sterk kwantitatieve studie, bijvoorbeeld Informatica, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Wiskunde, Econometrie of vergelijkbaar.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met alle volgende technologieën: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React en Next.js.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met alle volgende technologieën: .NET, Node.js, GraphQL en REST API’s.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met alle volgende technologieën: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB en Neo4j.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met alle volgende technologieën: CI/CD-pipelines, GitLab, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, Linux en SSH.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met alle volgende technologieën: Text-to-SQL, coding agents, Azure OpenAI en Python.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen van AI-Agents, LLM-integraties, MCP-servers en MCP-clients.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met zowel de AVG als de AI Act.

Wensen

Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met state management, bijvoorbeeld Redux.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met microservices.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met OAuth2 en OpenID Connect.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het realiseren van Proof-of-Concepts (PoC’s) en het zelf ontwikkelen van nieuwe proposities.

Competenties

Je bekijkt situaties vanuit verschillende invalshoeken, laat vaste interpretatiekaders los en komt tot alternatieve, oorspronkelijke en vernieuwende ideeën.
Je reageert proactief door zaken in gang te zetten.
Je signaleert, onderzoekt en speelt binnen je eigen mogelijkheden in op de wensen en behoeften van interne en externe klanten.
Je onderzoekt, herkent en begrijpt de belangrijkste elementen van vraagstukken en hun onderlinge samenhang.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
DecisionPoint is seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developers
to support the MODES III program. This individual will design, develop, modernize, test, integrate, and maintain secure enterprise web applications supporting Department of Defense mission requirements. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Oracle APEX, PL/SQL, modern front-end and back-end technologies, RESTful APIs, cloud-hosted applications, and Agile/DevSecOps delivery in a fast-paced Federal environment.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

Full Stack Application Development

Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain responsive enterprise web applications.
Develop reusable front-end components and scalable back-end services using approved frameworks and coding standards.
Translate business and technical requirements into secure, maintainable software solutions.
Troubleshoot defects, perform root-cause analysis, and support production issue resolution.

API, Integration, and Cloud Support

Design, build, document, and maintain secure RESTful APIs and system integrations.
Support application deployment and operations in AWS.
Collaborate with DevSecOps engineers to improve CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and deployment automation.
Assist with application performance monitoring, tuning, availability, and reliability.

Cybersecurity, Quality, and Compliance

Apply secure software development practices and participate in code reviews, automated testing, and vulnerability remediation.
Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to support RMF, Zero Trust, NIST SP 800-53, and Authority to Operate requirements.
Develop accessible applications and content consistent with Section 508 requirements.

Agile Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration

Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, UX specialists, architects, testers, and Government stakeholders.
Provide work estimates, technical documentation, status updates, and knowledge transfer.

The Full Stack Developer will help modernize and sustain MODES III applications that support military members and their families. The role combines hands-on Oracle APEX development, cloud application engineering, secure software delivery, and close collaboration with Government and program stakeholders to deliver reliable, accessible, and mission-focused digital services.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Must hold an active Secret clearance.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

jobs.description:
Staff Backend Engineer – Platform

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there.

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be up to

Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently.
Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment.
Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders.
Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence.
Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably.
Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available.
Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents.
Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement.

Some of the challenges waiting for you

Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally).
Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery.
Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch.
Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level.

What you'll bring to the team

8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role.
Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used.
A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team.
Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).
Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack).
Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function.
Fluent English.

Nice to have

Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong.
Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation).
Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent).
Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

What we offer

Culture and growth

A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities.
Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework.
Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency.
Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up.
Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team.
A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany.
Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events.
30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options.

Where you'll work from

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

jobs.title: Senior Unity Developer - Core Game Tech (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come.

Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

Senior Unity Developer - Core Game Tech (f/m/d)

We are looking for a Senior Unity Developer to join our Core Game Tech (CGT) Team — the small, senior team behind the technology that every Kolibri game runs on.

Our work spans consulting game teams on technical decisions, investigating problems where nobody has defined the requirements yet, and building the systems and integrations that the games depend on. That ranges from compliance features and third-party SDKs to shared systems, standardization and keeping our engine and tooling current.

You'll work in a small specialized team alongside technical decision makers to have strong impact on all the games across our portfolio.

If you like being the person who takes on the technical problems other teams can't, and you don't shy away from constantly diving into new unknowns, learning new skills and driving topics forward, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Design and build the shared systems multiple live games with dynamic events and scheduled content for millions of users run on
Drive third-party integrations and keep the portfolio current: evaluate and integrate SDKs, drive SDK and Unity version upgrades, and understand the impact across every game before it lands
Advise game teams as their technical counterpart, driving standardization and winning adoption of shared solutions on the strength of the work and the argument
Deliver compliance and privacy features across the portfolio, such as age assurance APIs, CMP implementations and GDPR data deletion flows
Investigate open-ended technical problems and turn regulations, vendor changes and internal needs into concrete technical requirements

Required Skills

(Ideally 5+ years of professional) Software development experience in C# and Unity3D. Experience in non-gaming contexts is also relevant; we value your expertise, so do not hesitate to apply
You have a wide understanding of how Unity works, you are familiar with native implementations, understand backend interactions, and performance investigations are your bread and butter. The most important skill is to be able to jump into the unknown and get familiar
Strong written and spoken communication, and the credibility to make teams you don't sit with want to adopt your solutions
Experience building libraries, packages, APIs or tooling that other developers consume, and an instinct for what makes them adoptable
Ability to plan, communicate, and execute technical solutions in a way that is both understandable for other developers as well as non technical stakeholders
Ability to derive requirements yourself from ambiguous or external sources — regulation, platform policy, vendor documentation — rather than working from a written spec
A genuine appetite for constantly learning new areas of the stack

Desirable Skills

Experience debugging below the C# layer into Android and iOS platform code, and profiling performance on mobile
Exposure to compliance, privacy or platform policy work — GDPR, CMP, age assurance, ATT or similar
Familiarity with reactive or async programming and dependency injection frameworks, e.g. UniRx, Zenject, UniTask
A passion for games and an understanding of the mobile market, like F2P and LiveOps
Strong familiarity with using LLMs in different areas of game development to support your efforts and achieve stronger results
Familiarity with Firebase Crashlytics and an understanding of ANRs

Kolibri Games is an equal opportunity employer. We come from 40 different countries and many different backgrounds. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, physical appearance or disability.

We are an international studio, so don’t forget to send in your application in English. Although it is not mandatory, we always appreciate a cover letter stating your motivation to join us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Your Benefits – We’re game to support you

Competitive Salary
- We believe that top performers should receive top payment

Learning Budget
- We believe in learning. A generous personal learning budget to spend on learning and development, including books, workshops and attending conferences. We also offer in-house training such as coding and German classes

Flexible Working Hours and Home Office

Equipment

Kolicard

Mobility budget

Relocation

Pension

Bonus Level – We love to have a good time, too

Food and Drinks

Parties and Team Events

Company Holidays

Bristol, UK (Onsite)

As a .NET backend developer, you will contribute to the architecture, design, development and support of current and future software products.
Your responsibilities will include:
Designing and developing scalable backend services and APIs using C#
Developing clean, maintainable and well-tested code following SOLID principles and industry best practices
Designing and optimising relational database structures and queries
Building integrations with third-party systems and services using REST APIs and JSON/XML
Supporting cloud-hosted applications and contributing to performance, reliability and scalability improvements
Collaborating with front end developers to deliver complete end-to-end solutions
Participating in code reviews and helping establish engineering best practises.
Troubleshooting, debugging and resolving production issues
Contributing to architectural discussions and continuous improvement of development processes
Continuously learning new technologies and sharing knowledge with the wider team.

What We’re Looking For

Commercial experience with C# and .NET / .NET Framework
Strong understanding of object-orientated programming, SOLID principles and software design patterns
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs
Strong SQL skills with experience of MySQL or similar relational databases
Experience integrating with external systems using JSON and XML
Experience writing automated unit tests (xUnit, NUnit, MSTest or similar)
Understanding of software architecture and development best practises
Experience using Git for source control.
Designing and developing secure applications by applying secure coding principles, OWAPS guidance and security best practices
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or within a collaborative team.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality solutions to agreed deadlines
Good knowledge of HTML, CSS, Javascript and experience with a modern frontend framework such as Vue to support full stack collaboration
Jira or similar Agile project management tools
CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practises
NoSQL databases such as MongoDB
Experience developing and deploying applications on AWS, including services such as ECS, EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM and API Gateway

Get To Know Us

The world runs on connected devices. At Likewize, we make the experience around them work better. We partner with many of the world’s biggest brands to design and deliver seamless device journeys across protection, repair, upgrade, and renewal. We help our partners unlock growth by putting customer experience at the center of the entire device lifecycle. When tech goes wrong, we make it right. When customers are ready for something new, we make the transition simple. We operate on a global scale but never lose sight of the individual customer. Innovation is part of our DNA. We move fast, challenge the obvious, and look for better answers.

We are driven by Success, Passion, Professionalism, Accountability and Teamwork – and we look for people who share the same values. At Likewize, we Go for Growth. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

Your new role

In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘ Menu’ team, which is part of the wider ‘ Order’ engineering group.

The Menu team owns and operates all of the systems involved with managing, publishing and accessing billions of menu records. Menus change in real time and their accuracy is essential for the proper operation of our customer’s businesses. Consequently, the Menu team’s scope includes some of the most sophisticated and performance sensitive parts of Olo’s infrastructure. A deep understanding of garbage collection, network latency, and database internals comes with the territory. If you are looking for a challenge, you will find it here.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Demonstrate a solid understanding of the Menu team's domain and technology stack, contributing to discussions and development decisions with growing independence.
Handle small-to-medium features independently and begin taking ownership of moderately complex tasks with some guidance.
Write clean, maintainable code and actively participate in peer code reviews, providing constructive feedback and adhering to coding standards.
Collaborate closely with Product to refine requirements, helping to shape solutions that meet business needs effectively.
Focus on delivering high-quality software solutions within established timelines, emphasising best practices in software development.
Engage in troubleshooting and debugging efforts, showing an ability to resolve common and moderately complex issues with minimal support.
Assist in the deployment and monitoring of services, learning how to manage and troubleshoot issues in production environments.
Contribute to building and maintaining reliable distributed systems, implementing resilience mechanisms as appropriate.
Participate actively in team ceremonies and demonstrate initiative by taking ownership of tasks and helping to unblock others when possible.
Engage in continuous learning and self-improvement by exploring new technologies and best practices relevant to the team's work.
Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot extensively as part of your daily workflow, and grow your skills through hands-on AI training designed to help you become highly effective with modern AI coding agents and IDEs.
Demonstrate ownership of the team's delivery pipeline, ensuring that code quality, testing standards, and deployment practices are continuously optimised.
Active participation in on-call duties is required, with specific responsibilities determined by your assigned team and area of expertise.

What Will Set You Up For Success

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience in software engineering.
Proficient in the .Net/C# ecosystem and capable of independently implementing moderately complex features and algorithms.
Experience using version control tools (e.g., GitHub) and participating in continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, TeamCity).

Deeper understanding of distributed systems, including building scalable and resilient services (e.g., Redis, Kafka, AWS infrastructure).

Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. jobs.description:
Senior Software Developer - .Net / C# - 100% Remote

Are you the kind of developer who sees something that's not quite right and just…owns it, rather than waiting to be told to fix it?

(This isn't a role for someone who wants tickets pointed at them and to be left alone. The team already has plenty of people who can execute - what's missing is someone who steps back, sees the bigger picture, and makes the call)

We're working with an established public sector-facing transport technology business, fully remote, with a small, close-knit engineering team building consumer-facing apps (built on .NET MAUI, so a single C#/.NET codebase across platforms) backed by a .NET Core API. The business is growing - new regional contracts are coming online that will substantially increase revenue over the next few years - but it's stayed a genuinely low-pressure, low-turnover place to work. People who join tend to still be there years later.

What you'll be doing:

Taking real ownership of features across the app and API - not just building to spec, but deciding what "right" looks like and pushing back when something isn't
Picking up pieces of work and seeing them through to completion without needing to be pointed in the right direction at every step
Stepping back from the code to look at the holistic picture - is this UI pattern actually good, is this the right way to solve the problem, not just "does it technically work"
Working alongside 4-5 other developers of mixed experience, helping steer decisions rather than just adding to the pile of individually-reasonable-but-inconsistent choices
Working across a MAUI-based app and its .NET Core / C# API - genuine full-stack ownership within the .NET ecosystem

What they're looking for:

Strong, proven C#/.NET development experience - this is the core skill the role is built around, not a secondary strength
A genuine ownership mentality - comfortable making the call and living with it, rather than waiting to be told
Enough experience to see the bigger picture across a codebase or feature, not just execute the ticket in front of you
Someone who's past chasing the next big salary bump or the next big title - this is a steady, long-term role for someone who knows what matters to them (good work-life balance, 100% remote, flexibility, no overtime or weekend work)

Advantageous, not essential:

Experience with .NET MAUI, Xamarin, or another cross-platform C#/.NET mobile framework
Comfortable with SQL Server (though there's already dedicated support for this, so it's not a core requirement)
Experience working in a small team where you're one of a handful of developers, not one of fifty

The kind of person who'll do well here:

You'd rather have a stable, sustainable working life than chase pace or cutting-edge tech for its own sake - this team finishes at 5.00pm, and means it
You're happy being trusted to own things without needing a bigger title to justify it
You care enough about the detail - a clunky bit of UI, a pattern being copied without being questioned - to fix it even when nobody's asked
You want to still be here in years, not months - this business is known for keeping people, and they're looking for someone who wants that too

Why this is worth a look:

This is a genuinely stable, well-funded business - revenue is set to rise significantly over the next few years as new contracts land - that has never had a problem keeping hold of good people. It's fully remote, properly low-pressure, and offers the kind of ownership that's usually reserved for a "lead" title, without the politics that title normally comes with.

If you want to be the person who decides what "right" looks like, rather than just building to someone else's decision, this is worth a conversation.

Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team at the forefront of subscription spend management innovation?

At TRG Screen, we're not just redefining how organizations manage their subscription expenses – we're shaping the future of the industry. About TRG Screen

TRG Screen is the leading provider of market data and subscription management technology and automation solutions, tailored to the unique needs of financial institutions and legal firms. Our integrated suite of solutions includes market data and subscription spend management, usage management, compliance reporting, and comprehensive managed services, which hundreds of clients worldwide use to remove cumbersome and inaccurate manual processes and gain control over market data and subscription costs at scale. For more than 25 years, TRG Screen has enabled businesses who rely on market data to monitor and strategically manage spending and usage of data and information services, including market data, research, software licenses, consulting and other necessary corporate expenses. TRG Screen solutions give decisionmakers full transparency into subscription spend and usage, enabling them to proactively manage subscription costs at scale, conduct more informed vendor negotiations, improve governance, and avoid unnecessary spending on these mission-critical business services. TRG Screen is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Europe and Asia, as well as a 24x7 client support center in Bangalore, India.

TRG Screen is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s largest and most respected private equity firms.

The Role

Location: Belfast, Northern Ireland

Reporting to the Director of Software Engineering, the Manager of Software Engineering will lead globally distributed engineering teams at TRG Screen, building a high-performance culture of operational excellence while scaling engineering operations to meet evolving business goals.

This role is responsible for translating engineering strategy into execution—optimizing development processes, providing technical leadership to guide platform modernization, and delivering secure, reliable, scalable solutions. The Manager will own team-level KPI tracking, champion AI-powered code-generation tools to elevate productivity and fuel continuous improvement, and serve as a key connector between engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

This is a people-first leadership role for someone who has grown beyond hands-on delivery but remains technically credible—capable of conducting meaningful code reviews, mentoring engineers at every level, and shaping a culture of engineering excellence across distributed teams.

Responsibilities

People leadership – Coach and develop direct reports through 1:1s, timely feedback, and career planning. Own performance management end-to-end, contribute to hiring, and enable Technical Leads to focus on their highest-leverage technical work.
Delivery – Set clear direction and realistic timelines, manage the roadmap with Product and Design, and proactively handle risks, blockers, and dependencies and escalate as needed to DOE. Own team delivery health metrics (print velocity, bug metrics) and provide visibility to DOE.
Process – Champion Agile practices, ceremonies, and ensure the team has space to act on improvements. Lead incident management and champion a blameless culture.
Technology – Engage in technical discussions at team level, ensure designs are properly evaluated, and keep team decisions consistent with TRG Screen’s architectural principles and engineering strategy.
AI governance – Actively drive AI adoption within the team, build capability and measure uptake. Hold the team accountable for AI code quality and own AI feature delivery. Ensure AI is used responsibly and in line with TRG Screen’s AI governance standards.
Security & communication – Treat secure coding and supply-chain hygiene as standard work. Foster a culture of clear communication, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback across the team and stakeholders.

Required

Skills and Qualifications

5 years of relevant industry experience building production-grade software solutions using an enterprise-grade stack. C# / .NET experience is preferred, though candidates with a strong background in comparable languages such as Java or Go are welcome to apply.
2+ years of people-management experience, with a proven ability to coach and develop engineers at varying levels.
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Continuous Delivery, developer velocity, and DevOps concepts.
Demonstrable experience managing team performance – setting expectations, conducting reviews, and supporting career growth.
Track record of managing delivery – planning, tracking, and communicating progress clearly to stakeholders at multiple levels.
Comfortable engaging in technical discussions at team level; able to represent and be accountable for the team’s technical output.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to tailor communication to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working in cross-functional environments alongside Product Management, Design, and Client Success.

Preferred

Background in financial services, market data, or a regulated technology environment.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tooling.
Familiarity with AI developer tooling (e.g. Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and experience driving adoption responsibly within an engineering team.
Exposure to cloud platforms, with AWS preferred.
Experience participating in security reviews, DDQs, or ISO 27001 audit processes.
Experience leading or contributing to technology modernisation programmes – including legacy migration, re-platforming, or the introduction of modern engineering practices into established codebases.

Leadership Qualities

People-first mindset – genuine investment in the growth and wellbeing of the team.
Clear decision-maker who takes ownership and learns from mistakes without defensiveness.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity; able to act responsibly without the full picture.
Economic thinker – able to frame trade-offs clearly and make pragmatic, business-aligned decisions.
Proactive problem solver who anticipates issues before they escalate.
Builds trust quickly across functions and levels; communicates with candour and respect.

Join TRG Screen and unlock your potential in an environment where innovation thrives, opportunities abound, and your contributions make a difference. We are an equal opportunities employer. We recognise and value the power of diversity in our workplace and are committed to being an employer of choice for everyone. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
jobs.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.

The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability
Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful
Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable
Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design
Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network
(Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About You

5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks
Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality
Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Bonus points

Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!)
Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs
Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)
Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)
Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3)
Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments

How we work

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open fully remote, or hybrid from our Berlin, Germany hub if you prefer time with the team in person.

jobs.description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.

Job Title:
Full Stack Developer - CT Office Incubation Team

Location:
London, UK; Cambridge, UK; or Milan, Italy – (Hybrid, 50% On-site)

Employment Type:
Full-time

The job

AVEVA’s Chief Technology Office drives emerging-technology innovation from early signals to real-world impact by scouting technology and market trends and then maturing capabilities such as Industrial AI, Digital Twins, robotics, simulation, visualization, and edge-to-cloud technologies through hands-on technical evaluation, experimentation, and rapid prototyping. The CT Office Incubation Team turns emerging technology ideas into working prototypes that can be validated with customers, partners, and internal teams.

As a Full Stack Developer, you will help build end-to-end prototype solutions (UI, APIs, data integration, and cloud/edge deployment) to test new concepts in Digital Twins, Industrial AI, robotics, simulation, and visualization. You’ll work in small, fast-moving, multidisciplinary teams, collaborating with engineers, researchers, product and solution specialists, and industrial domain experts. This role suits an early-career developer who enjoys learning quickly, working across the stack, and turning ideas into functional software—valuing curiosity, practical problem-solving, and clear communication alongside coding skills.

Key Responsibilities

Support the build of full‑stack prototypes by implementing and testing frontend, backend, APIs, and basic data integrations under guidance.
Help turn product ideas into small, testable demos by contributing to minimum-viable implementations and iterating quickly.
Develop and maintain simple, well-documented REST APIs and integrations (including event-driven patterns when needed) for internal and customer-facing prototype environments.
Use AI-assisted coding tools effectively and responsibly, while learning to validate generated code for correctness, security, quality, and IP compliance with support from senior engineers.
Improve reliability and demo readiness by fixing bugs, adding basic tests, and ensuring prototypes can be set up and reproduced by others.
Apply baseline security best practices (secrets handling, dependency hygiene, access control awareness, safe data handling) following team standards.
Troubleshoot prototype applications using logs and basic observability tools; escalate issues early with clear context.
Document your work clearly (setup steps, API notes, known limitations, assumptions) to help teammates and future reuse.
Collaborate with cross-functional teammates (product, researchers, solution architects, domain experts) and participate in team practices such as PR reviews, while building confidence in providing feedback.
Contribute small reusable components and templates and grow your knowledge of industrial software topics (Digital Twins, simulation, industrial data, robotics, edge/visualization) over time.

Essential Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or equivalent hands-on experience) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Maths/Physics, or a related field.
1–3 years of practical coding experience through a mix of internships, junior roles, university projects, open-source, or personal projects.
Experience building end-to-end applications or prototypes, covering both backend and basic frontend components.
Working knowledge of at least one backend stack (e.g., Python, Rust, Java, Node.js, C) and a willingness to learn new tools as needed.
Familiarity with REST APIs, basic database concepts (relational and/or NoSQL), and software engineering fundamentals (testing, debugging, modular design, incremental delivery).

Exposure to modern cloud technologies and enterprise-scale projects.

Job details

Aberdeen, Birmingham, Bristol, Cambridge, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Gatwick, Glasgow, Leeds, Liverpool, London, Manchester, Milton Keynes, Newcastle upon Tyne, Nottingham, Reading, South Coast - Southampton, Watford

Job description
Role Type: Hybrid working
The Team

The Audit Technology team at KPMG is driving innovation at the intersection of auditing and advanced technological solutions, reshaping the future of audit delivery. By combining expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, and Software Development, the team is revolutionising the auditing process to deliver smarter, faster, and more reliable outcomes.

Our mission is to design and implement robust, intelligent, and scalable technologies that not only streamline workflows but also enhance audit quality and generate actionable insights for auditors and clients. Through harnessing the power of cutting-edge tools, we aim to transform traditional audit practices into dynamic, forward-thinking processes that are built for the complexities of the modern business environment.

Our team, supported by KPMG’s global network, serves as the driving force behind this transformative journey. Focused on innovation, this team is dedicated to engineering solutions today that anticipate the challenges and opportunities of tomorrow, ensuring that audit services remain at the forefront of technological progression.

The Role

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in transforming advanced AI concepts into impactful, production-ready solutions within the Audit Technology team. You will lead a dedicated AI engineering squad, working closely with data scientists, data engineers, software developers, cloud architects, and audit professionals to build and scale AI-driven systems that enhance audit quality, efficiency, and insight generation.

From developing robust proof-of-concepts to deploying enterprise-grade solutions, you will apply your expertise in AI engineering, cloud platforms, and technologies such as Generative AI, Azure, Databricks to embed intelligence into critical audit workflows and products.

In addition to technical leadership, you will shape the growth of the team—mentoring engineers, promoting best practices, and fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. You will stay at the forefront of AI engineering trends, advocate for modern development methodologies, and drive knowledge-sharing across both the technology and audit domains.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Mentorship: Lead a high-performing AI engineering team comprising software engineers and AI practitioners. Provide hands-on technical direction, foster career growth, and cultivate a collaborative culture that emphasizes engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Scalable AI Engineering: Drive the design, development, and deployment of production-grade AI systems tailored to audit applications. Ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and maintainable by applying strong software engineering principles, MLOps practices, and cloud-native development.
End-to-End AI Solution Delivery: Oversee the full lifecycle of AI product engineering—from architectural design and prototyping to CI/CD-enabled deployment—using modern platforms and tools such as Azure ML, Databricks, MLflow, LangChain and LangGraph. Champion automation, testing, and observability across pipelines.
Operational Excellence: Define reusable development patterns, enforce coding standards, and promote MLOps best practices that support version control, performance optimisation, and maintainability.
Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Partner closely with data scientists, product managers, platform engineers, and QA teams to align on technical requirements, delivery timelines, and integration plans. Ensure AI capabilities are well-embedded within core audit platforms and services.
AI Governance & Risk Management: Implement engineering controls to support responsible AI use, including model monitoring, explainability, security, and auditability. Contribute to the operationalisation of AI governance frameworks to ensure regulatory and ethical compliance.
Capability Building & Knowledge Sharing: Drive initiatives to enhance internal capabilities, empowering team members and the broader Audit Technology function with the skills and knowledge to adopt and adapt AI innovations effectively.

Requirements

Bachelor (preferably master or PhD) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent professional experience.
Strong knowledge of generative AI, machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing and other relevant AI fields.
Proven track record of designing, developing, and deploying AI systems in production environments.
Proficient in Python and key ML libraries (e.g. PyTorch, PySpark, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers).
Hands-on experience with modern data platforms and AI tooling such as Azure ML, Databricks, MLflow, LangChain, LangGraph.
Proven experience with modern engineering practices Git, version control, unit testing and containerisation.
Familiarity with agile work methodologies and tools like Jira and Confluence.
Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Advanced certifications in AI, machine learning, cloud computing or data engineering are highly advantageous.
Professional accounting qualification preferred, however not a requirement.

Why Audit at KPMG?

Audit is the largest of our UK practices. Some of the world’s biggest companies rely on us to provide independent insight, challenge and expertise, so the work we undertake affects investment decisions, inspires confidence in public sector expenditure and supports our economic growth. Today, more than ever in disruptive times, audit is a function needed by society, and in the future, so we can capitalise, and grow. As part of the Audit team, you’ll be helping to build the confidence and trust that business and society need to thrive. We want to lead the conversation when it comes to shaping the future of the profession. And given the scale and variety of our audit engagements in both the UK and globally, we are well placed to create change. If you share our commitment to achieving excellence and working to the highest audit standards, are a natural collaborator who values different perspectives and relishes the opportunity to develop and progress - then KPMG could be the place where you can thrive.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer
to shape the architecture and delivery of our modern, AWS-native platform powering underwriting intelligence, GenAI-driven analysis, and high-volume content processing.

Working across Python, .NET, PostgreSQL/Aurora, OpenSearch, and LangGraph-based services
, you will own technical direction, system quality, scalability, and reliability across the platform. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant technical leadership responsibility, including setting engineering standards, mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and coordinating across product and platform teams
.

Responsibilities

Shape platform architecture across ingestion, transformation, storage, APIs, and AI-powered services, ensuring scalability, resilience, and maintainability.
Own end-to-end technical delivery of AWS Batch content pipelines, Lambda-based workflows, and .NET 8 REST/GraphQL APIs.
Drive architecture decisions around Aurora PostgreSQL, graph-based data models, and OpenSearch to support GenAI retrieval and high-volume workloads.
Define and champion engineering, data quality, testing, and observability standards across platforms including Pentaho, ThoughtSpot, CloudWatch, and Splunk.
Partner with ML and Product Engineering teams to ensure LangGraph-based RAG pipelines have reliable, current, and well-structured data and service layers.
Shape LLM evaluation and prompt data pipelines, including ground-truth and synthetic datasets for testing and model quality.
Apply senior technical judgment to review and validate AI-assisted engineering output before production deployment.
Lead architecture discussions through technical briefs, RFCs, design reviews, and documented trade-offs.
Define testing, rollout, monitoring, and rollback strategies for critical platform changes.
Lead production incident reviews and postmortems, driving actions that improve reliability and operational resilience.
Establish and evolve engineering standards and best practices, reinforcing them through code reviews and practical examples.
Mentor engineers on software architecture, data engineering, design patterns, and responsible AI-assisted development.
Coordinate technical dependencies across product squads, ensuring clear interfaces, effective collaboration, and smooth delivery.
Communicate technical decisions, risks, dependencies, and delivery impacts clearly to engineering and business stakeholders.

Qualifications

Extensive software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating production systems and data pipelines at scale.
Strong software architecture and system design expertise, with experience making and documenting complex technical trade-offs.
Advanced experience with .NET / C#, including production services and APIs using REST and GraphQL.
Deep hands-on experience with AWS, including S3, Batch, Lambda, SNS, RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, EKS, and CloudWatch.
Strong SQL and PostgreSQL expertise, including schema design, query optimization, and graph-based data modelling.
Experience designing distributed, scalable, and fault-tolerant systems, with robust observability, recovery, and rollback strategies.
Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed services, using logs, metrics, and traces with tools such as Splunk and CloudWatch.
Experience with CI/CD and Agile delivery, using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring engineers, leading design reviews and RFCs, and coordinating across teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice To Have

Python 3.10+ experience, including Pandas, BeautifulSoup, and XML/HTML processing.
Hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or other LLM/agentic frameworks.
Experience with OpenSearch or vector search technologies for RAG applications.
