The opportunity to shape the architecture of a modern, AWS-native platform with significant technical ownership.
The chance to work with cutting-edge technologies across cloud, data engineering, GenAI, and AI-powered services.
A collaborative environment where you can influence engineering standards, mentor engineers, and drive technical decisions.

Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

Copilot Studio Architect
works within a technologically versatile team located in Poland, providing consulting services to biggest market players in EMEIA region and around the globe.

The opportunity

With a constant growth of our business and customers’ needs we are willing to move our projects on the new track. We are able to offer you a senior developer role with opportunity to support your further professional growth. You will work as part of a team that designs, develops, tests, deploys and supports different types of solutions using Power Platform, RPA and other modern technologies. You will work with the most recognizable and influential players on the financial markets within the challenging projects.

Your Key Responsibilities

Design and deliver end-to-end agentic AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform
Build scalable, secure architectures with strong focus on enterprise readiness
Develop advanced integrations with systems like SAP using APIs, custom connectors, and Azure services
Implement identity & access management patterns, including principal propagation (ensuring agents correctly inherit user permissions across systems)
Define how agents are authenticated and authorized when accessing external systems (e.g., retrieving invoice data or status from SAP)
Work hands-on with pro-code extensions (Microsoft AI stack, agent frameworks) for complex scenarios
Lead client engagements: shape vision, design solutions, run workshops, and present architectures
Support pre-sales activities (demos, PoCs, proposals) and contribute to AI/automation offerings

Skills And Attributes For Success

We are looking for experienced individuals with RPA and/or Power Platform skills, ready to further develop their technical and consulting skills across a variety of business processes, who are able to work independently but also as a part of a team.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio and agentic AI solutions
Solid background in integration design (REST APIs, OAuth, identity propagation patterns)
Strong experience with Power Platform architecture (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
Expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, service principals, and managed identities
Ability to design complex solutions independently and clearly communicate them to stakeholders
Strong consulting and problem-solving mindset

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience integrating Copilot Studio / Power Platform with SAP
Experience working with Agent365 or at least thorough understanding of capabilities and implementation best practices
Familiarity with agent frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, AutoGen)
Pro-code development skills (.NET, C#, JavaScript)
Experience with custom connectors and API management

What We Look For

We love working with people who are passionate about their job and have great interpersonal skills, who are ready to face new professional challenges. Are you a person with a good sense of humor and open to significantly extend your skillset? If yes, it’s a role for you.

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

jobs.title: L3 Support Engineer
jobs.description:
About the project:

US-based home medical equipment providers and hospitals run on tight schedules — missed deliveries, billing errors, and documentation gaps have real consequences. We're building a centralized SaaS platform that handles the operational backbone for these providers: scheduling, invoicing, documentation, and medical item logistics. The system is live, growing, and needs someone who can hold the line when things get complex.

A new team member will be in charge of:

Own the L3 escalation layer — be the last technical stop before an issue reaches the development team, and make sure most don't need to.
Diagnose and resolve deep-level issues across backend services, APIs, and databases, with a clear path to permanent fixes — not just workarounds.
Drive root cause analysis in close collaboration with dev and DevOps, turning recurring incidents into documented, solved problems.
Keep the knowledge base current — incidents, solutions, and patterns that actually help the next person on shift.
Support releases and bug fix validation from the operational side, including CI/CD touchpoints.

Does this relate to you?

3–5+ years in IT support roles, with hands-on experience in SaaS or enterprise application environments.
Solid experience troubleshooting .NET-based applications — C# and ASP.NET Core specifically. This is a hard requirement.
Strong grasp of microservices architecture — you understand how services talk to each other and where things break down.
Comfortable working with MySQL or PostgreSQL at a diagnostic level — reading query plans, spotting data issues, tracing DB-side failures.
Familiar with API troubleshooting, authentication flows, and authorization patterns — you know what a broken token or a misconfigured scope looks like.

Upper-Intermediate English or above — enough to communicate clearly with a US-based client team in writing and on calls.

Available to start your working day at 2PM CET time. This is a firm schedule requirement tied to client timezone overlap.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines from an operational or support perspective is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Integrations & Enrich
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE Cognism is the leading provider of European B2B data and sales intelligence. Ambitious businesses of every size use our platform to discover, connect, and engage with qualified decision-makers faster and close more deals. Headquartered in London with global offices, Cognism’s contact data and contextual signals are trusted by thousands of revenue teams to eliminate the guesswork from prospecting.
About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer within the Integrations & Enrich domain, you will build the capabilities that connect Cognism with customers' technology ecosystems. Your work will focus on CRM integrations, enrichment workflows, synchronization services and customer-facing data experiences. You will help enterprise customers seamlessly move trusted Cognism data into platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot and other business applications.  

What You'll Do

Design and develop backend services supporting CRM integrations and enrichment workflows

Build scalable APIs enabling secure data exchange between  Cognism and customer platforms

Own software throughout its lifecycle, from design through production operations

Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Customer Success, Data Engineering and Platform teams

Improve integration reliability,  synchronization   performance and customer experience

Write high-quality automated tests and  participate in code reviews

Contribute to architecture discussions and engineering best practices

Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and quality

Technology Environment

Cloud-native backend services running on AWS

REST APIs and event-driven microservices

CRM integrations (Salesforce,  HubSpot and similar ecosystems)

Kafka and asynchronous messaging

SQL / NoSQL databases  

Modern CI/CD pipelines and automated testing

What Success Looks Like

Reliable customer integrations with measurable improvements in stability and performance

High-quality enrichment services  supporting enterprise customers

Production ownership with rapid issue resolution

Reusable engineering components adopted across multiple product teams

Continuous improvements in customer experience and engineering quality  

Required Experience

5+ years of professional software engineering experience

Strong backend engineering skills using Java, Scala, Kotlin, C# or modern TypeScript/Node.js

Experience building APIs and system integrations

Knowledge of distributed systems and asynchronous processing

Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform

Understanding of CI/CD, automated  testing and production support

Excellent communication skills and fluent English

Nice to Have

Experience integrating with Salesforce, HubSpot or other CRM platforms

Knowledge of event streaming using Kafka

Experience with ETL or data enrichment pipelines

Infrastructure as Code and Kubernetes

Experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot

 WHY COGNISM At Cognism, we’re not just building a company - we’re building an inclusive community of brilliant, diverse people who  support, challenge, and inspire each other every day
. If you’re looking for a place where your work truly  makes an impact
, you’re in the right spot!
Our values aren’t just words on a page—they guide how we work, how we treat each other, and how we grow together. They shape our culture, drive our success, and ensure that everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to do their best work.
Here’s what we stand for:
🤝 We Own the Outcome Together.

🤓  We Deeply Understand our Customers. 

🏆  We Celebrate Impact Wherever It Comes From.

At Cognism, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and supportive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals typically underrepresented in tech, so if this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer
jobs.description:
It's more than a job

Kuehne+Nagel is one of the world's leading logistics providers. To strengthen our global Contract Logistics IT organization, we are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer (Development) to join our international engineering team.

In this role, you will design, develop, and implement scalable solutions that support warehouse and logistics operations across our global technology landscape. Working with Blue Yonder WMS (MOCA, SaaS) and KN SwiftLOG, you will combine software engineering, solution design, stakeholder management, and technical leadership to deliver high-quality solutions throughout the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

This position offers the opportunity to work on business-critical logistics platforms within a collaborative international environment focused on innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.

‎

As a Senior Solution Engineer (Development), you will take ownership of designing, building, testing, and supporting technical solutions for global warehouse and logistics platforms. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and operations teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.

Besides development, you will contribute to solution architecture, technical governance, testing, deployments, and continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring solutions meet enterprise standards for quality, performance, and security.

How you create impact

Design, develop, configure, and implement scalable solutions within Blue Yonder WMS (MOCA, SaaS) and KN SwiftLOG platforms
Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate functional and technical requirements into robust solution designs
Support the full Software Development Life Cycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and hypercare
Develop integrations, APIs, and data flows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and coding standards
Perform root cause analysis, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and provide L2/L3 support during stabilization
Monitor application performance, optimize system reliability, and drive technical improvements
Maintain technical documentation and promote knowledge sharing, reusable assets, and engineering best practices
Contribute to governance, security, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives across the global engineering organization

What we would like you to bring

Strong experience with Blue Yonder WMS (MOCA framework, SaaS), including custom development, configuration, and integrations
Experience with APIs, SQL, system integrations, CI/CD practices, Agile methodologies, and the Software Development Life Cycle
Strong software engineering skills with experience in debugging, performance optimization, secure coding, and technical problem solving
Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders in an international environment
Experience within logistics, warehouse management, or supply chain systems is highly desirable; familiarity with KN SwiftLOG, cloud/SaaS environments, or DevOps practices is considered an advantage

What's in it for you

This role offers the opportunity to work on global warehouse and logistics platforms used across large-scale international operations. You will combine solution engineering, software development, architecture, and technical leadership while collaborating with colleagues across multiple countries.

Working with modern warehouse technologies, cloud platforms, and enterprise logistics systems, you will help shape the future of digital logistics by delivering innovative, scalable, and business-critical solutions. At the same time, you will continue to develop your technical expertise within an international engineering team focused on innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

We kindly advise that placement agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited profiles. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Tworzymy zespół AI & Agents w Ringier Axel Springer Polska. Budujemy wewnętrzne, produkcyjne platformy klasy enterprise dla ponad 1500 pracowników od infrastruktury AWS, przez backend i współdzielone kontrakty domenowe, aż po frontend.

Jak pracujemy? Kod nie jest już wąskim gardłem. Większość naszej bazy kodu powstaje przy użyciu systemów opartych na agentach programistycznych, działających w oparciu o ludzki projekt i weryfikację. Kluczowe umiejętności to architektura, ocena rozwiązań i orkiestracja: projektujesz system, sterujesz agentami, weryfikujesz zmiany i odpowiadasz za finalny produkt.

Działa to w obie strony agenci funkcjonują również wewnątrz samych produktów.

Chatboty, voiceboty, asystenci oraz systemy klasyfikacji, ekstrakcji danych i podejmowania decyzji usprawniają procesy biznesowe, ograniczając liczbę kliknięć i pracy ręcznej.

Czym się będziesz zajmował/a?

Kompleksową odpowiedzialnością za produkty od wyzwania biznesowego, przez architekturę i wdrożenie, po utrzymanie.
Prowadzeniem inicjatyw, wyznaczaniem kierunku, kwestionowaniem założeń i angażowaniem zespołu.
Kierowaniem pracą coding agents (np. Claude Code) przy zadaniach produkcyjnych dekompozycją problemów, zarządzaniem kontekstem, sterowaniem agentami i weryfikacją wygenerowanych zmian.
Projektowaniem agentic workflows i środowiska pracy agentów (harness) z wykorzystaniem Agent Skills, sub-agents, custom commands i MCP wspierających cały cykl życia produktu: od specyfikacji po wdrożenie i utrzymanie.
Wdrażaniem LLM-ów bezpośrednio w produktach, z wykorzystaniem RAG, pamięci, pipeline’ów, pętli agentowych i mechanizmów ewaluacji, przy zachowaniu odpowiednich guardrails i modelu human-in-the-loop.
Budowaniem end-to-end w monorepo TypeScriptowym: React, Node.js/Express, Zod, XState, Drizzle, Terraform/Terragrunt i GitHub Actions, na AWS (Lambda, SQS, ECS/Fargate, Aurora, S3).
Integracją z Entra ID, Teams, Azure OpenAI, SAP i Copilot Studio oraz współpracą bezpośrednio z biznesem i użytkownikami.

Czego oczekujemy?

Solidnego doświadczenia z React/TypeScript i Node.js oraz projektowania i wdrażania produkcyjnych systemów end-to-end.
Znajomości nowoczesnej architektury webowej: SPA, CDN, caching, usługi warstwowe, streaming, WebSockets.
Codziennego, praktycznego doświadczenia z coding agents (np. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) przy pracy z produkcyjnym kodem.
Znajomości praktyk agentic engineering: specyfikacje i plany, agentic workflow, praca równoległa, MCP, integracja z CI/CD oraz świadome zarządzanie ograniczeniami agentów.
Doświadczenia w budowaniu AI/LLM jako części logiki biznesowej produktu, a nie tylko dodatkowego interfejsu chatowego w tym RAG, pipelines, agent loops, ewaluacje i pamięć.
Dużej samodzielności potrafisz przeprowadzić problem od niejasnego wymagania do gotowego produktu.
Praktycznego doświadczenia z AWS i nastawienia produktowego.

Mile Widziane

Znajomość technologii: XState, Drizzle; Copilot Studio / Power Platform; Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Teams oraz Adaptive Cards.

Kompleksową odpowiedzialnością za produkty od wyzwania biznesowego, przez architekturę i wdrożenie, po utrzymanie.
Prowadzeniem inicjatyw, wyznaczaniem kierunku, kwestionowaniem założeń i angażowaniem zespołu.
Kierowaniem pracą coding agents (np. Claude Code) przy zadaniach produkcyjnych dekompozycją problemów, zarządzaniem kontekstem, sterowaniem agentami i weryfikacją wygenerowanych zmian.
Projektowaniem agentic workflows i środowiska pracy agentów (harness) z wykorzystaniem Agent Skills, sub-agents, custom commands i MCP wspierających cały cykl życia produktu: od specyfikacji po wdrożenie i utrzymanie.
Wdrażaniem LLM-ów bezpośrednio w produktach, z wykorzystaniem RAG, pamięci, pipeline’ów, pętli agentowych i mechanizmów ewaluacji, przy zachowaniu odpowiednich guardrails i modelu human-in-the-loop.
Budowaniem end-to-end w monorepo TypeScriptowym: React, Node.js/Express, Zod, XState, Drizzle, Terraform/Terragrunt i GitHub Actions, na AWS (Lambda, SQS, ECS/Fargate, Aurora, S3).
Integracją z Entra ID, Teams, Azure OpenAI, SAP i Copilot Studio oraz współpracą bezpośrednio z biznesem i użytkownikami.

Czego oczekujemy?

Solidnego doświadczenia z React/TypeScript i Node.js oraz projektowania i wdrażania produkcyjnych systemów end-to-end.
Znajomości nowoczesnej architektury webowej: SPA, CDN, caching, usługi warstwowe, streaming, WebSockets.
Codziennego, praktycznego doświadczenia z coding agents (np. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) przy pracy z produkcyjnym kodem.
Znajomości praktyk agentic engineering: specyfikacje i plany, agentic workflow, praca równoległa, MCP, integracja z CI/CD oraz świadome zarządzanie ograniczeniami agentów.
Doświadczenia w budowaniu AI/LLM jako części logiki biznesowej produktu, a nie tylko dodatkowego interfejsu chatowego w tym RAG, pipelines, agent loops, ewaluacje i pamięć.
Dużej samodzielności potrafisz przeprowadzić problem od niejasnego wymagania do gotowego produktu.
Praktycznego doświadczenia z AWS i nastawienia produktowego.

Mile Widziane

Znajomość technologii: XState, Drizzle; Copilot Studio / Power Platform; Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Teams oraz Adaptive Cards.

looking for exceptional talent to join our growing international team. Our employees combine technical expertise, analytical thinking and interpersonal skills

Start your IT career with real projects, international clients and hands-on experience.

Looking for your first hands-on experience in IT?

Join GGS IT Consulting for a 6-month on-site internship in Kraków.
You’ll work alongside experienced consultants, learn from a dedicated mentor and contribute to real automation projects for international clients.

contribute to process automation solutions for international clients under the guidance of experienced consultants,

collaborate with experienced consultants, developers and clients,

basic knowledge of IT Process Automation,

hands-on experience with real business projects,

opportunities for professional development,

subsidized English classes ,

jobs.description:
Project description

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.
Compensation for Toronto, Ontario: 80000-135000 CAD Gross per year based on your interview results.
Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.

Responsibilities

Must know the following technologies: MxML Exchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart
Knowledge and hands on experience in implementing, developing and supporting various MX.3 proprietary modules for Enterprise Integration such as MxML Exchange, Datamart, MX.3 Accessibility and Extensibility APIs (.Net, Java, C++, and SOAP/REST Web services), Real-time bridging service, Market Data Cache Server, MX.3 Connectivity 2.0 framework, MX.3 Packaged interfaces including (but not limited to) MarkitWire, DTCC Global Trade Repository, MarginSphere, IceLink, FXAll, Market Data Import Tool etc., MX.3 End of Day processes and Trade Life Cycle Management using workflows engine. (At least 3 years)
Build new up / down stream integration(s)
Convert existing integration point with Murex version change
Development of MxML (Workflows, Exchange)
XSL / Transformation
Scripting (bsh, ksh, ...etc.)
Assist existing support group(s) in resolving integration related request or issues
Contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables
Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)
Liaise with technical team(s) -
when needed -
to resolve environment related issues and necessary enhancements in preparation for cloud deployment
Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables
Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)
Seniority: Flexible but preferably mid-level or juniors with some Murex experience beyond just trainings.
Provide professional services to Murex clients:
Provide services in the domain of system integration, business intelligence and data flows through the full lifecycle of the MX.3: requirements analysis, configuration build, installation, training, upgrade, and production support.
Professionally interact with Murex colleagues and clients.
Build, test, and provide support to clients on MX.3 integration modules.
Contribute to project implementations
Participate in design, build, and test phases sometimes remotely and other times at the client site as needed.
Develop trade workflows and interfaces to set up communication between external platforms and murex to receive trade and other data feeds, process them, save into the system, and send acknowledgement. Use a combination of MXMLExchange, MXopenconnect, Murex APIs, and Datamart to successfully deliver such solutions.
Contribute to functional documentation of the test cases and use cases by the client.
Contribute to Design documentation for the Build process of the Product.
Develop and maintain end-to-end configuration management packages etc. Install, Deploy and test Murex packaged interfaces like MDIT (market data interface tool), Markitwire, BSMT and MarkitCredit to receive live and end-of-day data from external providers like Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, etc.
Handle support cases from notification to resolution and validation.
Participate in the business as usual and project support: follow-up of client open cases through email, CRM portal, phone-calls and on-site visits
Develop an understanding of ongoing activities and manage own deliverables / progress
Manage bug fixes and enhancements with the Product Team
Integrate with various teams to deliver the right solution to client.
Work with S4C stream leads, Front-Office, Back-Office, or Risk teams to understand requirements and develop solutions for the client.
Work with the Product division team to provide them timely details on defects – how to reproduce the issue, project/client constraints, and how to validate the fix.
Follow up with the S4C stream leads, the Project Manager, and other teams to meet deadlines and regular meetings to make sure the delivery is on time.
Work with technologies including SQL, Unix, and Murex proprietary standards like Murex Scripting Language (MSL), XMLF, etc. for client solutions.
Use SQL for end-of-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.
Java programming skills are not essential but are a plus.
Various Murex proprietary languages and formats: Data Query Language for querying in various screens in MX.3, MSL (Murex Scripting Language) for pre-trade logic, XMLF for post-trade flow processing, MxML in various contexts, etc.
Create shell/python scripts for automation of day-to-day manual activities.
Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre
trade and post-trade workflow, and integration points.

Skills

Must have

Must:

4+ years experience with Murex Datamart and workflows
Must know any 2 of the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart, C2.0 Product interfaces
SQL; XML; MxML; UNIX; Scripting languages
Hands on experience with Murex MxML Exchange development
Knowledge of pre trade framework along with MSL scripting language
Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology
Knowledge of XML/JSON and related technologies (XSLT), Java/J2EE, Python, or C/C++ or C#, and scripting languages such as UNIX Shell or JavaScript, Jenkins, CI/CD, DevOps, Maven, Git/Bitbucket, Apache Camel, ESB, ETL
Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems
Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills
Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter
Possess good verbal and written communication skills
Must have strong organization skills
Previous Experience in Murex Integration (MxML/WF) experience
Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology
Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems
Strong DataMart Murex knowledge is a must
Rigorous attention to detail

Nice to have

Understanding of Test management
Understanding of Trade life cycle
Understanding of Market Data management
Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft's aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.
Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.
Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.
Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.
Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.
Analytical decision-making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions.

Languages

English: C2 Proficient

Regular

This is not a traditional Staff Engineer position. You will become one of the founding senior technical leaders responsible for shaping the architecture, engineering standards and technical culture of the Warsaw Hub. You will work on the strategic DaaS, API and MCP platform that enables enterprise customers and AI agents to consume Cognism data at scale.  
What You Will Own

Technical ownership of critical platform capabilities across multiple engineering teams

Architecture of distributed backend systems supporting APIs, MCP and enterprise integrations

Engineering standards covering code quality, reliability, observability and maintainability

Mentoring Senior Engineers and acting as a technical advisor for Engineering Managers and Product Managers

Driving architectural decisions balancing customer value, scalability and operational simplicity

What Success Looks Like After 12 Months

Key platform capabilities delivered to production

Measurable improvements in reliability, scalability and engineering velocity

Architecture decisions documented and adopted across teams

Warsaw Hub recognised for engineering excellence and technical leadership

Required Experience

8+ years building large-scale backend systems

Strong software architecture experience in distributed systems

Hands-on expertise with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)

Experience with event-driven architectures, APIs and microservices

Excellent communication and mentoring skills

Ability to influence without formal authority

Preferred Experience

Kafka, Kubernetes, Terraform

Scala, Java, Kotlin or modern TypeScript/Node.js

Observability platforms such as Grafana or Prometheus

AI-assisted software development using Claude, GitHub Copilot or similar tools

Why Join Cognism

Joining now means becoming part of the founding engineering team building Cognism's Warsaw Hub from the ground up. You will influence technology choices, engineering practices and organisational culture while solving complex data-platform challenges with direct business impact.  
Our Hiring Process

Recruiter conversation
Hiring Manager interview
Technical architecture interview
System design session
Leadership conversation  

 WHY COGNISM At Cognism, we’re not just building a company - we’re building an inclusive community of brilliant, diverse people who  support, challenge, and inspire each other every day
. If you’re looking for a place where your work truly  makes an impact
, you’re in the right spot!
Our values aren’t just words on a page—they guide how we work, how we treat each other, and how we grow together. They shape our culture, drive our success, and ensure that everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to do their best work.
Here’s what we stand for:
🤝 We Own the Outcome Together.

🤓  We Deeply Understand our Customers. 

🏆  We Celebrate Impact Wherever It Comes From.

At Cognism, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and supportive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals typically underrepresented in tech, so if this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply!

Our client develops IT solutions, mainly for prestigious clients in the financial and automotive sectors.

Backend .Net Developer

Asynchronous architecture - message queues (RabbitMQ or equivalent), request-callback pattern, idempotency, persistence of exchange state
Good knowledge of databases

Git in gitflow model
English language proficiency for reading technical documentation

Ability to work independently

jobs.title: Copilot Studio Architect
jobs.description:
Location: Katowice/Wrocław/Warsaw - 2 days in office / 3 days remote

Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

Copilot Studio Architect
works within a technologically versatile team located in Poland, providing consulting services to biggest market players in EMEIA region and around the globe.

The opportunity

With a constant growth of our business and customers’ needs we are willing to move our projects on the new track. We are able to offer you a senior developer role with opportunity to support your further professional growth. You will work as part of a team that designs, develops, tests, deploys and supports different types of solutions using Power Platform, RPA and other modern technologies. You will work with the most recognizable and influential players on the financial markets within the challenging projects.

Your Key Responsibilities

Design and deliver end-to-end agentic AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform
Build scalable, secure architectures with strong focus on enterprise readiness
Develop advanced integrations with systems like SAP using APIs, custom connectors, and Azure services
Implement identity & access management patterns, including principal propagation (ensuring agents correctly inherit user permissions across systems)
Define how agents are authenticated and authorized when accessing external systems (e.g., retrieving invoice data or status from SAP)
Work hands-on with pro-code extensions (Microsoft AI stack, agent frameworks) for complex scenarios
Lead client engagements: shape vision, design solutions, run workshops, and present architectures
Support pre-sales activities (demos, PoCs, proposals) and contribute to AI/automation offerings

Skills And Attributes For Success

We are looking for experienced individuals with RPA and/or Power Platform skills, ready to further develop their technical and consulting skills across a variety of business processes, who are able to work independently but also as a part of a team.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio and agentic AI solutions
Solid background in integration design (REST APIs, OAuth, identity propagation patterns)
Strong experience with Power Platform architecture (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
Expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, service principals, and managed identities
Ability to design complex solutions independently and clearly communicate them to stakeholders
Strong consulting and problem-solving mindset

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience integrating Copilot Studio / Power Platform with SAP
Experience working with Agent365 or at least thorough understanding of capabilities and implementation best practices
Familiarity with agent frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, AutoGen)
Pro-code development skills (.NET, C#, JavaScript)
Experience with custom connectors and API management

What We Look For

We love working with people who are passionate about their job and have great interpersonal skills, who are ready to face new professional challenges. Are you a person with a good sense of humor and open to significantly extend your skillset? If yes, it’s a role for you.

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The Exceptional EY Experience. It’s Yours To Build.

In compliance with the requirements of the Whistleblower Protection Act, our company has established the Procedure for reporting breaches of law and undertaking appropriate follow-up actions . Any misconduct should be reported through the EY Ethics Hotline.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect (rola projektowa)
jobs.description:
Pomagamy naszym Klientom definiować ścieżkę transformacji w oparciu o najnowsze technologie – odkrywamy innowacyjne pomysły dzięki analizie danych, tworzymy wyjątkowe doświadczenia dla klientów, wspieramy redukcję kosztów i promujemy nowoczesne, zespołowe podejście do pracy. Dołącz do nas i bądź częścią projektów, które realnie zmieniają sposób działania firm!

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy:

Solutions Architect (rola projektowa)

Twoja przyszła rola:

ustanawianie standardów w zakresie projektowania, developmentu, jakości i testów,
projektowanie i komunikowanie architektury systemowej dla rozwiązań enterprise,
projektowanie interoperacyjności i integracji między systemami,
analiza potrzeb, zbieranie wymagań i przekładanie ich na architekturę systemową,
mapowanie celów biznesowych, korzyści projektowych, priorytetów oraz komponentów i funkcji systemowych,
analiza istniejących systemów i identyfikacja możliwych opcji rozwiązania,
utrzymanie i monitorowanie architektury w całym cyklu życia systemu,
szacowanie i estymacja prac developerskich,
udział w projektowaniu systemów, testowaniu, zapewnieniu jakości oraz zarządzaniu zmianą,
przygotowywanie dokumentacji systemowej oraz prowadzenie prezentacji technicznych,
prowadzenie zespołów developerskich i nadzorowanie procesów wytwórczych,
wybór i ocena technologii,
zbieranie i interpretacja metryk systemowych,
optymalizacja systemów pod kątem wydajności, bezpieczeństwa i jakości.

Aplikuj jeśli:

posiadasz co najmniej 2 certyfikaty z obszaru architektury lub inżynierii oprogramowania (np. TOGAF Certified, Certified UML Professional, lub równoważn
pełniłeś/-aś rolę kluczowego architekta w rozwoju min. 2 systemów,
jesteś ekspertem/ekspertką w architekturze systemów i projektowaniu rozwiązań enterprise,
masz doświadczenie w planowaniu wydajności i bezpieczeństwa systemów,
bardzo dobrze znasz technologie: bazy danych, application servers, middleware, web servers, directory services, GIS, bezpieczeństwo na platformach Microsoft, integracje i IDE,
biegle projektujesz w UML,
masz doświadczenie w metodykach RUP, ISO12207 oraz Agile,
swobodnie posługujesz się narzędziami modelującymi: Sparx EA, Aris Architect lub podobnymi,
posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie w projektowaniu dużych systemów w architekturze mikroserwisowej,
masz doświadczenie w budowie large knowledge systems,
masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu rozwiązań .NET,
pracowałeś/-aś z: Kafka, SQL Server, Redis, OpenShift/Kubernetes, Azure DevOps,
wykazujesz się znajomością nowych technologii i narzędzi opartych na AI w codziennej pracy (np. automatyzacja zadań, analiza informacji, przygotowywanie treści),
możliwość prowadzenia działalności jako jednoosobowy przedsiębiorca lub podmiot gospodarczy w Polsce (ze względu na projektowy charakter zatrudnienia).

Mile widziane:

doświadczenie w prowadzeniu architektury systemowej w projektach międzynarodowych,
wcześniejsze doświadczenie w roli Lead Architect / Principal Architect,
doświadczenie w optymalizacji systemów pod kątem skalowalności i wysokiej dostępności,
dodatkowe certyfikaty z architektury, chmury lub inżynierii oprogramowania.

Dołączając do nas zyskujesz:

udział w różnorodnych i wymagających projektach, które pozwolą uniknąć rutyny i rozwijać kompetencje doradcze,
hybrydowy model pracy, elastyczne godziny oraz możliwość okazjonalnej pracy zdalnej,
szansę na realizację projektów międzynarodowych oraz sporadyczne wyjazdy służbowe.

Jak wygląda proces rekrutacji?

zaaplikuj,
porozmawiaj telefonicznie z Rekruterką,
poznajmy się lepiej podczas rozmowy rekrutacyjnej!

Administratorem danych osobowych przetwarzanych w celu przeprowadzenia rekrutacji jest PwC Advisory sp. z o.o. sp.k., lub inna spółka z sieci PwC (lista spółek), do której kierujesz aplikację. Jeśli wyrazisz odrębną zgodę, dane osobowe będą przetwarzane również w innych celach zgodnie z treścią udzielonych zgód. Pełną informację o przetwarzaniu danych osobowych oraz o przysługujących Ci prawach znajdziesz w Polityce Prywatności.

jobs.title: Backend .Net Developer
jobs.description:
TeamQuest is a rapidly growing Polish company engaged in the comprehensive HR consulting services, in particular in the recruitment of IT professionals.

Our client develops IT solutions, mainly for prestigious clients in the financial and automotive sectors.

Backend .Net Developer

location: Wrocław, Białystok, Kraków, Warszawa, Łódź, Katowice, Poznań, Rzeszów, Lublin, Gdańsk

Main Responsibilities

Designing and implementing integrations with external systems (SOAP/XML and REST/JSON services), including data model mapping and partner error handling.
Maintaining and developing an asynchronous data exchange mechanism (message queues, callbacks, statuses, request idempotency).
Generating and updating API clients based on OpenAPI contracts provided by the client; responding to contract version changes.
Building and maintaining mocks of external systems for test environments.
Implementing business process logic in a BPMN engine (handlers in C#, process variables, signals) and decision rule models.
Configuring environments (installation parameters, Docker, CI/CD pipeline), participating in preparing releases and hotfixes.
Analyzing defects from business tests and production based on logs, quick fixes, collaborating with client analysts and testers.
Documenting solutions and transferring knowledge within the team.

Requirements

Minimum 3-4 years of experience in a similar position
Very good knowledge of C# and .NET (ASP.NET Core, .NET 8 or newer)
Practical experience with SOAP / XML integrations, REST/OpenAI integrations
Asynchronous architecture - message queues (RabbitMQ or equivalent), request-callback pattern, idempotency, persistence of exchange state
Good knowledge of databases
Mapping of domain models
Docker and CI/CD
Git in gitflow model
English language proficiency for reading technical documentation
Communicative, open to collaboration with client-side personnel
Ability to work independently

Good To Have

Experience in the financial/banking industry or in projects for these industries

We Offer

Attractive salary
Possibility of fully remote work
Real opportunity for professional development
Possibility to genuinely influence the shape of projects

Som Senior .NET-utvecklare blir du en nyckelperson i Skandias AML-team (Anti-Money Laundering), där ni utvecklar systemstöd för att förebygga penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism – ett affärskritiskt uppdrag med tydlig samhällsnytta.

Du arbetar nära både verksamhet och teknik och är delaktig i att designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla stabila och säkra lösningar. Rollen innebär att bidra i design-, arkitektur- och kravdiskussioner samt vara med och fatta tekniska vägval tillsammans med teamet.

Arbetet fokuserar på backendutveckling i .NET/C# och eventdriven arkitektur i en säkerhetskänslig miljö med stora datamängder och höga krav på tillförlitlighet.

Du utvecklar och optimerar integrationer mot andra system, samarbetar nära teamet genom exempelvis par- och mobbprogrammering och bidrar till kontinuerlig förbättring av kod, arbetssätt och lösningar.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som trivs i en utvecklarroll där kvalitet, säkerhet och stabila lösningar är avgörande. Du är van att arbeta i affärskritiska systemmiljöer och har erfarenhet av att ta ansvar för tekniska lösningar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen – från design och implementation till vidareutveckling och förbättring.

Du arbetar strukturerat, har ett analytiskt förhållningssätt och trivs med att samarbeta nära andra utvecklare. Samtidigt delar du gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till att utveckla både teamets arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar.

Du har även ett intresse för att ligga i framkant inom AI-stödd systemutveckling, till exempel genom verktyg som GitHub Copilot.

Du har erfarenhet av

Systemutveckling i C# / .NET
Backendutveckling och integrationer
Eventdriven arkitektur eller meddelandebaserade lösningar
ASP.NET / MVC och REST-baserade API:er
Databashantering med MS SQL, samt ORM-verktyg som EF Core eller Dapper
Versionshantering och CI/CD-flöden
Kommunikation på svenska, i tal och skrift

Vad händer nu?

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv bedömning. Du kan läsa mer om vår process här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Stephan Mannerfelt på stephan.mannerfelt@skandia.se

Om du har frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition Partner, Madelene Skogh, på madelene.skogh@skandia.se

Vi återkopplar till alla som söker, oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

jobs.title: Build the Future of Payments Reporting at SEB | .NET Developer, Örebro
jobs.description:
Do you want to work with business-critical payment systems, modern cloud technologies, and solutions that support millions of transactions? Join SEB and help shape the next generation of payment reporting.

SEB is more than just a bank with an IT function. We are a progressive tech company powered by innovation and fueled by collaboration. From Java to AI and everything in between, we offer you an impressive tech stack and several technology paths. Together, we are building the future of financial services and creating technology that makes a real difference for our customers and society.

About The Role

As a .NET Developer, you'll join an agile team responsible for some of SEB's most business-critical payment reporting solutions. Our applications support high payment volumes and provide essential reporting capabilities across the bank.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of established banking systems and modern technology. You'll help modernize and evolve our payment reporting platforms while ensuring the stability, reliability, and performance expected from critical financial infrastructure.

You'll work across a diverse technology landscape that includes .NET, SQL Server, SEB's container platform, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Together, we are transforming how reporting solutions are built and operated, enabling faster delivery, increased scalability, and improved customer value.

In this role, you will:

Design, develop, and maintain business-critical payment reporting solutions
Contribute to the modernization of applications and services across on-premises and cloud environments
Work closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and fellow developers to deliver high-quality solutions
Optimize application performance and database workloads
Take ownership of solutions throughout their lifecycle, from development to production
Participate in shaping technical direction, architecture, and best practices within the team

To thrive in this role, we believe you have

Strong development experience in .NET, C#, and preferably VB.NET
Experience working with high-volume, business-critical applications
Strong SQL skills, including performance tuning and query optimization
A structured and analytical approach to problem-solving
The ability to work independently and take ownership of your deliveries
A collaborative mindset and a willingness to continuously learn and develop

It's a plus if you also have experience with:

Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other cloud platforms
Container-based platforms and modern deployment practices
Financial systems, payments, or reporting solutions

What We Offer

At SEB, you'll be part of a team where your ideas are valued and where you can make a real impact.

We offer:

Challenging and meaningful work within critical banking infrastructure
Opportunities to work with both established and emerging technologies
Modern and agile ways of working
A collaborative environment with experienced and knowledgeable colleagues
A flat hierarchy where initiative and new ideas are encouraged
Hybrid working possibilities and flexible work arrangements
Continuous learning and career development opportunities

Do you want to be part of SEB?

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.

Since we review applications continuously, feel free to submit your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026-09-30.
If you have questions about the position, please contact Joel Forsgren at Joel.Forsgren@seb.se. Please note that we do not process applications via email.

Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.

SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.

jobs.description:

Vi söker dig som tar stort eget ansvar, gillar att samarbeta och gärna bidrar med initiativ, kunskap och idéer som utvecklar både våra lösningar och vårt sätt att arbeta.

Hos oss blir du en viktig del av Synsams fortsatta digitala utveckling och vår ambition att vara det ledande och mest hållbara livsstilsföretaget inom optik och ögonhälsa. Du får arbeta med spännande tekniska utmaningar i en miljö där innovation, utveckling och en riktigt bra digital kundupplevelse står i fokus. Är du nyfiken på ny teknik, gillar att lösa komplexa problem och drivs av att bygga smarta och hållbara lösningar? Då kan det här vara rollen för dig!

Som Backend Developer blir du en del av vårt Digital Business-team, där du tillsammans med Team Lead och kollegor inom fullstack, backend, frontend och test driver utvecklingen av Synsams e-handelsplattform. Hos oss är ensam inte stark! Du blir en del av ett framåtsträvande och sammansvetsat tvärfunktionellt team där vi samarbetar nära, delar kunskap och lär av varandra. Delta i teknisk planering och scoping av initiativ.
Säkerställa prestanda, säkerhet och stabilitet i våra tjänster.
Sätta och upprätthålla kodstandarder, samt driva kontinuerliga förbättringar i teamets arbetsmetoder.

Utforska och implementera nya teknologier och verktyg för att förbättra våra processer.

Vi söker dig som är en erfaren backendutvecklare och som trivs med att ta ansvar, lösa komplexa problem och bygga stabila och skalbara lösningar. Du är tekniskt nyfiken och håller dig uppdaterad inom ditt område, samtidigt som du har ett pragmatiskt förhållningssätt och fokus på att skapa lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.

Du trivs i ett prestigelöst och tvärfunktionellt team där man samarbetar nära och gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap. Du har lätt för att kommunicera med både tekniska och icke-tekniska kollegor och bidrar gärna till att utveckla såväl våra tekniska lösningar som teamets arbetssätt.

Vi Ser Gärna Att Du Har

Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av backend-utveckling.

Erfarenhet av databaser, databasdesign och optimering i MSSQL.

jobs.title: AI Native Software Engineering Consultant (C# / .NET)
jobs.description:
AI förändrar inte bara hur vi skriver kod. Det förändrar hur system designas, hur team arbetar och vilka kompetenser som kommer att särskilja morgondagens ingenjörer.

För utvecklare som vill fortsätta utvecklas räcker det inte längre att enbart behärska programmering. Det krävs också förståelse för arkitektur, systemdesign och hur AI kan användas som en integrerad del av utvecklingsarbetet.

Din resa som konsult hos SALT börjar med en fem veckor lång accelerator där du bygger den engineering- och AI-kompetens som marknaden efterfrågar idag – och som kommer att bli ännu viktigare imorgon. Därefter matchas du med en av våra kunder, där du får omsätta dina nya kunskaper i praktiken som konsult.

Din konsultkarriär hos SALT

Som konsult hos SALT blir du en del av ett nätverk av utvecklare och ingenjörer som arbetar hos ledande företag inom bland annat fintech, retail, telekom och industri. Vårt kommersiella team, med över 20 års erfarenhet i branschen, matchar dig med uppdrag där du får fortsätta utvecklas inom modern software engineering, AI och systemdesign. Vår ambition är att ge dig de bästa förutsättningarna att ligga i framkant, även när tekniken förändras.

SALT är inte ett traditionellt konsultbolag. Vi är i grunden ett utbildningsbolag och hos oss slutar inte kompetensutvecklingen när du börjar ditt första uppdrag. Genom vår etablerade utbildningsverksamhet, coachning och SALT Community fortsätter du att bygga din kompetens tillsammans med andra konsulter och alumner. Vårt kontor är beläget centralt på Medborgarplatsen och arbetskulturen präglas av en stark gemenskap och att ständigt hjälpa varandra att utvecklas. Vi har regelbundna AW:s och interna event där du har möjlighet att träffa kollegor och bygga ditt nätverk även mellan uppdragen.

Om acceleratorn

Acceleratorn är en del av din väg in i konsultrollen och är utvecklad för dig som redan behärskar grunderna i programmering. Under fem intensiva heltidsveckor får du möjlighet att höja din tekniska nivå och bygga kompetens inom områden som blir allt viktigare i framtidens ingenjörsroller – från systemdesign och arkitektur till AI och avancerade engineering practices.

Du arbetar tillsammans med andra utvecklare i projekt och teammiljöer som speglar moderna utvecklingsorganisationer. Fokus ligger på att utveckla ditt engineering thinking, din förmåga att fatta välgrundade tekniska beslut och att arbeta AI-native genom hela utvecklingsprocessen.

Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:

AI-assisterad utveckling och moderna AI-verktyg
Systemdesign och mjukvaruarkitektur
Engineering trade-offs och tekniskt beslutsfattande
Skalbara system och moderna utvecklingsmiljöer
Kodgranskning och teknisk kommunikation
Teambaserad problemlösning
Avancerade utvecklingsprojekt

De sista två veckorna ägnas åt ett större projekt där du omsätter dina kunskaper i praktiken och bygger en lösning som demonstrerar både teknisk bredd, systemförståelse och förmågan att arbeta som en modern, AI-native engineer.

Praktisk information

Din anställning hos SALT börjar med en fem veckor lång accelerator på heltid från vårt kontor i Stockholm.

Efter godkänd accelerator matchas du mot uppdrag hos någon av våra kunder. Målet är att du ska kliva in i ditt första uppdrag med en stärkt engineering-profil, djupare teknisk förståelse och förmågan att arbeta som en AI-native developer.

Du lär dig att:

Använda AI som en naturlig del av utvecklingsprocessen, från design och implementation till testning, kvalitetssäkring och dokumentation.
Höja din kompetensnivå kring systemdesign, arkitektur och tekniska vägval utifrån verkliga affärs- och systemkrav.
Utvärdera, förbättra och kvalitetssäkra AI-genererade lösningar.
Kommunicera tekniska beslut och samarbeta effektivt med både utvecklare och andra roller i organisationen.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi söker dig som redan arbetat ett par år i utvecklarrollen och nu vill investera i nästa fas av din karriär.

Du behöver:

Ha minst 2–3 års erfarenhet av professionell mjukvaruutveckling.
Ha erfarenhet av utveckling i C#/.NET eller Java, där C#/.NET är vårt primära teknikområde under acceleratorn.
Ha arbetat med versionshantering och samarbete i utvecklingsteam.
Ha god förståelse för objektorienterad programmering och grundläggande designprinciper.
Vara flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
Ha permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige.
Vara permanent bosatt i eller i närheten av Stockholm.

Det är meriterande om du:

Har erfarenhet av molnplattformar som Azure eller AWS.
Har arbetat med arkitektur- eller systemdesignfrågor.
Har använt AI-verktyg som en del av ditt utvecklingsarbete.
Har experimenterat med agentiska arbetsflöden eller AI-drivna processer.
Har erfarenhet av kodgranskning, mentorskap eller tekniskt ledarskap.

Som person ser vi att du:

Gillar att förstå hur saker hänger ihop, inte bara få dem att fungera.
Är nyfiken på hur software engineering förändras och vill ligga steget före.
Trivs i miljöer där lärande och kunskapsdelning är en del av vardagen.
Har lätt för att samarbeta, ge och ta feedback samt bidra till teamets utveckling.
Ser AI som en naturlig del av framtidens software engineering och är motiverad att utveckla nya arbetssätt där AI förstärker både den egna och teamets förmåga att skapa värde.

Övrig information

Start:
4 januari 2027

Plats:
Medborgarplatsen, Stockholm

Sista ansökningsdag:
30 september 2026

Ta första steget mot din nya karriär och skicka in din ansökan redan idag — vi tillämpar löpande urval.

SALT är stolt över att vara en jämlik arbetsgivare som välkomnar individer av alla kön, bakgrunder och erfarenheter. Bli en del av ett företag i teknikens framkant som värdesätter och främjar stor mångfald på arbetsplatsen. Kulturen på SALT kännetecknas av att vara inkluderande, öppen och dynamisk.

jobs.title: Software & AI Engineering Program (C# / .NET)
jobs.description:
Vill du bygga en karriär som mjukvaruingenjör med kompetens i framkant – där du både behärskar kodhantverket och skapar förutsättningar för att orkestrera AI‑drivna system?

AI har redan blivit en del av infrastrukturen i mjukvaruutveckling. Det handlar inte längre bara om att skriva kod, utan om att förstå hur system hänger ihop, hur AI kan förstärka ditt arbete och hur du skapar verkligt värde i team. Samtidigt är grunderna fortsatt avgörande.

Under det här programmet bygger du en stabil grund som fullstack‑utvecklare, samtidigt som du utvecklar den AI‑, system- och ingenjörsförståelse som behövs för att kunna ta dig an roller inom AI‑orkestrering.

Om programmet

Programmet är intensivt och pågår under tre månader på plats på vårt kontor i Stockholm.

Upplägget är designat för att du ska kunna ta dig an framtidens ingenjörsroller. Först a
delen fokuserar du på att stärka ditt kodhantverk och din förståelse för moderna fullstack‑miljöer. Du skriver mycket kod, jobbar med testning, versionshantering och mobbprogrammering, och lär dig hur en professionell utvecklingsprocess ser ut i praktiken. Därefter lyfter du blicken
: du arbetar mer med arkitektur, systemdesign och AI. Du lär dig hur du använder AI‑verktyg för att designa, producera, testa och skala kod – och hur agentiska arbetssätt och orkestrering kan se ut i verkliga team.

Resultatet är att du både kommer kunna gå in i juniora utvecklarroller, men också ta dig an roller där du förväntas vara mer drivande i hur AI används i teamet och organisationen – som en AI‑orkestratör med stark grund i utveckling.

Efter avslutat program matchar vårt säljteam dig med ett konsultuppdrag hos någon av våra kunder, med målsättningen att det leder till en fast anställning.

Du lär dig att:

Bygga upp ett stabilt fundament i modern fullstack‑utveckling: skriva kod, testa, felsöka, samarbeta i versionshantering och arbeta i agila team.
Använda AI‑verktyg som en naturlig del av ditt dagliga arbetsflöde – både för att skriva, förbättra och kvalitetssäkra kod – samtidigt som du tränar din förmåga att granska, ifrågasätta och förbättra AI:ns förslag.
Tänka i system snarare än isolerade funktioner: förstå hur komponenter hänger ihop, varför vissa arkitekturbeslut fattas och vilka trade‑offs som görs.
Ta de första stegen mot AI‑orkestrering: designa agentiska arbetsflöden, kombinera flera verktyg och resonera kring hur AI kan förstärka ett team snarare än ersätta det.
Arbeta i team där kodgranskning, kunskapsdelning, mentorskap och kontinuerligt lärande är en del av vardagen – och där du förväntas bidra både tekniskt och kommunikativt.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi söker dig som har lagt grunden själv, men vill ta nästa steg tillsammans med erfarna instruktörer.

Du behöver:

Ha programmerat regelbundet det senaste året (t.ex. egna projekt, frilans, studier eller open source) – helst med fokus på att bygga något lite större.
Ha erfarenhet av något eller några språk såsom Java, JavaScript, C#, Python eller liknande.
Ha en avslutad eftergymnasial utbildning.
Ha relevant eller närliggande arbetslivserfarenhet där du samarbetat i en teammiljö.
Vara flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
Ha permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige.
Vara permanent bosatt i eller i närheten av Stockholm.

Det är meriterande om du:

Har jobbat med AI‑verktyg i ditt eget lärande eller utvecklingsarbete, t.ex. för att förstå kod, förbättra struktur, skriva tester eller utforska nya lösningar.
Har börjat experimentera med agentiska upplägg (t.ex. kedjor av verktyg, automatiserade flöden eller enklare agent‑system) eller är nyfiken på hur sådana kan byggas.
Har kunskap i objektorienterad programmering och grundläggande systemdesign.
Har en kandidat- eller masterexamen

Som person letar vi efter dig som:

Gillar att förstå hur saker hänger ihop, inte bara få något att “funka”.
Är nyfiken, proaktiv och trivs i miljöer där mycket förändras.
Tycker om att kommunicera med olika människor och roller inom en organisation.
Har lätt för att samarbeta, ge och ta feedback samt tycker det är kul att lära tillsammans med andra

Övrig information

Start:
28 oktober 2026

Plats:
Medborgarplatsen, Stockholm

Sista ansökningsdag:
18 september 2026

Ta första steget mot din nya karriär och skicka in din ansökan redan idag— vi tillämpar löpande urval.

jobs.title: Power Platform Konsult
jobs.description:
Du sitter i ett projektmöte.

Kunden beskriver ett problem som egentligen inte har någon självklar lösning. Det är komplext, kanske lite rörigt och exakt den typen av utmaning du gillar.

Du börjar ställa frågor, koppla ihop saker, skissa på lösningar i huvudet och du vet att du inte behöver ha alla svar själv. Du har nämligen ett team bakom dig som tänker lika mycket som du och kompletterar dig i det du inte kan.

Det är så det är att jobba på Compago.

Vi bryr oss inte om din debiteringsgrad. Vi tänker inte börja mäta den heller.

Och vi tror inte på lönemodeller som stressar mer än de motiverar. Vi tror istället på balans, trygghet och att faktiskt ha ett hållbart arbetsliv (ja, på riktigt).

Det vi gillar? Kluriga projekt, samarbete och att lösa svåra problem tillsammans. Du är personen som vet att du inte kan allt, men som är rejält nyfiken på att lära dig mer och gärna delar med dig längs vägen.

Hos oss samarbetar vi i projektform åt stora bolag som gör skillnad. Du får grotta ner dig i Power Platform och andra Microsoft-tekniker, förstå kundens verksamhet och bygga smarta lösningar, som förmodligen inte gjorts tidigare och som faktiskt används.

Vi jobbar med allt från SharePoint, Teams och Power BI till Copilot, Azure och Business Central. Kan du inte allt redan? Perfekt, då har du ju massor att lära dig hos oss.

Vem är du?

Om du kommer från kundsidan eller konsult spelar ingen roll. Du trivs med att jobba i projektform, har praktisk erfarenhet av Microsoft-utveckling och en god förståelse för verksamhet. Att agera arkitekt är något du gillar och du är bekväm i dialogen med kunder. Samtidigt har du lite svårt att hålla dig borta från att koda då och då. Du är flytande i både svenska och engelska, såväl tal som skrift.

För att ge dig bästa möjliga förutsättningar ser vi att du:

Är välbekant med Power Platform/Model Driven Apps ELLER Dynamics CE
Är bekväm med Azure och datamodellering/dataverse

På Compago arbetar vi med placering i centrala Malmö eller Göteborg.

Läs mer om oss och vår rekryteringsprocess.

Ansökan och frågor:

Har du frågor eller funderingar får du gärna höra av dig till Alexander Lindgren och Hanna Elfving på rekrytering@compago.se. Enligt GDPR tar vi inte emot ansökningar via mejl utan de sker enbart via den här annonsen. Du kan läsa mer om vår integritetspolicy här

jobs.description:
Lyten is leading an industrial revolution through Lyten 3D Graphene™, a breakthrough supermaterial unlocking a new generation of products — from lithium–sulfur batteries and energy storage systems to concrete admixtures, lightweight composites, and next-generation sensors that are revolutionizing industries. Together, these innovations are making a massive global improvement and driving real-world impact across energy, mobility, construction, and defense.

At Lyten, we believe the most meaningful careers begin with purpose — and with people who want to make a difference. We’re not just developing advanced supermaterials — we’re about to change the world as we know it, reshaping how energy is stored, how products are built, and how progress is made.

We’re entering an exciting growth phase, scaling production across the U.S. and Europe and expanding our team of engineers, scientists, and innovators.

Apply now to join our team and be part of something bigger than yourself — where collaboration, creativity, and purpose come together to build the technologies that will define the next century.

Job Scope

The Systems Engineer will be responsible for the design, configuration, deployment, and maintenance of the OT and server infrastructure supporting ABB 800xA Distributed Control Systems (DCS). This includes managing Windows-based servers, virtual environments, network security, and system performance to ensure reliable and secure operation of the control system platform.

This role serves as the technical bridge between automation and IT, ensuringseamless integration of control networks and corporate systems while maintaining system availability, cybersecurity, and lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)

Design, configure, and maintain Windows Server environments (physical and virtual) supporting ABB 800xA systems.
Install, configure, and maintain ABB 800xA system software, domain controllers, operator workstations, engineering stations, and network components.
Manage Active Directory (AD), Group Policies (GPO), and user access control for DCS environments.
Implement and manage data backup, recovery, and redundancy solutions in alignment with ABB recommendations and Lyten IT policies.
Perform patch management and system updates while ensuring uptime of production systems.
Support system commissioning, FAT/SAT testing, and system upgrades or migrations.
Monitor system performance and resource utilization; optimize for high availability and low latency.
Implement and maintain cybersecurity measures including antivirus, firewalls, and network segmentation according to ISA/IEC 62443 standards.
Collaborate with Application engineers, IT departments, and ABB technical support for troubleshooting and integration activities.
Prepare and maintain comprehensive system documentation, architecture diagrams, and maintenance procedures.
responsible for OPCUA and similar connections to high level information system.

Direct reports: No
Manager work environment responsibility: No
All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience with Windows Server administration in an industrial automation or DCS environment.
Hands-on experience with ABB 800xA system architecture, configuration, and maintenance.
Strong knowledge of:
Windows Server 2016/2019/2022
Active Directory and GPO management
Virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V)
Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls)
RNRP network and routing
Familiarity with backup solutions (e.g., Acronis, Veeam, ABB recommended tools).
Experience in system hardening and cybersecurity best practices.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Specific skills

Good skills in English since it is main used language
Experience with ABB 800xA upgrades, domain migrations, or server clustering.
Knowledge of ISA/IEC 62443 cybersecurity framework.
Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server administration and historian database systems.
Experience working in regulated or mission-critical industries (power, mining, process automation).
ABB Certified or Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE) is an advantage.
Knowledge of goose protocol IEC 61850

Why Work at Lyten

At Lyten, you’ll be part of a team that’s redefining what’s possible in energy, materials, and manufacturing. We’re not just imagining the future — we’re building it today with breakthrough technologies that are changing how products are made and how industries innovate.

Our people are the heart of that mission. From world-class scientists and engineers to creative problem-solvers in operations, manufacturing, and commercialization, every member of the Lyten team plays a role in turning bold ideas into real-world impact. We believe that the best work happens when you’re doing great things in the world — with people you like. Collaboration, curiosity, and a shared sense of purpose drive everything we do.

What You’ll Find at Lyten

A mission that matters: Contribute directly to solving complex challenges in energy, mobility, and materials innovation.
Cutting-edge innovation: Work on technologies at the intersection of materials science, energy storage, and advanced manufacturing that strengthen energy security and local supply chains.
Extraordinary people: Join a team of talented, friendly, and down-to-earth innovators who support, challenge, and inspire one another every day.
Teamwork and culture: Experience a workplace built on trust, respect, and shared success — where collaboration fuels breakthroughs and everyone’s ideas are heard.
Global impact: Help scale new materials and energy solutions that reinforce industrial resilience across the U.S. and Europe.
Career growth: Be part of a fast-moving company entering a commercial growth phase, with opportunities to lead, learn, and make your mark.
Purpose-driven values: Thrive in an environment that celebrates ingenuity, optimism, and meaningful progress — together.

Lyten offers the opportunity to do the most important work of your career — helping build the technologies that will power the next century of innovation.

Join us, and help transform industries, communities, and the planet with friends who share your drive to make a difference.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to develop cutting-edge software applications for our world-leading products? Looking to use and grow your development skills in a fast-paced and creative environment? If this sounds like an exciting challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

About The Job 

Trackman products generate extremely accurate measurements using a patented combination of camera and radar, which provide valuable insights for athletes ranging from top worldclass professionals to enthusiastic amateurs, as well as coaches, scouts, and clubs of all levels.

As part of our company's continued expansion, we are looking for a .NET C# backend developer. You will join a department of 45+ skilled developers, responsible for applications used in golf, baseball, softball and football. You will be part of refinement, planning, implementation, testing and deployment to our customers.

We build applications hosted on distributed Linux servers running Docker, on Microsoft Azure technologies, on mobile devices and customer laptops. You will get to interact with skilled developers working across a range of platforms and apps. We always work with the latest LTS .NET version using C# with web frontends in React. 

As part of our development toolkit, our teams actively use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to speed up coding, testing, and documentation — letting our developers spend more time on solving interesting problems and less on repetitive tasks.

You will join a team of skilled developers who love what they do and, in a role, where you can have a big impact both on what is being built and how it is built. We value having our developers being part of refinement and you will be deeply involved in finding great solutions from a technical as well as a user perspective together with our Head of Products and UI/UX designers.

Job Requirements

Required skills:

3+ years of working with .NET and excellent C# programming skills
Professional usage of an IDE like Visual Studio or Rider
Work in an agile environment with a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and clear communication 
Good understanding of architectural patterns and software design principles 
Good communication skills and a positive and proactive mindset 
Experience with Git  

Additional skills (not required, but nice to have): 

Experience with using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude)
Experience with Docker and Azure Pipelines

All we ask is that you bring passion, curiosity and structure to our workplace. We are a company of many nationalities. Whether you are from abroad or already living in Denmark, we welcome talented people of any gender, nationality and belief. We think the right mix of people makes for the best culture and product. 

At Trackman, we see AI not as a replacement for great developers, but as a tool that makes great developers even more effective — accelerating code reviews, catching bugs earlier, and freeing up time for the creative problem-solving that moves our products forward.

The IT landscape is evolving faster than ever and staying up to date with AI-assisted development is quickly becoming a fundamental part of the software development process.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.
