RESPONSIBILITY

The Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring software reliability, test automation, and continuous quality improvement across the software development lifecycle. The role requires strong analytical skills, test automation expertise, and collaboration with product and development teams to implement robust testing strategies. Engineers must work in an agile, DevOps-driven environment, ensuring fast feedback loops, risk-based testing, and high software quality.

Collaborate with Product Owners and Business Analysts to define clear and actionable user story acceptance criteria.
Work with Software Engineers to ensure automated test coverage and prevent bugs and defects in production.
Analyze and decompose complex software systems to design holistic, risk-based test strategies.
Develop and maintain test automation frameworks using industry-standard tools.
Design, implement, and execute comprehensive test suites covering functional, regression, exploratory, and performance testing.
Take a risk-based approach to test automation, prioritizing critical functionality for maximum impact.
Perform time-boxed exploratory testing to uncover edge cases and usability issues.
Maintain a stable regression test suite integrated into QA nightly builds.
Continuously refine smoke tests in the Development CI environment for early issue detection.
Lead system integration testing with other system owners to validate cross-system interactions.
Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT), coordinating with stakeholders to ensure business requirements are met.
Manage the defect lifecycle, test artifacts, and test repositories to ensure clear tracking and reporting.
Drive continuous improvement in agile testing practices, tools, and methodologies.
Take on a secondary role as an Application Performance Engineer or Application Security Engineer to expand testing coverage beyond functional aspects.

Experience And Skills Needed

Core Testing Expertise:

Strong knowledge of test automation strategies and risk-based testing.
Experience designing and executing test cases, test plans, and test suites.
Hands-on experience with manual and automated testing for web, mobile, and API services.
Familiarity with cross-browser, cross-platform, and responsive UI testing.

Test Automation & CI/CD Integration

Experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Robot Framework, Cypress, SikuliX, or EggPlant.
Knowledge of test scripting and automation programming using Python, Java, JavaScript, or C#.
Experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Bamboo).
Ability to design maintainable, scalable, and reusable test automation suites.

Agile & DevOps Testing Practices

Strong understanding of agile testing methodologies, including TDD, BDD, and exploratory testing.
Experience working in agile development environments (Scrum, Kanban, XP).
Familiarity with shift-left testing approaches, ensuring early defect detection.
Experience with containerized testing in Docker/Kubernetes environments.

Security & Performance Testing (Added Advantage)

Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6, Locust).
Knowledge of application security testing (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, SAST, DAST).
Experience conducting API security testing using authentication protocols (OAuth, JWT).

Test Management & Certifications

Experience managing defect tracking and test repositories using tools such as JIRA, TestRail, Micro Focus ALM (QC/Sprinter).
Certified Software Testing Professional (CSTP) and/or Certified Software Quality Analyst (CSQA) is an advantage.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the role

In this role, you’ll contribute directly to Axon™
, our Digital Twin SaaS platform. We’re looking for Software Engineers who are curious, analytically strong, and excited to grow in an intellectually challenging product environment.

A background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field will provide a strong foundation for success in this role. Beyond that, we value strong reasoning skills, an interest in software development, and the ambition to continuously learn and improve.

You join the backend Analytics team within Product & Engineering: a close‑knit team of 20+ data scientists and engineers working closely with product owners to deliver end‑to‑end platform features.
You help build and evolve the analytical backbone of the Axon platform.
You translate strong abstract and analytical thinking into real‑world software solutions.
You integrate customer data into scalable data models, building complex graph structures, analytical logic, and advanced capabilities for calculations, simulations, and querying.
You know what clean, production‑ready code looks like. You have a strong focus on quality and maintainability.
You build and extend a sophisticated backend, using .NET.
You use AI -curiously and with judgement- to explore design options, write and improve code, validate tests, and speed up repetitive work.
You’ll report to the Lead Software Engineer of Axon technology.

Job Requirements

About you

We value people with a strong technical foundation, a growth mindset, curiosity, and the drive to build solutions that create real impact.

Have a strong analytical and abstract reasoning mindset and enjoy mathematics, complex systems, and intellectual challenges.
Hold a master’s degree in fields such as (Civil) Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, or similar.
Have a strong interest in software development . Prior development experience is a big plus, but not required.
Are curious about how AI is reshaping software development and eager to grow with it.
Enjoy understanding how technical choices connect to real business impact.
Are fluent in Dutch & English.
Feel connected with and are ready to represent our company values: dig deep, own it, come together, move fast and be kind!

Why join us?

Strong onboarding, daily collaboration and coaching by experienced engineers to help you grow fast.
The chance to build a strong foundation for your software engineering career.
Work on one growing SaaS product, instead of jumping from one short project to another.
Build deep product and technical knowledge over time, so you can become an expert faster.
High-impact work on real-life, complex supply chain problems.
An intellectually challenging environment where deep thinking is valued.
AI-enabled development that helps you focus on creativity, problem-solving, and quality.
A fun culture that values ownership, curiosity, kindness, and helping each other succeed.
Flexible working hours and a 50/50 hybrid model from our Mechelen office.
Alongside a competitive salary and bonus, you'll have the choice between a flexible mobility budget or an electric company car with convenient charging facilities.

About us

Start your career shaping the future of supply chains.

Bluecrux is a value chain consulting and technology company, specializing in transformative solutions for today’s complex supply chain landscape. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we’re committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

Axon
helps companies bring scattered supply chain data together in one clear view, so our clients can better understand what is happening, make smarter decisions, and act faster. Our platform is used especially in Life Sciences and Healthcare, where supply chains are highly complex, and decisions can directly impact product launches, availability, and access to medicines. By helping companies see their supply chain more clearly, Axon supports faster product launches, better use of working capital, and more room for investment in research and development.

Axon is also still in a scale-up phase. There is a strong product vision, many new ideas to build, and a lot of product innovation still ahead.

the automotive world.

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong expertise in C#/.NET, cloud-native backend development, and API engineering.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building scalable, secure, and maintainable backend services in cloud environments. The engineer will work closely with Tech Leads and cross-functional teams to implement high-quality solutions aligned with established architectural and engineering standards.

This role is not a Tech Lead or Architect position. The expectation is strong technical execution, active contribution to engineering quality, support for architecture compliance, and ownership of backend deliverables.

AI-assisted development practices are a core expectation for this role. Candidates should be comfortable using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code Codex, or similar within their daily engineering workflow.

Your Responsibilities

As a key member of the team, you will be responsible for:

Backend Development

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using C# and .NET Core.
Build secure, scalable, and high-performance REST APIs.
Implement backend solutions aligned with approved architectural patterns and technical guidelines.
Develop services capable of handling high concurrency and production-scale workloads.
Write optimized and maintainable database queries while ensuring data integrity and performance.
Troubleshoot and resolve backend and production issues efficiently.

Code Quality and Best Practices

Write clean, maintainable, testable, and production-ready code.
Apply SOLID principles and safeguard architectural practices such as Clean Architecture, Onion Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
Implement and maintain:
Unit tests
Integration tests
End-to-end tests
Performance/load tests
Participate actively in code reviews and engineering quality initiatives.
Contribute to continuous improvement of development standards, tooling, and workflows.

Collaboration and Agile Development

Work closely with Tech Leads, frontend engineers, QA engineers, and DevOps engineers
Translate technical and business requirements into high-quality implementations.
Support architecture compliance and contribute to solution improvement discussions.
Provide technical guidance and support to less experienced engineers when needed.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and team collaboration activities.

DevOps, Cloud and Architecture

Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Containerize backend services using Docker.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
Support observability and monitoring practices using logging, metrics, and tracing tools.
Follow security, reliability, and operational best practices in backend implementations.

Continuous Improvement

Stay up to date with advancements in backend technologies.
Propose and implement improvements in system architecture and development workflows.

Contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives and technical documentation

What We're Looking For

Experience:
A minimum of 6 years of experience in backend development.
Experience in developing and maintaining scalable backend services.
Experience writing and maintaining unit, integration and performance tests.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude-Code … configuration, rule management and use.
Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Languages: English (Interview will be conducted in English)
Communication: Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
Technical Skills:
Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Core
Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Strong SQL and relational database experience
Good understanding of:
SOLID principles
Design patterns
Clean Architecture
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

Experience with Docker and CI/CD workflows
Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Understanding of scalable backend systems, observability, and reliability practices
AI Engineering
Practical experience using AI coding assistants in day-to-day software development (Cursor/Claude Code/Codex/Github Co-pilot)
Experience configuring or working with AI-assisted engineering workflows
Language Skills
Fluent in English (mandatory).
French language proficiency is a plus.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration int cross-functional teams.
Ability to take ownership and drive initiatives to completion.
Interpersonal Skills: Ability to collaborate in a diverse and dynamic environment.

are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

Backend Developer – Global Customized Solutions

Build the integrations that make complex access solutions work.

What happens when a customer needs SKIDATA products to work with a system they already rely on? That’s where you come in.

As a Backend Developer
, you’ll design and build tailored software integrations that connect third-party systems with SKIDATA products. You’ll solve varied technical challenges, work with integration partners and turn specific customer requirements into working solutions.

Why this role matters

Access solutions need to work seamlessly with the wider systems customers depend on. Your work will help turn specific customer requirements into reliable solutions, extending the flexibility and reach of SKIDATA products across different markets and real-world environments.

The role

You’ll take ownership of your own projects, from design and implementation through testing and documentation, while working as part of the global GCS team. Alongside your development work, you’ll support colleagues across regions and contribute to shared coding, architecture and engineering practices.

What You’ll Work On

Build custom integrations — design, develop, test and document backend solutions connecting third-party systems with SKIDATA products.
Develop in C#/.NET — build reliable solutions primarily using .NET.
Work with APIs and interfaces — develop and integrate solutions using technologies such as REST, SOAP, gRPC, RMQ and sockets.
Support integration partners — provide integration support for public interfaces and help third-party companies connect with SKIDATA systems.
Contribute to engineering practices — support the implementation of coding standards, architecture guidelines and reusable frameworks, and contribute to practices such as CI/CD and AI-assisted development.
Support colleagues across regions — assist regional developers and contribute to code reviews, technical mentoring and consistent quality.

What Will Help You Succeed

Backend development experience — with solid hands-on skills in C#/.NET.
Integration experience — familiarity with APIs and system interfaces such as REST, SOAP, gRPC, RMQ or sockets.
Software development foundation — experience with databases and software design, with exposure to Java or web technologies such as JavaScript/TypeScript being a plus.
Modern development practices — familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps, an understanding of secure coding, and familiarity with AI-assisted development tools.
Collaborative approach — self-organised, analytical and comfortable working with colleagues across different regions and cultures.

Fluent English and Spanish is required
. German would be a plus.

Why SKIDATA

At SKIDATA, you’ll work on technology that connects access solutions with the wider systems customers rely on, while having the autonomy to own your work and collaborate with colleagues across borders.

Meaningful impact — Build integrations that help SKIDATA access solutions work seamlessly with the systems customers and partners depend on.
Innovation & scale — Work with modern backend technologies, APIs and integration solutions as part of a global organisation.
Autonomy & trust — Take ownership of your projects from design through delivery, with the freedom to shape solutions and solve problems in your own way.
Growth & development — Broaden your technical experience through varied projects, different technologies and collaboration with colleagues across regions.
Work–life balance — Benefit from a flexible hybrid working model in Madrid that supports a sustainable way of working.

Ready to build what connects it all?

If you’re a backend developer who enjoys solving integration challenges and turning customer requirements into working solutions, we’d like to hear from you.

AI-assisted development practices are a core expectation for this role. Candidates should be comfortable using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code Codex, or similar within their daily engineering workflow.

Backend Development

Develop services capable of handling high concurrency and production-scale workloads.

Code Quality and Best Practices

Implement and maintain:
Unit tests
Integration tests
End-to-end tests
Performance/load tests
Participate actively in code reviews and engineering quality initiatives.
Contribute to continuous improvement of development standards, tooling, and workflows.

Translate technical and business requirements into high-quality implementations.
Support architecture compliance and contribute to solution improvement discussions.
Provide technical guidance and support to less experienced engineers when needed.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and team collaboration activities.

DevOps, Cloud and Architecture

Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Containerize backend services using Docker.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
Support observability and monitoring practices using logging, metrics, and tracing tools.
Follow security, reliability, and operational best practices in backend implementations.

Continuous Improvement

Stay up to date with advancements in backend technologies.
Propose and implement improvements in system architecture and development workflows.

Contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives and technical documentation

What We're Looking For

Experience:
A minimum of 6 years of experience in backend development.
Experience in developing and maintaining scalable backend services.
Experience writing and maintaining unit, integration and performance tests.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude-Code … configuration, rule management and use.
Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Languages: English (Interview will be conducted in English)
Communication: Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
Technical Skills:
Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Core
Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Strong SQL and relational database experience
Good understanding of:
SOLID principles
Design patterns
Clean Architecture
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

Experience with Docker and CI/CD workflows
Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Understanding of scalable backend systems, observability, and reliability practices
AI Engineering
Practical experience using AI coding assistants in day-to-day software development (Cursor/Claude Code/Codex/Github Co-pilot)
Experience configuring or working with AI-assisted engineering workflows
Language Skills
Fluent in English (mandatory).
French language proficiency is a plus.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration int cross-functional teams.
Ability to take ownership and drive initiatives to completion.
Interpersonal Skills: Ability to collaborate in a diverse and dynamic environment.

Our Recruitment Process

15-minute introductory call with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.
Interview with the Hiring Team
Technical Interview

What We Offer

We understand that flexibility and trust
are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

🏡 Hybrid Work: Rotational model, 2 days onsite, three days remote.
💰 Annual Payments: 14 payments per year (12 monthly payments + 1 summer bonus + 1 Christmas bonus in November).
🍽️ Meal Voucher: €10.20 per working day.

Teambuilding: Join us for memorable afterworks and team activities!

. We firmly believe that diversity in experiences and backgrounds strengthens our culture and drives innovation.

Support for people with disabilities. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, let us know so we can provide the best possible experience.

PORTO

TECHNOLOGY

The Technology team builds end-to-end products and solutions that power our marketplace, delivering an incredible experience for customers globally. From understanding customer and partner needs to designing and testing innovative hypotheses, we create industry-leading experiences for luxury customers everywhere.

Reporting to the Engineering Lead, you will be responsible for improving and maintaining our project portfolio. As a Software Engineer, your duties will include developing end-to-end solutions, reviewing initiatives prior to their deployment and subsequent maintenance phase addressing any arising issues, and developing enhancements based on our business teams requirements. You will ensure that all developments undergo rigorous testing and review. Effective communication is crucial in this role, as you will frequently interact with issue reporters to thoroughly understand problems and convey clear solutions. You will be working in a very friendly environment and be part of a well-motivated, talented and growing team. If you love to learn, if you are willing to share knowledge and would love to be part of the building process to reach the top, using the latest technology stack and having fun doing it, this is an opportunity you can’t miss.

Design, implement, and optimize solutions to improve operational efficiency
Ensure outstanding engineering practices when building these solutions
Expand our modular architecture, creating new libraries
Provide technical support and expertise to resolve issues and improve system performance
Collaborate effectively within an agile environment
Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure high-quality software delivery
Evolve your technical capabilities to the next level while using state-of-the-art technologies

An expert in object oriented languages (C#)
Knowledgeable of unit tests and/or integration tests
Passionate about code quality
Stay on top of all of all best practices of modern software development
Knowledgeable of SQL and experience using relational databases
Knowledgeable of REST APIs
A professional with experience working with agile methodologies is also a plus
Autonomous and able to make important technical decisions that will have a positive impact on our platform
Interested in large-scale systems
Passionate about solving complex problems

Extra days off, sabbatical program and days for you to give back for the community;
Training opportunities and free access to LinkedIn Learning;
Flexible benefits program

Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.

We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM

We are building the future of software development — AI-First is the new standard
. You won’t be “experimenting”; you’ll be delivering. Fast. Smart. Relentless. Join the core team that will prove AI-driven engineering is the only way forward. If you love challenges, own your outcomes, and are obsessed with delivery, you’ll thrive here.

MISSION

As an AI-First Engineer, your mission is to deliver production-quality features at a speed and scale that traditional teams cannot match. You will apply AI aggressively across every stage
of the development lifecycle — from requirements and design to coding, testing, and release — and establish a new engineering benchmark for the company.

OUTCOMES

Consistently deliver high-quality, production-grade features faster than traditional teams.
Build and optimize AI-first workflows that integrate AI across all development stages.
Raise the bar for speed, quality, and ownership in product delivery.
Be a core contributor to the new engineering culture built on AI-First principles.

How You’ll Ramp

By Day 30:

Deeply understand our AWS, .NET, Python, MongoDB tech stack and delivery model.
Start shipping real features using AI at every stage: coding, testing, documenting, releasing.
Contribute to improving workflows for even faster delivery.

By Day 60:

Independently own the full lifecycle of feature delivery through AI-first methods.
Identify and drive improvements in velocity, automation, and team efficiency.
Partner with Product and Tech Leads to aggressively accelerate time-to-market.

By Day 90:

Deliver features faster and with higher quality than baseline teams.
Actively mentor others on using AI as a multiplier across development.
Become a key driver of the AI-First engineering standard inside the company.

WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED:

Proven track record
of delivering production-grade products using AI-driven approach.
Mastery in using AI tools
(Copilot/Cursor/WindSurf (etc, you choose), GPT APIs, LLMs) across the entire development lifecycle — design, code generation, testing, documentation, and release.
Strong technical foundation in AWS, .NET, Python, and MongoDB.
Obsessed with delivery: you ship, you improve, you own the outcome.
Comfortable moving fast, taking ownership, and constantly pushing for better, faster, smarter execution.

Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far

A global, connected team
We’re a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you’re based, you’ll be part of a highly collaborative, globally-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact.
Be part of an AI Native Organization
We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.
Innovating a $100 Billion industry
Smartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.
Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together
We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here.
Smartcat Culture Code: Where Diversity Meets High Performance
At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a mid-level OutSystems Developer to join a support and evolutive development team, keeping a live platform running smoothly while continuously improving it. This isn't greenfield build work - it's about owning a production application, fixing what breaks fast, and shipping enhancements that make it better over time.

You'll work closely with business and IT teams, balancing incident response with planned development, and making sure both get the attention they deserve.

What you'll do

Diagnose and resolve incidents and bugs in existing OutSystems applications, keeping downtime and business impact to a minimum
Design and build new features and enhancements (evolutive development) based on business requirements
Perform root-cause analysis on recurring issues and propose fixes that prevent them from coming back
Monitor application performance and health, and act on issues before they become incidents
Maintain and improve technical documentation, including architecture notes and support runbooks
Participate in code reviews and apply OutSystems best practices for performance, security, and maintainability
Manage integrations with external systems (REST/SOAP APIs, databases, third-party services)
Work within SLA-driven support processes, prioritising tickets by severity and business impact
Collaborate with product owners and the wider delivery team on sprint planning and backlog refinement

What you bring

2-4 years of hands-on OutSystems development experience (Reactive and/or Traditional Web apps)
Solid understanding of the OutSystems platform: Service Studio, Integration Studio, Lifetime
Experience supporting live applications: triaging incidents, debugging in production-like environments, and working under SLAs
Working knowledge of REST/SOAP web services, SQL, and relational databases
Understanding of OutSystems architecture principles and performance best practices (query optimisation, aggregate usage, screen performance)
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum ways of working
Good English communication skills, written and spoken
A methodical, problem-solving mindset: comfortable moving between "fix it now" and "build it right"

Nice to have

OutSystems certification (Associate or Professional level)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines for OutSystems (e.g. OutSystems Pipelines, Azure DevOps)
Exposure to ITIL-based support processes
Experience in various industries

What the project looks like

Mixed workload: reactive support (incidents, bug fixes) plus planned evolutive development (new features, improvements)
Direct engagement with stakeholders, not just internal teams
Clear SLAs and ticket prioritisation, so you always know what matters most
Room to bring your own ideas on how to make the application better, not just keep it alive

jobs.description:

We are a technology-driven company offering businesses an innovative online solution for managing indirect tax obligations across 60 countries
. Our platform seamlessly integrates VAT registrations, tax calculations, filings, notifications, centralized document storage, and payments
, while our clients also benefit from the expertise of our experienced, multilingual team of tax professionals.

Thanks to the increasing demand for high-quality compliance services, Tax Desk has rapidly grown to a team of over 55 professionals specializing in tax compliance and technology
.

Role Overview

As a Solution Architect at Tax Desk
, you will be the primary bridge between ambitious business goals and robust technical execution.
You will own the architectural integrity of our platforms, ensuring that every new feature is scalable, secure, and seamlessly integrated
into our ecosystem, utilizing a modern .NET, React, and Azure
stack.
You aren't just drawing boxes and arrows — you are defining the "how" behind our "what."

Main Responsibilities

End-to-End Design

Lead the design of comprehensive technical solutions that align with Tax Desk’s long-term product roadmap.

Integration & Tech Stack

Define integration patterns across APIs, Webhooks, and Event-driven architectures
, and select the appropriate technology stacks in close collaboration with the development team. .NET, React, and Azure
are mainly used, but we are open to finding the best solution for our challenges.

Workflow Visualization

Translate complex business logic into clear technical flows and state diagrams
.

Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)

Define, document, and lead the testing for performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements
.

Architectural Documentation

Maintain high-quality documentation, including system architecture diagrams, data models, and sequence diagrams (UML/Mermaid)
.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Act as the "translator" between Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, and Developers
, ensuring technical feasibility meets business value.

Other Important Responsibilities

Security & Data Privacy

In the tax industry, data is king. You will design for SOC2/GDPR compliance
and ensure data encryption and PII handling
are baked into the architecture.

Cloud Governance

Optimize cloud resource usage, mainly Azure
, to ensure the architecture is cost-effective as we scale.

Legacy Modernization

Identify opportunities to refactor or replace technical debt
without disrupting ongoing business operations.

Technical Mentorship

Provide guidance to senior developers to ensure the architectural vision is understood and implemented correctly.

Key Qualifications

Experience

7+ years in software development, with at least 3 years in an Architect or Lead Developer role
. FinTech or RegTech experience is a massive plus.

System Design

Proven track record of building distributed systems or microservices-based architectures
.

Communication

Ability to explain O(n) complexity to a developer and "system uptime ROI" to a CEO in the same afternoon.

Tools

Proficiency with modelling tools (e.g. Mermaid)
and modern CI/CD pipelines
.

Location: Bahrain (on-site)
Type: Contract · 68 days across 26 weeks
Rate: USD 463 per day
Covered by Toga EMEA: work visa, flights to and from Bahrain, and hotel while on site

The role
Toga EMEA is looking for a Solution Architect to act as design authority on a customer-facing web portal. The portal sits over a live Oracle 19c system of record, and it has to work without changing that system. You own the interface between the two.

The 68 days are heaviest in the first seven weeks, while the design is set. After that, the role is design authority: you review the build; you do not write it.

What you will own

The technical specification and integration design — architecture, hosting, database, scalability and business continuity.
The adapter to the core system: REST, SOAP where it is required, webhooks and SFTP.
Role-based access control across several organisations sharing one portal.
The non-functional design: 99.9% availability, pages under three seconds, and room to add further customers and sites.
Single sign-on with the client's existing identity setup, and an audit trail that records who changed what, before and after, and when.
What you bring

10+ years in software, 4+ of them as an architect.
ASP.NET Core and ASP.NET MVC architecture.
Oracle 19c data modelling and PL/SQL.
REST APIs specified in OpenAPI 3.0.
Load-balanced IIS and high-availability design on Windows Server.
Security architecture across TLS 1.2+, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SAML.
Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to defend a design in front of a client.
Terms

USD 463 per day for days worked, invoiced monthly and paid 15 days after the client pays Toga.
Work visa, flights and hotel for on-site days are arranged and paid by Toga EMEA.
Subject to contract and to the client's approval of your CV.
How to apply
Send your CV to tega@togaemea.com with a short note on the Oracle-backed systems you have designed.

Please note, this role is open to candidates based in both the UAE and India locations.

Key responsibilities

• Lead technical discovery with client business, data, security and technology stakeholders; convert business priorities into qualified AI use cases, solution requirements and a practical delivery approach.
• Design secure, scalable enterprise architectures for generative AI, agentic AI, conversational AI, intelligent search, document intelligence and AI-enabled applications using the Microsoft cloud stack.
• Build working demonstrations, accelerators and proof-of-concepts using production-relevant patterns not only mock-ups to validate feasibility, user experience, integration and expected value.
• Own the technical workstream of RFPs, RFIs and proposals, including architecture, solution narrative, scope, assumptions, dependencies, non-functional requirements, effort estimates, bill of materials and delivery risks.
• Define RAG, grounding, tool-use, memory, orchestration, evaluation, observability and human-in-the-loop patterns appropriate to each use case.
• Assess model and platform choices across quality, latency, throughput, security, data residency, responsible AI and cost; explain the trade-offs clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
• Present solutions in workshops, solution reviews, demonstrations and bid presentations; respond credibly to detailed questions from enterprise architecture, cybersecurity and procurement teams.
• Work with account, industry and delivery teams to shape opportunities, identify reusable assets and position differentiators without overcommitting scope or capability.
• Support technical due diligence, implementation planning and handover after award, ensuring that proposal commitments are understood, feasible and traceable into delivery.
• Maintain current knowledge of Microsoft AI services, reference architectures, licensing and emerging agentic patterns, and turn that knowledge into reusable pre-sales assets.

Required experience and capabilities

• 10+ years of professional experience across software engineering, cloud architecture, AI/ML engineering or enterprise solution consulting.
• At least 5 years of hands-on experience specifically designing and building generative AI solutions using large language models, including enterprise RAG and/or AI agents.
• Demonstrable experience delivering AI or advanced analytics solutions beyond proof-of-concept stage, with a strong understanding of production engineering, security, monitoring and operational support.
• Strong hands-on development capability in Python and APIs/SDKs; experience with C#/.NET is advantageous.
• Deep understanding of LLM application patterns: prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, tool/function calling, structured outputs, agent orchestration, evaluation and guardrails.
• Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, document repositories and identity platforms.
• Strong knowledge of cloud security, Entra ID, managed identities, private networking, secrets management, role-based access control, data privacy and responsible AI controls.
• Proven client-facing experience in discovery, solution presentations, technical writing, estimation and proposal development for complex enterprise opportunities.
• Ability to produce clear architecture diagrams, sequence flows, assumptions, sizing models and implementation plans under bid deadlines.
• Excellent written and verbal English; able to challenge requirements constructively and communicate complex concepts without unnecessary jargon.

Preferred qualifications

• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or equivalent current Microsoft credentials.
• Experience in regulated or government environments, including security review, data residency and private-cloud/hybrid integration requirements.
• Experience estimating Azure AI consumption, model throughput/capacity, search capacity, infrastructure and licensing for commercial proposals.
• Experience creating reusable accelerators, reference architectures or demo environments for an AI consulting or technology pre-sales organisation.

new_jobs.title: .NET Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Jouw functie

PGGM ontwikkelt veel van haar software zelf. Deze maatwerkoplossingen zijn een essentieel onderdeel van onze dienstverlening én een cruciale succesfactor voor de toekomst. Met belangrijke uitdagingen zoals de implementatie van de nieuwe pensioenwetgeving staan we voor complexe technische- en architectuurvraagstukken.

Als .NET DevOps Engineer ontwerp en bouw je hoogwaardige .NET oplossingen en generieke services binnen een complex landschap van maatwerkapplicaties, ingekochte pakketten, een BI‑-platform en diverse portalen. Jij brengt software‑ engineeringsvakmanschap samen met architectuurinzicht en neemt end‑-‑to-end ‑verantwoordelijkheid voor jouw oplossingen.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Lead developer, softwarearchitecten en andere engineers aan het toekomstbestendig maken van onze applicaties en ondersteunt de beweging naar de Azure Cloud. Je maakt technische keuzes op basis van feiten, ontwerpprincipes en standaarden.

Wat je gaat doen~

Ontwerpen, bouwen en verbeteren van robuuste .NET applicaties, services en integraties;
Toepassen van DDD, onion architecture, integratiepatronen en dependency injection;
Realiseren van REST ‑API’s en complexe koppelingen in een divers applicatielandschap;
Bijdragen aan architectuurkeuzes, kwaliteit, consistentie en technische standaarden;
End-‑to-end ‑verantwoordelijkheid~ analyse → bouwen → testen → releasen → run & observe;
Versterken van CI/CD, automatisering, security-by-design (o.a. RBAC) en observability (ELK);
Coachend optreden richting minder ervaren engineers door reviews, pairing en het demonstreren van best practices;
Samenwerken met architectuur, Cloud Enablement, Product Owners en andere engineeringdisciplines voor team overstijgende oplossingen.

Engineering Mindset~
jij bent de drijvende kracht achter topkwaliteit

Bij PB‑IT zoeken we een DevOps Engineer die méér brengt dan techniek alleen. Onze Engineering Mindset bestaande uit Samenwerking, Nieuwsgierigheid, Vakmanschap, Energie en Eigenaarschap is de manier waarop jij het verschil maakt.

Je werkt soepel team overstijgend samen en brengt mensen bij elkaar om de flow in de keten te versnellen. Je blijft nieuwsgierig, stelt scherpe vragen en initieert verbeteringen die echt waarde toevoegen. Met jouw vakmanschap ben je een inhoudelijk autoriteit~ je maakt doordachte keuzes, bewaakt kwaliteit en helpt collega’s groeien door jouw voorbeeldgedrag. Je straalt energie uit, brengt focus en creëert momentum zodat teams met vertrouwen vooruitkomen. En je neemt eigenaarschap over de hele keten~ je bouwt, levert, monitort én verbetert zonder dat iemand je erom hoeft te vragen.

Als DevOps engineer ben jij de verbindende kracht die richting geeft, kwaliteit verhoogt en onze engineering naar een hoger niveau tilt.

Jouw afdeling

Met circa 1.850 collega’s verzorgen wij de pensioenadministratie voor 5,6 miljoen Nederlanders, waarvan 2,8 miljoen in Zorg & Welzijn. Met een vermogen van €252 miljard onder beheer behoren we tot de grootste institutionele beleggers ter wereld.

Cluster Deelnemers is de Robin Hood van de IT Clusters. Daar waar het Werkgevers Cluster zorgt dat geld binnenkomt zorgt het Deelnemers cluster dat elke deelnemer krijgt waar hij/zij recht op heeft. Met €1,1 miljard euro jaarlijks uitgekeerd is het belangrijk dat we zaken goed en zorgvuldig voor elkaar hebben.

Onze missie~ mensen helpen bij het realiseren van een waardevolle en zorgeloze toekomst. Duurzaamheid, maatschappelijke relevantie en betrouwbaarheid staan daarbij centraal.

PGGM zoekt versterking bij het toekennen team~

Team Toekennen opereert zowel aan de voor- als achterkant van de keten rondom de pensioenadministratie. Toekennen is, zoals je zou verwachten, verantwoordelijk voor de toekenning van een pensioen aan een deelnemer. Als centrale applicatie in het landschap heb je een belangrijke taak als team. Niet alleen om alles draaiende en functioneel juist te hebben maar ook als keyteam in het proces. Als onderdeel van het cluster Deelnemers draag je samen met ons bij aan de administratie van meerdere fondsen en werk je intensief samen met collega’s uit de business om processen soepel en zorgvuldig te laten verlopen. We zijn een groeiend backend-team van ongeveer 10–15 collega’s, waarin leergierigheid, flexibiliteit en samenwerking centraal staan. We zoeken actief de verbinding met andere teams op en pakken graag kansen om te innoveren waar mogelijk. Onze gezamenlijke drive is om continu te verbeteren en bij te dragen aan een toekomstbestendige pensioenketen.

Het team is van A tot Z verantwoordelijk is voor het ontwikkelen en beheren van functionaliteiten die door de product owner voor dat domein worden geprioriteerd. Daarbij werk je naar (voorlopige) resultaten toe, met een flexibele aanpak. Je werkt met een Microsoft toolstack met tools als Azure Devops, SQL Server, Visual Studio (C#) en MS Test. Hiermee bouwen en onderhouden we onze software. Software die we regelmatig naar productie brengen via een geautomatiseerde pipeline.

Jouw achtergrond

Als DevOps Engineer neem jij sowieso dit mee~

HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met IT-achtergrond;
Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring in .NET softwareontwikkeling;
Ervaring met .NET (Core), Entity Framework, REST, MS SQL;
Ervaring met DDD, architectuurpatronen, integratiepatronen, DI, onion architecture;
Kennis van Azure, MS Build/Pipelines, Git, testautomatisering en RBAC-principes;
Eerder gewerkt in Agile/Scrum DevOps‑context;
Ervaring met of zicht op cloudtransities (Azure);
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Verder vinden we het belangrijk dat~

Je bent in staat om team overstijgend te denken in keten, architectuur en standaarden;
Je kan technische keuzes onderbouwen, uitleggen en verdedigen wanneer nodig;
Je zet de standaard voor professioneel engineer‑gedrag;
Je stuurt op kwaliteit, flow en samenwerking in de keten;
Je hebt een sterke stem in techniek.

Wij bieden

Bij PGGM zijn we trots op onze kernwaarden~ vertrouwen, teamwork en innovatie. Deze waarden zijn ontstaan uit de ‘best stories’ van onze collega's, momenten waarop zij op hun best waren. We geloven dat die momenten ontstaan wanneer je 100% jezelf kunt zijn. Bij PGGM waarderen we de unieke combinatie van jouw persoonlijke en professionele eigenschappen. Want wat echt telt bij PGGM zijn mensen, honderd procent! Bij PGGM mag jij rekenen op~

Een fijne werkplek op ons kantoor in Zeist/Den Haag en vanaf medio 2028 in hartje Utrecht.
Een bruto maandsalaris, in schaal schaal 15, tussen € 4.101,- en € 5.859,- op basis van 36 uur, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
Vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand.
Een goede pensioenregeling als deelnemer van pensioenfonds PFZW (71% betaald door PGGM, 29% door de medewerker).
Jaarlijks een Fit for the Future budget van € 300,- netto welke je kunt inzetten voor het verbeteren van de mentale, fysieke of financiële fitheid.
Een ruim opleidingsbudget voor interne en externe trainingen of opleidingen.
Ruim 26 vakantiedagen (medewerkers hebben de keuze om maximaal twee nationale christelijke feestdagen te ruilen met een voor hen belangrijke (feest)dag).
Flexibiliteit in werktijden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden.
Een netto internetvergoeding van € 45,- per maand (€ 540,- per jaar).

Informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure vind je terug op onze website~ Onze sollicitatieprocedure. | PGGM.

PGGM en hybride werken

Bij PGGM hebben we een hybride werkomgeving gecreëerd die ons in staat stelt om flexibiliteit en samenwerking te combineren. Onze medewerkers hebben de mogelijkheid om zowel op kantoor als op afstand te werken, afhankelijk van hun persoonlijke voorkeuren en de aard van hun werk. Door hybride werken aan te bieden, willen we onze medewerkers de vrijheid geven om hun eigen werkstijl te ontwikkelen, maar tegelijkertijd de voordelen van een gezamenlijke werkplek behouden.

Behandeling sollicitatie

new_jobs.title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
new_jobs.description:
Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat
ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?

Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.

Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.

Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
goede kennis van C# en .NET;
ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.

Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.

Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.

Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?

Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.

Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.

Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

Werken met de gaafste automerken!
Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken
8,5 medewerkers tevredenheid

new_jobs.description:
As a Full stack Developer
at ORTEC LogiqCare, you will have a unique opportunity to explore the many facets of software engineering within an innovative, international organization.

Please note: for this role you need to be eligible to live and work in the Netherlands without sponsorship.

Your enthusiasm and thirst for knowledge are what pulls you out of bed in the morning. You’re looking for a career opportunity that allows you to prove yourself and your skills, day after day. You want your experience and capabilities to have a life-changing impact on other people. You are the Full-Stack Software Engineer we are looking for.

The Clinical Care & Research team is leveraging data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning and cutting-edge techniques to push the healthcare industry to the next level. We develop software applications for medical care and (bio)medical research: clinical decision-making tools, medical workflow support and applications for scientific research. These applications cover a broad area of medicine, e.g. cardiovascular medicine (most notably U-Prevent), oncology, lung disease and various other disciplines (e.g. rheumatology, pregnancy, toxicological prediction models).

The Healthcare platform has been written from scratch using modern architecture techniques like microservices, CQRS and event sourcing. We use DDD (domain-driven design) to get a thought-through domain model that closely models the business and provides us with a functional decomposition that maps to decoupled services. We use Angular and Typescript for frontend development and C# for backend development.

Who you are

1) Experience with:
· designing software, e.g. know what design patterns and SOLID are
· writing technical designs
· front-end development: Angular, Typescript, Cypress, Playwright
· back-end development: .NET 10.0, C#
· cloud development, specifically Azure cloud (e. g. services like App Service, Web Jobs, Application Insights, CosmosDB, Service Bus, Azure SQL, etc.)
2) Used to working in an agile software development environment, with: code reviews, unit testing, continuous integration/deployment
3) Familiar with or strong interest in Domain-driven design
4) Willingness to take part in on-call duties to support our customers 24/7 (approx. 8 weeks per year). You will be generously compensated.

What we offer

An open, friendly, and informal atmosphere with a strong emphasis on work-life balance.
A team of motivated colleagues who organize numerous enjoyable activities for employees.
Experience: Learn from day one while applying your knowledge in practice! We believe in your growth and provide the support and training necessary for your development.
A permanent contract with a salary in the range of € 4100,- and € 5020.- gross per month
An end-of-year bonus (13th month).
A mobility allowance of 3% of your gross monthly salary, seperate commuting allowance and business travel (or the option of an NS Business card).
Pension contributions.
Holiday pay.
25 vacation days, with additional days granted from age 35.
Compensation for private internet connection and a home working allowance.
A well-equipped workspace, including furniture and IT resources for remote work.

If you recognize yourself in this role, we are really keen to hear from you. Please upload both your CV and also your motivation letter and we will get back to you as soon as possible after your application.

What to expect

We will help you to thrive in your field of expertise. We offer development programs, tailored to your individual needs and function requirements, including opportunities to attend courses and seminars. We offer challenging, practical hands-on experience with opportunities to work abroad. We operate in a flat organizational structure that keeps communication lines short. The atmosphere is open, informal, cooperative and positive. We employ over 900 people in the Netherlands (HQ), Belgium, Germany, France, the U.K., Romania, Italy, the U.S., Australia, Brazil, Poland, Denmark and Singapore. Visit our website ortec.com to learn more about our solutions and clients’ experiences. Please do not use this vacancy as an acquisition opportunity.

new_jobs.title: iOS Developer
new_jobs.description:
Do you want to shape the technical direction of mobile solutions used daily by professionals, within a team of experienced and highly skilled developers? Do you take ownership of complex applications, architectural decisions, and team development, and enjoy collaborating and sparring at a senior level? Then this role as Senior Mobile Apps Developer at 4PS is for you.

Who are we?

4PS offers a comprehensive portfolio of ERP solutions based on Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, including related portals and apps, for companies in the construction industry. With over 400 professionals, we work every day on applications that make a real difference for our 450 customers worldwide.

Within our development teams, you will work alongside experienced and highly capable colleagues. We have a mature team with a strong mix of senior, medior, and specialized profiles. This means that as a senior you will not only provide direction but also engage in meaningful discussions at a high level and collaborate with peers who are used to taking ownership and delivering quality.

We are passionate and take pride in delivering results. As a team, we support and inspire each other, share knowledge, and grow professionally. In addition to working hard, we highly value enjoyment. We foster this by organizing regular social activities and maintaining a relaxed work environment.

4PS Group is now part of the Hilti Group. Together, we are working towards the mission: “Making Construction Better”.

What will you do?

As a Senior Mobile Apps Developer, you play a key role within the development team. You are responsible for designing, building, and continuously improving mobile applications for Android and iOS, ensuring they are scalable, high-performing, and future-proof.

You are involved in the full software development lifecycle and take the lead in technical decision-making. You ensure quality, security, and maintainability, while actively contributing to continuous improvement of processes and ways of working.

You work in a multidisciplinary Scrum team and act as a sparring partner for product managers, UX/UI designers, and other stakeholders. You take ownership of complex features and contribute to a strong team dynamic through knowledge sharing and coaching.

Your Key Responsibilities

Defining and safeguarding the technical architecture of mobile applications
Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable mobile solutions
Making well-founded choices in frameworks, tooling, and technologies
Taking end-to-end ownership of complex features and projects
Integrating APIs and external services
Ensuring code quality, performance, security, and maintainability
Setting up and improving CI/CD processes and automation
Coaching and mentoring junior and mid-level developers
Acting as the technical point of contact for stakeholders
Identifying risks and proactively proposing solutions

How do you work?

You are part of a Scrum team and collaborate closely with Product Management, UX/UI, and other development teams. You actively participate in Agile/Scrum processes and contribute to effective collaboration and continuous improvement.

You translate functional requirements into robust technical solutions, considering user experience, performance, and various scenarios such as offline and online usage.

What do you bring?

At least 5+ years of experience as a Software Developer, including several years in mobile development
At least 5 years of experience with .NET (preferably .NET Core / .NET 6+);
Experience with ASP.NET Core (developing REST APIs and backend services);
Experience with .NET MAUI or similar mobile frameworks (e.g. Xamarin);
Proven experience in mobile app development (Android and/or iOS);
Strong experience with Git (branching, pull requests, code reviews);
Strong knowledge of software design principles (SOLID, DRY, Clean Code) Proven ability to build maintainable and testable software;
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills;
Affinity with mobile app development (UX, performance, offline/online scenarios);
Ownership mindset and end-to-end responsibility for quality and delivery;
Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.

Nice to have

Experience with CI/CD (e.g. YAML pipelines)
Experience with Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines)
Experience with test automation (UI testing such as Appium and API/integration testing)
Experience with Azure or other cloud environments
Experience with monitoring and logging (e.g. Application Insights)
Knowledge of performance optimization (mobile and backend)
Experience with AI tools in development (e.g. Copilot, AI-assisted testing)

Who are you?

You enjoy working independently and take strong ownership of your work and results. You have a clear and well-developed technical vision, which you are able to communicate effectively and convincingly to others. At the same time, you thrive in a collaborative environment, contribute actively to teamwork, and see yourself as a true team player.

What can you expect from us?

An excellent salary with a year-end bonus;
Working with high-end and the latest software from Microsoft and other vendors;
A great workplace at our office in Ede, with all facilities to support your work;
Flexibility in working hours and location, including remote work and a home office allowance;
28 vacation days based on full-time employment, with the option to purchase additional days;
An ambitious and highly skilled team with experienced colleagues
Increasing focus on AI and process optimization;
Work that has a direct impact on customers and the industry;
A role within an organization with strong national and international ambitions;
A position where you can make an impact, with a high level of autonomy, independence, and responsibility;
A certified Great Place to Work, recognized by our own colleagues;
4PS Academy – the place for internal and external training;
4PS Life – focused on a healthy and enjoyable work-life balance (e.g. LAN parties, social drinks, fresh fruit, periodic health checks, and company events).

new_jobs.title: Senior IT System Engineer – Infrastructure & Cloud
new_jobs.description:
Werk aan IT die direct invloed heeft op bedrijfsprocessen

Bij veel IT-dienstverleners eindigt het werk van een senior engineer in tickets, changes en incidenten. Servers patchen, werkplekken herstellen en storingen oplossen zodra gebruikers ze melden.

Bij SPS IT Group
is dat anders, wij zorgen voor IT Regie.

Onze klanten draaien processen die niet mogen stilvallen: zorgregistraties, logistieke ketens, productieomgevingen en andere bedrijfskritische applicaties.

In zulke omgevingen is het bij een verstoring zelden eenvoudig om de oorzaak te vinden. De oorzaak ligt namelijk vrijwel altijd in de complexiteit tussen identity, applicaties, databases, netwerken, cloudplatformen en externe leveranciers.

Daarom beheren wij geen losse systemen, maar de digitale keten.
Wij noemen dat IT-Regie
: organisaties grip geven op hun digitale continuïteit.

Met ons eigen platform Gensys
maken we afhankelijkheden inzichtelijk en voorkomen we verstoringen in plaats van ze alleen op te lossen.

Als Senior IT System Engineer werk je dus niet alleen aan infrastructuur — je werkt aan de betrouwbaarheid van complete IT-platformen en digitale bedrijfsprocessen.

De rol

Je werkt binnen ons Managed Services team aan meerdere klantomgevingen. Dat betekent variatie, maar vooral complexiteit: verschillende architecturen, meerdere clouds en afhankelijkheden tussen systemen en leveranciers.

Je bent een technisch regisseur binnen ons operations team en je werk bestaat hierbij uit de volgende drie domeinen:

1. Platform & Hybrid Cloud Engineering

beheren en verbeteren van hybride IT-omgevingen (on-premise en Azure)
Windows Server, virtualisatie en werkplekomgevingen
identity- en security-inrichting (AD / Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA)
performance- en stabiliteitsverbeteringen
moderniseren van bestaande omgevingen

2. Automation & Preventief Beheer

automatiseren van provisioning en beheer (PowerShell, IaC, scripting)
standaardiseren van omgevingen
elimineren van terugkerende incidenten
toepassen van monitoring en voorspellend beheer

3. Ketenmonitoring & Reliability Engineering

Je werkt actief met onze ketenmonitoringomgeving (Gensys).
Daarmee controleren we niet alleen of een server draait, maar of een bedrijfsproces functioneert.
Je onderzoekt bijvoorbeeld waarom een applicatie niet werkt terwijl alle systemen “groen” lijken, door afhankelijkheden te analyseren tussen:
identity
databases
netwerken
applicaties
cloud services
externe koppelingen en leveranciers

Je voert root cause analyses uit over meerdere lagen en implementeert structurele oplossingen zodat verstoringen worden voorkomen in plaats van alleen opgelost.

Je werk verschuift daarmee van reactief beheer naar reliability engineering.

Werken met én invloed hebben op ons eigen platform

Een belangrijk verschil met andere IT-dienstverleners is dat wij niet alleen tooling gebruiken — wij ontwikkelen ons eigen platform.

Wij werken dagelijks met Gensys
, onze ketenmonitoring- en IT-Regie software. Omdat dit ons eigen platform is, heb je als engineer directe invloed op hoe de tooling werkt en hoe wij onze dienstverlening uitvoeren.

Je denkt actief mee over:
welke informatie engineers nodig hebben om sneller te analyseren
hoe monitoring en automatisering slimmer ingericht kan worden
hoe terugkerend beheer geëlimineerd kan worden
welke inzichten klanten nodig hebben om hun IT-omgeving beter te besturen

Je signaleert in de praktijk waar tijd verloren gaat of analyses beter kunnen, en vertaalt dit samen met onze developers en architecten naar aanpassingen in de software.

Daardoor los je niet alleen problemen op voor één klant, maar verbeter je structureel onze dienstverlening voor alle klanten tegelijk.

Je helpt dus niet alleen IT beheren, je helpt mee bouwen aan het platform waarmee wij IT-dienstverlening anders organiseren.

Waar je technisch mee werkt

Cloud & Platform

Microsoft Azure
Windows Server
hybrid cloud architecturen

Identity & Security

Active Directory / Entra ID
Conditional Access & MFA
PKI / certificaten
Endpoint security

Automation

PowerShell
Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
standaardisatie en scripting

Virtualisatie & Workspaces

VMware
RDS / werkplekomgevingen
Citrix (pré)

Monitoring & Analyse

monitoring en observability
performance analyse
root cause analyse
preventief beheer
back up management

Dit spreekt je aan

Dan herken jij jezelf waarschijnlijk in meerdere van deze punten:
Je bent klaar met alleen brandjes blussen
Je wilt structurele oplossingen bouwen in plaats van workarounds
Je denkt in systemen en afhankelijkheden, niet in losse servers
Je automatiseert liever één keer goed dan twintig keer handmatig
Je wilt begrijpen waarom iets stuk gaat, niet alleen dat het stuk is
Security en identity zie je als onderdeel van infrastructuur
Je wilt technisch inhoudelijk blijven én impact hebben

Dit breng jij mee

MBO-4 ICT (minimaal) met HBO werk- en denkniveau
meerdere jaren ervaring als System / Infrastructure / Cloud Engineer
ervaring met Microsoft-omgevingen (hybrid of cloud)
ervaring met PowerShell of automatisering
analytisch vermogen en in staat zelfstandig en in team verband te werken
Microsoft certificeringen

Wat je van ons krijgt

Salaris vanaf €4.000 p/m (o.b.v. een 40-urige werkweek en afhankelijk van ervaring)
Overwerkvergoeding, bonus- en winstdelingsregeling
25 vakantiedagen + max. 13 variabele verlofdagen
Opleidingsbudget en onbeperkt studiemateriaal
Laptop en iPhone
Mogelijkheid tot hybride werken
Internet- en thuiswerkvergoeding
Interne technische kennissessies

Maar belangrijker:

Je komt in een omgeving waar engineers betrokken zijn bij analyse, automatisering en structurele verbeteringen van complexe IT-landschappen. Je krijgt ruimte om mee te bouwen aan hoe moderne IT-dienstverlening eruit hoort te zien.

new_jobs.title: Software-ingenieur
new_jobs.description:
Voor engineers die graag impact maken in een hightech omgeving, is dit zo’n rol waarin techniek en ontwikkeling echt samenkomen. Werken aan hightech machines, slimme software bouwen en samen met andere specialisten technische innovaties naar een hoger niveau tillen. Daar worden wij enthousiast van. Daarom zorgen we er bij Ndus3 voor dat jij inhoudelijk wordt uitgedaagd, kunt blijven groeien en terechtkomt in een omgeving waar techniek, samenwerking en kwaliteit centraal staan.

Wij zijn op zoek naar een Software Developer met een passie voor productontwikkeling en technische innovatie. Iemand die zich thuis voelt in een hightech R&D-omgeving, graag samenwerkt met verschillende disciplines en energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van software voor complexe machines en systemen.

Wat ga jij doen?

Als Software Developer werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling en verbetering van geavanceerde machines binnen een internationale hightech omgeving. Je vormt de schakel tussen requirements, architectuur en implementatie en draagt bij aan software die in de praktijk betrouwbaar en efficiënt moet functioneren. Jij houdt je bezig met:

Vertalen van product requirements naar concrete software requirements
Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van nieuwe functies, processen, concepten en ontwerpen onder begeleiding van een System Architect
Controleren en bespreken van werkresultaten van collega-developers
Begeleiden van prototyping, productie en software testen door informatie te verstrekken en technische problemen op te lossen
Technische ondersteuning bieden aan projectmanagers bij het plannen en bewaken van projecten
Coachen en inhoudelijk begeleiden van minder ervaren collega’s
Samenwerken met disciplines als software, motion, vision en hardware om tot hoogwaardige technische oplossingen te komen

Wat neem je mee?

Een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding in een technische richting, zoals Technische Informatica, Embedded Systems, Werktuigbouwkunde of Natuurkunde, met aantoonbare affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling
5 jaar relevante werkervaring als Software Developer, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar binnen een R&D-omgeving in de hightechindustrie
Ervaring binnen de machinebouw, apparatenbouw of een vergelijkbare technische ontwikkelomgeving is een sterke pré
Ervaring met objectgeoriënteerd programmeren, bijvoorbeeld in C++, C# of vergelijkbaar
Bekendheid met profiling tools en versiebeheersystemen zoals Git of Mercurial
Kennis van real-time machinebesturing en UML-modellering
Een sterk analytisch vermogen, een proactieve houding en een resultaatgerichte manier van werken
Je werkt graag samen, communiceert helder en voelt je prettig in een multidisciplinaire omgeving
Goede beheersing van zowel het Nederlands als Engels in woord en geschrift
Bereidheid om incidenteel internationaal te reizen ter ondersteuning van productielocaties en klanten

Wat krijg je?

Bij deze functie hoort een salaris van €3775 tot €4550 op fulltime basis (40 uur).

Je hebt de vrijheid om je werk zo in te richten dat het bij jou past. De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken maakt het makkelijker om een gezonde balans te houden tussen werk en privé. Uiteraard ondersteunen we je met een sterk mobiliteitspakket (km-vergoeding of leaseauto), plus een laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

Ontwikkeling staat centraal bij Ndus3. En dat bedoelen we niet als loze kreet. Met ons onbeperkte opleidingsbudget krijg je toegang tot trainingen en kennissessies om niet alleen op persoonlijk gebied te groeien, maar ook technische skills zoals ISTQB, Python, C++, SysML of testautomatisering verder te ontwikkelen. Of juist meer te groeien richting lead-rollen.

En je doet het niet alleen! Je werkt samen met een gezellige en nieuwsgierige club engineers die graag kennis delen en samen plezier maken. Denk aan klant lunches met professionals, LAB days vol kennisdeling, Innovation Groups, of Tech Tuesday-sessies waar klanten samenkomen om te netwerken en nieuwe inzichten op te doen.

Ook buiten de werkvloer merk je snel wat voor club Ndus3 is. Met onze driemaandelijkse Rocks gaan we samen op pad, en ja: dat kan zomaar eindigen in een kano in de Ardennen: vrij letterlijk in hetzelfde schuitje! Daarnaast weten we elkaar goed te vinden voor een borrel, een F1-simrace, indoor skydiven of een ander uitje.

We vertellen je graag alles over onze overige arbeidsvoorwaarden tijdens een persoonlijk gesprek!

Over Ndus3

Bij Ndus3 geloven we dat slimmere technologie de wereld mooier maakt. Daarom helpen wij de smart industry vooruit met de beste consultants en engineers.

Als consultant werk je aan uiteenlopende opdrachten bij toonaangevende hightech maakbedrijven op gebied van Manufacturing, Defence, Mobility en Energy. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan klanten als Lely, het Ministerie van Defensie, Yunex Traffic, Enercon, ElaadNL, of Terberg. Dé ideale plek om je loopbaan een boost te geven en ervaring op te doen in verschillende technische omgevingen.

Wat ons echt Ndus3 maakt, zit niet alleen in wat we doen, maar vooral in hoe we het doen: open gesprekken, oprechte interesse en teamspirit. Het zit in samen bouwen, lachen en vooruitgaan.

Daarnaast geloven we in de ontwikkeling van een betere toekomst en in de ontwikkeling van de makers van morgen. Daarom steunen we gelijke kansen via maatschappelijke initiatieven en sponsoren we technisch talent aan hogescholen en universiteiten. Iedereen is welkom bij Ndus3, ongeacht achtergrond, identiteit of carrièrepad.
