Als führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Softwarelösungen für das Gesundheitswesen sind wir in 19 Ländern tätig und beschäftigen über 9.000 engagierte Mitarbeitende. Du wirst in einem dynamischen und innovativen Umfeld arbeiten, das voller Möglichkeiten steckt. Mit Deinem Einsatz und Deiner Leidenschaft hast Du die Gelegenheit, einen nachhaltigen Unterschied zu machen.

CGM Leverages AI:
Wir suchen Menschen, die die Kraft von KI im E-Health-Umfeld spüren, den Wandel mitgestalten wollen und mit neugieriger Leidenschaft erkennen, wie Technologie Gesundheit smarter, einfacher und besser machen kann.

Gemeinsam gestalten wir das Gesundheitssystem der Zukunft. Werde Teil unserer Mission und mache den Unterschied – für eine Welt, in der Wissen Leben rettet!

Dein Beitrag:

Du verantwortest die Wartung und Weiterentwicklung unserer bestehenden Visual Basic 6-Anwendungen und sorgst für höchste Codequalität.
Du optimierst Legacy-Systeme und bringst sie mit modernen Technologien wie Cloud-Plattformen und aktuellen Datenbanken zusammen.
Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Fehleranalyse, Debugging und die Migration historischer Software auf neue Plattformen.
Du arbeitest mit Source-Control-Tools wie Git oder SVN und unterstützt unsere DevOps-Teams bei Automatisierungs- und CI/CD-Projekten.
Du kommunizierst Projekte, Anforderungen und Lösungen souverän mit Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Stakeholdern.

Das bringst Du mit:

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit Visual Basic 6 sowie Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, idealerweise auch Kenntnisse in DevOps und Cloud-Technologien.
Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Software-Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich, mit exzellenten Studienleistungen.
Tiefgehende Expertise in VB6, SQL-Server, Source-Control (Git, SVN), sowie idealerweise in Automatisierung, Cloud-Plattformen und Containerisierung.
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, starke Detailgenauigkeit, hohe Kommunikationskompetenz, Lernbereitschaft und dynamische Anpassungsfähigkeit.

Das kannst Du von uns erwarten:

Mobile Work: Arbeite flexibel an zwei Tagen pro Woche mobil und an 3 Tagen vor Ort.
Attraktive Standorte: An unseren Standorten erwarten Dich neben voll ausgestatteten Arbeitsplätzen auch regelmäßige Events wie Sommerfeste und Weihnachtsfeiern.
Langfristige Entwicklung: Bei uns bedeutet "Legacy" nicht Stillstand! Du bleibst auch nach Projektende Teil unseres Teams – mit individuellen Entwicklungspfaden und spannenden Perspektiven.
Gesundheit: Gesundheit ist für uns ein hohes Gut. In der hauseigenen Kantine gibt es jeden Tag eine Auswahl an leckeren und gesunden Gerichten und in unserem voll ausgestatteten Fitnessstudio heißen wir Dich in wöchentlichen Kursen gerne willkommen.
Mehr geht immer: Der Kindergarten auf unserem CGM-Campus in Koblenz unterstützt unsere Mitarbeitenden dabei, ihren Arbeitsalltag noch flexibler zu gestalten. Wir halten außerdem Corporate Benefits, die Möglichkeit eines Jobrads, BAV, u.v.m für Dich bereit.

Vielfalt ist Teil von CGM!
Wir freuen uns unabhängig von Behinderung, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität auf Deine Bewerbung.

Bewirb Dich jetzt online mit Deinen aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (inkl. Deiner Zeugnisse, Gehaltsvorstellung und nächstmöglichem Eintrittstermin).

Group Overview

The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,200 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

Role Overview

As a Full Stack C# Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and delivering high-quality, scalable applications that power critical business functions. This position requires strong technical expertise across front-end and back-end technologies, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to influence architectural decisions. You will work closely with product owners, architects, and other engineers to build innovative solutions that meet business needs while adhering to best practices in security, performance, and maintainability.

Role Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using modern frameworks and cloud technologies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software aligned with business objectives.
Implement and maintain microservices architecture and API integrations.
Ensure adherence to SDLC processes, including CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
Optimize application performance and ensure security best practices.
Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to evolving systems toward target state architecture.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in production environments.
Mentor junior engineers and promote engineering best practices.
Work within Agile delivery teams, contributing to planning, estimation, and retrospectives.
Stay current with emerging technologies and incorporate best practices into development.

Experience / Competences

Essential

Strong experience in full-stack development within enterprise environments.
Proficiency in front-end technologies: TypeScript, React (or similar frameworks).
Strong back-end experience with C# language.
SOLID principle.
Good understanding of RESTful APIs.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
Knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., GitLab).
Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and maintaining code quality.
Strong database skills (SQL).
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Desired

Experience with microservices and event-driven architectures.
Experience with AI assisted design and coding.
GraphQL, and WebSockets.
Knowledge of observability tools (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Grafana).
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
Understanding of financial markets or trading systems.
Contribution to open-source projects.
Awareness of security principles and DevSecOps practices.

Role Band & Level:

Professional/5

Not The Perfect Fit?

Concerned that you may not meet the criteria precisely? At TP ICAP, we wholeheartedly believe in fostering inclusivity and cultivating a work environment where everyone can flourish, regardless of your personal or professional background. If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience doesn't align perfectly with every aspect of the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply. You may be the ideal candidate for this position or another opportunity within our organisation. Our dedicated Talent Acquisition team is here to assist you in recognising how your unique skills and abilities can be a valuable contribution. Don't hesitate to take the leap and explore the possibilities. Your potential is what truly matters to us.

Company Statement

We know that the best innovation happens when diverse people with different perspectives and skills work together in an inclusive atmosphere. That's why we're building a culture where everyone plays a part in making people feel welcome, ready and willing to contribute. TP ICAP Accord - our Employee Network - is a central to this. As well as representing specific groups, TP ICAP Accord helps increase awareness, collaboration, shares best practice, and holds our firm to account for driving continuous cultural improvement.

new_jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
new_jobs.description:
How You’ll Support Our Mission

Our Data Platform team owns the development of a robust platform designed to empower all ESO customers to extract, transform, and utilize data from our various applications for their reporting needs. This platform supports multiple tools, including embedded third-party BI visualizations, a first-party flat file extractor, and direct SQL read-only access. We are committed to continuously enhancing these tools by adding new features, overhauling existing functionalities, and delivering the best possible user experience for our customers.

The team operates cross-functionally across the entire organization, supporting data mesh initiatives that enable domain teams to own their data products. We provide the platform and tooling needed to make this ownership seamless and effective, collaborating across time zones and countries to drive innovation.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will join our Data Platform team, contributing to its mission of enabling our customers and internal teams to fully harness the power of their data to improve community health and safety.

What You’ll Be Doing – The Day To Day

You can expect to work as a full-stack engineer with a focus on front-end development, helping balance the team’s expertise while being fully capable of contributing to and learning from back-end development efforts. This role is ideal for someone passionate about creating excellent user experiences while also diving into back-end systems regularly.

Our Current Stack:
C#, .NET Core, Angular, Typescript, Snowflake, Azure DevOps, Terraform, Azure PAAS / Serverless, EF Core, SQL Server, Redis, Sonar, Snyk, Cypress, Application Insights, New Relic. This is what you can expect to work with, but we are always open to using other technologies where they add value!

Our development engineers lead by championing a culture of personal ownership and customer-focused execution. We love those who pride themselves in how they contribute through excellent solutions and end-user experiences, as much as clean and clear code. Our team is made up of highly experienced engineers with a deep expertise across the stack, creating an incredible opportunity to learn from seasoned professionals while contributing your own skills and ideas. We foster an environment where collaboration and mentorship thrive, making it a supportive space to grow and refine your expertise.

We are an Agile development shop and interact regularly with project stakeholders to ensure that the solutions we build align with customer needs and business goals. To support this methodology, we use regular retrospectives and objective measurements to drive continuous improvement and empower our developers to make informed technology and implementation decisions. As part of the development process, you will be involved in design sessions, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn and teach through peer review of code and completed solutions.

Who You Are - some of the essential things required to be successful in the role:

Three+ years of experience in software engineering and software design and architecture principles. 
Two+ years of experience with Typescript and UI development in Angular.
Two+ years of experience with C# .NET. 
A solid understanding of SQL and relational database concepts for reporting.
Demonstrated experience with Git for source control, branching and merging (i.e. gitflow) 

Who You Are – it’s desirable if you have:

Experience of some of the following technologies, and a passion to learn and grow across many of the remainder:  

Logging, monitoring and alerting frameworks (e.g. Application Insights, New Relic)
OO concepts, design patterns, modern .NET web frameworks 
Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery, or other similar platforms focused on efficient data extraction, transformation, and reporting
Serverless, PAAS and containerized cloud applications 
Messaging and eventing technologies, (e.g. Azure Service Bus, MQ) 
Working with standardized external file structures (XML, JSON, Parquet, Fixed Length, etc.)

About ESO

ESO is a fast-paced, growing data, technology and research company passionate about improving community health and safety through the power of data. We pioneer innovative, user-friendly software to meet the changing needs of today’s EMS agencies, fire departments, and hospitals. We’re small enough to be nimble and fun, but big enough to be a great place to work. We serve thousands of customers out of our offices across the US, Canada and Northern Ireland.

A
re you ready to Make a Difference?

ESO is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at ESO regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religious or similar philosophical belief; race; national origin; political opinion; sexual orientation; disability; marital or civil partnership status or other non-merit factor.

Data Privacy

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Intelligent Document Processing
new_jobs.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. We use frontier LLMs to turn all of that into structured data that automations and AI agents can act on. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance.

It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is "not well enough", is a large part of the job.

You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. We're looking for someone who loves building things, learns fast, and wants to own product outcomes rather than tickets.

What You'll Do At UiPath

Work with engineers, product managers and customers to design, build and operate the AI systems behind UiPath's document processing products.
Build across the pipeline: ingestion, parsing and extraction, indexing and retrieval, and the evaluation that tells us any of it is working.
Take features from idea to production and stay with them, measuring whether they actually worked, and improving them when they didn't.
Solve genuinely hard problems in concurrency, latency and distributed systems, so the platform holds up under high-volume production workloads.
Build for environments we don't control: multi-cloud, on-premises, air-gapped, and under strict security and compliance requirements.
Use coding agents as a serious part of your toolkit, and help the team get better at it. Where to trust them, where not to, and how to keep quality high as the tooling changes underneath us.
Work with teams across UiPath and across locations to innovate and build best-in-class document processing, and occasionally with customers directly. Because the fastest way to understand a product is to watch someone use it.
Contribute to our engineering culture: mentor, review, hire, and push back when something isn't good enough.

What You'll Bring To The Team

A solid track record (5+ years) building and operating large-scale commercial services that real customers depend on.
Strong programming ability and the confidence to pick up whatever language a problem calls for. You'll meet Python, Rust and C# here, but we don't expect you to arrive knowing them all.
Real-world experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and containerised deployment on Kubernetes. You understand how production systems get shipped, monitored and scaled, not just written.
Comfort with data at scale: SQL, and the trade-offs between different storage and search systems.
Experience working with coding agents, and opinions about them, What responsible use looks like, where they earn their keep and where they cost you, and how you keep evaluating them in an ecosystem that changes every few months.
An appreciation for tools that catch bugs before runtime — type systems, tests, and designs that make bad states unrepresentable. Especially in the age of coding agents.
A pragmatic grasp of computer science fundamentals. We care about solving real problems with the right data structure, not reciting one from a textbook.
Experience shipping LLM-backed products to production is a strong plus: prompting, evaluation, and everything else that turns a model into a feature people will trust.
Familiarity with document processing is a plus: OCR, layout, and the messy reality of documents as they actually arrive.
An opinion on what makes good code and good architecture, and the ability to argue it, including against us.
You're a builder and a problem-solver at heart.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. As organisations adopt cloud-first strategies, strong architecture is essential to ensure platforms are well-designed, governed and able to deliver long-term value. Ofgem plays a vital role in the UK’s energy system, protecting consumers and enabling a more secure, fair and sustainable energy future, and a robust Architecture capability is central to this mission.

Within the Digital, Data and Security Services (DDSS) directorate, we are modernising our technology estate and expanding our use of Microsoft Azure as a core platform. This includes building secure, scalable and cost-effective solutions that support data, AI and digital services across the organisation.

As a Principal Technical Architect (Azure), you will play a key role in shaping how Azure is designed and used across Ofgem. You will define standards and governance, guide technical decision-making and support delivery teams to build high-quality cloud solutions. Working across programmes and domains, you will ensure architectural consistency, manage risk and embed architectural best practice across our Azure environment.

This is a highly influential technical role within a fast-paced and evolving environment, requiring deep Azure expertise and strong architectural capability.

Job description

You will be responsible for:

Defining and shaping Azure architecture standards, aligned to organisational and government frameworks
Establishing and embedding architectural patterns, principles and governance
Providing oversight and assurance for complex cloud solutions
Supporting architectural decision-making and managing technical risk
Promoting reusable frameworks and best practice across teams
Collaborating with stakeholders to align technology and business needs
Evaluating emerging Azure capabilities and supporting their adoption
Mentoring architects and engineers, building capability across DDSS

We are looking for:

A highly experienced technical architect who can shape and guide cloud architecture in a complex environment. You will bring strong Azure expertise alongside the ability to influence across teams.
You may come from a infrastructure, cloud, enterprise or platform background, but you will demonstrate:

Strong experience designing and delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure
Solid understanding of cloud architecture, governance and optimisation
Experience contributing to architectural standards and decision-making
Knowledge of security, identity and compliance in cloud environments
Ability to collaborate across teams and guide technical outcomes

Relevant certifications (e.g. Azure Solutions Architect Expert) is expected (or achievable).
Experience with Infrastructure as Code, DevOps or regulated environments is beneficial.
This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping Ofgem’s architecture capability and Azure cloud platform. You will help ensure systems are secure, scalable and fit for the future, supporting digital transformation and services that impact consumers across Great Britain.

Person specification

Essential Criteria

Extensive experience in design and delivery of complex solutions on Microsoft Azure (Lead Criteria).

Demonstrable proficiency in technical direction, team mentorship, and guidance across multi-disciplinary IT teams and architects (Lead Criteria).

Understanding Azure security frameworks, compliance standards, and identity management models.
Proven capability in the definition and implementation of governance models for cloud adoption and optimisation.
Proficiency in architectural modelling tools such as Archi and frameworks, such as ArchiMate, UML, or equivalent, with the ability to create and maintain architectural artefacts.

Holds or can obtain the following certifications or equivalent:

Formal Architectural Qualification such as BCS EA Certification or equivalent.
Cloud Architecture Certification: Microsoft Azure Solution Architect (Expert).

Desirable Criteria

Experience with Infrastructure as Code and DevOps practices.
Understanding government digital standards and assurance processes.

Behaviours

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:
Seeing the Big Picture
Making Effective Decisions
Leadership

Technical skills

You will also be asked to prepare a presentation. Full details of the presentation will be included in the invitation to interview.

Benefits
Alongside your salary of £63,443, OFGEM contributes £18,379 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

Ofgem can offer you a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes; 30 days annual leave after 2 years; Excellent training and development opportunities; The opportunity to join the generous Civil Service pension which also includes a valuable range of benefits; hybrid working (currently 1 day a week in the office but this is kept under review), flexible working hours and family friendly policies. Plus lots of other benefits including clean and bright offices based centrally, engaged networks and teams and an opportunity to contribute to our ambitious and important targets of establishing a Net Zero energy system by 2050. This exciting blend of professional challenge and personal reward identifies career opportunities at Ofgem as something to get excited about.

My client is looking for a AEP Data Architect to join there team.

The AEP / RT-CDP Data Architect will lead the design and ongoing development of the organisation’s customer data foundation within Adobe Experience Platform (AEP). With a strong emphasis on Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform (RT-CDP), this position is accountable for ensuring customer data can be collected, structured, connected, governed, and activated effectively across the enterprise.
Serving as the technical authority for the AEP data layer, the architect will turn marketing and business objectives into scalable data solutions. They will collaborate with solution architects, data engineers, marketing teams, and security and privacy stakeholders to enable real-time personalisation, customer analytics, and activation across channels.

This is a contract role and is 3.5 days Per week. There maybe occasional travel into the London based office.

Principal Accountabilities

Set the architectural direction for the complete AEP and RT-CDP data lifecycle, covering source ingestion, XDM design, identity resolution, profile configuration, and downstream activation.
Develop and maintain Adobe Experience Data Model (XDM) schemas, datasets, and data flows for both profile-enabled and non-profile use cases.
Create reusable architecture patterns and technical standards for batch, streaming, and real-time data ingestion.
Design solutions that can scale across multiple brands, markets, and regions where required.
Define how data from a range of source platforms and applications should be onboarded into AEP.
Determine the appropriate modelling approach for customer attributes, behavioural events, and other data types, applying established XDM best practices.
Work alongside data engineering teams to ensure ingestion processes are reliable, performant, maintainable, and properly documented.
Establish and govern the RT-CDP identity framework, including identity namespaces, matching and stitching rules, and merge policies.
Set standards for profile enablement and define the criteria that data must meet before it is ready for audience creation and activation.
Convert business, marketing, and customer-experience requirements into clear data architecture blueprints and detailed solution designs.
Provide authoritative guidance on AEP data design throughout discovery, implementation, and delivery.
Review proposed solutions, identify technical and data-related risks, and support teams with architecture decisions.
Explain design options, dependencies, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and senior non-technical stakeholders.

At least five years of experience working in a Data Architect position or a closely related architecture role.
Strong practical knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform, with experience in Real-Time CDP and, ideally, other products within the Adobe ecosystem.
Demonstrated experience in enterprise data architecture, customer data solution design, or solution architecture.
Strong knowledge of:
Event-based and event-driven data structures
Customer and profile data modelling techniques
APIs, JSON, and data transformation principles
Identity resolution and unified customer profile concepts
Batch, streaming, and real-time integration patterns
Experience working with at least one major cloud data environment, such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform.
A sound understanding of GDPR, data governance, consent, and privacy-by-design principles as they apply to customer data platforms.

Please apply for immediate consideration.

Contract

Rate

Storm ID is an award-winning Edinburgh-based digital transformation consultancy that helps organisations accelerate their use of digital, data and AI. We believe in tailored solutions, assembling expert teams to address each client's unique needs. Our services span strategy, design, technology and data & AI, ensuring seamless end-to-end delivery of platforms, products and services with real-world impact.

Role Overview

Storm ID has delivered the Alpha phase of a prominent Scottish Government digital transformation programme. The work is focused on shaping and validating an end-to-end service model, including service mapping, early-stage integration activity and the development of an initial working capability within a secure test environment. 

The programme includes multiple related delivery streams being delivered by a mixed supplier and Scottish Government team. These streams cover user-facing digital journeys, supporting content and information architecture, and the underpinning service model and technical approach required to enable future phases. 

That architecture is documented in both a PoC High Level Design and Full-Service High-Level Design, supported by Architecture Decision Records.
The next phase requires: 
one or more iterations of the Full Service HLD based on a re-evaluation of technical and integration constraints. 
a body of options papers and ADRs that show the reasoning, alternatives and trade-offs behind each decision before the decision is written up. 
integration strategies for each justice partner that are specific to that partner's systems, appetite and supplier landscape. 
low level design of sufficient depth to assure, cost, plan and build a Beta. 

Essential skills and experience 

Substantial experience as a technical architect on complex, integration-heavy digital services, with a track record of designs that were successfully delivered. 
Demonstrable ownership of HLD and LLD artefacts through multiple iterations and formal architectural assurance, in a governed public sector or comparably regulated environment. 
Deep, practical systems integration expertise: event-driven and message-based architecture, service buses, asynchronous patterns, idempotency, replay, dead-lettering, eventual consistency, change data capture and reconciliation. 
Strong API design and integration with legacy and third-party systems that you do not control and cannot change. 
Data architecture: modelling, entity correlation and matching across systems without shared identifiers, data quality, migration and seeding, retention and deletion. 
Cloud architecture on Azure — networking, identity, data services, messaging, secrets, IaC and CI/CD; ability to size and cost a workload. 
Security and privacy by design: authentication and identity (OIDC/OAuth2, federated identity), threat modelling, data protection and information governance for sensitive personal data. 
Written argument. Options papers, ADRs and design documents that a sceptical technical reviewer can follow and act on.  
Stakeholder credibility. Able to hold a design position under sustained challenge from an assurance function, concede accurately when the challenge is right, and negotiate with partner organisations whose interests are not aligned with the programme's. 

Desirable skills and experience 

Experience in the justice, policing or public safety sector
Familiarity with Scottish Government common components; ScotAccount, Digital Mailbox, SG Cloud Platform, Scottish Government Design System and the Digital Scotland Service Standard. 
Experience designing services for vulnerable users
Experience with viewpoint-based architecture description (Rozanski & Woods or similar) and with C4 or equivalent modelling. 
Multi-organisation programme experience where architectural progress depends on organisational agreement.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
At Longshot Systems we build advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the team that owns and develops our trading platform. Longshot is a small, focused company and so the role suits someone who can architect and implement whatever is needed to meet our next product, performance or stability goal. The team owns the technical standards and coding guidelines, CI/CD, observability and security. This role suits someone who wants to ship features and contribute to the wider technical excellence in the team and platform.

The trading platform at Longshot handles integrations with many bookmakers and exchanges worldwide. It normalises and combines the global odds data for many sports and makes it available internally for strategies to trade on. We handle thousands of odds updates and trades per second and have very strict bounds on latency, correctness and overall quality of the feed and trading. You would be at the heart of this team: integrating more trading venues, optimising key parts of the platform, making trading safer and faster, etc. We also maintain a significant historical data repository and support wider trading and research efforts around the company.

Our key platform systems are all in Golang, with message buses and databases at the core of the architecture. You don't need to be fluent in Golang, but it would help. It's easy to learn and we have a team full of experts able to teach you.

We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and flexible the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals.

Interview Process

Intro call (30 mins) - your background + interests
1st Technical interview (30 mins) - live code review & pair programming
2nd Technical interview (60 mins) - deep dive technical questions
Full assessment day (10:30-5pm) - a one day systems programming exercise designed to be similar to the real work we do in the team. Meet some of the team, see the office, have a nice lunch (on us)

Requirements

Bachelors or Masters in a quantitative or technical subject (e.g. Maths, EE, Physics, Comp Sci) from a top university
2+ years experience building mission critical distributed systems (finance, gaming, telco, ad-tech, etc.) where throughput, correctness and availability are a hard requirement
Proven track record delivering and maintaining production systems in at least one systems language (Go, C++, Rust, Java, C#, etc.), with clear, idiomatic designs
Startup experience: shipping products in small, fast moving teams
Architecture & design: Able to reason about trade offs and produce clean, evolvable service boundaries
Cloud & DevOps: comfortable working in AWS, linux and wrangling build pipelines. We have dedicated DevOps people, but you do need to be competent in the core skills here
Fluent written and spoken English. Communicating with the team is as important as the technical work. You need to be able to effectively collaborate on everything from low level details to long term strategic planning

Nice to have

Trading, market making or exchange experience

Benefits

Participation in the uncapped company bonus scheme
10% matched pension contributions
Private healthcare insurance
Long term illness insurance
Gym membership

Ten is on a mission to become the most trusted service business in the world. Technology-driven Product is at the centre of our strategy to create a hugely successful service and business.  Millions of members already have access to Ten's services across lifestyle, travel, dining and entertainment on behalf of over 50 clients including HSBC, Swisscard, Visa, Mastercard and American Express. We have the advantages of already being at scale globally with a critical mass of high-net-worth members via stable, multi-year revenue-generating contracts.  We already have a market leading consumer proposition and credibility (and many integrations) with the leading suppliers/partners across our ‘big 4' service categories of restaurants/travel/entertainment and luxury retail.    
We are debt-free, profitable and the first B Corp listed on the London Stock Exchange (AIM market).  
Our plans are to continue to invest into technology (including AI) to become the main way that our members organise their leisure lives. The next few years will see Ten speed up our progress via our Growth Engine strategy  making the next huge steps to achieve our ambitions together.  
For more information about Ten, please check out our Welcome to Ten video and this article.
🌟 Join Our Team as an AI Engineer! 🌟

Ten is currently building a bigger team of AI engineers in London, and as part of those efforts, we're currently looking for an AI Engineer
who will play a critical role in designing, building, deploying, and monitoring AI systems that scale across the business and to our millions of members globally.
Your role will involve working in a cross-functional team, collaborating with product, data and platform teams to produce high quality working software released to a frequent cadence. The team adopts a ‘you build it, you run it' and DevOps mindset and likes to be hands-on in all aspects of development. You will be responsible for ensuring the software meets quality through rigorous automated testing and metrics. You will also be responsible for assessing and choosing the right solution for the task at hand whilst considering cost implications and timelines. 
If you have a curiosity and passion for AI, whilst a firm grounding in software engineering principles enabling you to build industry leading products, we'd love to hear from you!

Requirements

Proficiency in at least one programming language. I.e Python, C#, JavaScript, Kotlin, Java, Go.. 

Experience with Gen AI tools (e.g LangGraph, CrewAI, Hugging Face, OpenAI APIs etc)

Experience in building and optimising systems for performance, scalability, and reliability 

Understanding of ML fundamentals (training, evaluation, deployment) and LLM-specific challenges (prompt engineering, latency, cost optimisation, hallucinations, evaluation) 

Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform etc). 

Hands-on with DevOps/Infra tooling (CI/CD, Docker, K8s) and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog etc) 

Experience building distributed systems

Knowledge and hands-on experience with multiple datastores (both SQL and NoSQL)

Software Engineer .NET

You will work primarily in C# and .NET Core building backend services and APIs, write and tune SQL against SQL Server, and deploy and operate workloads on AWS. You will also contribute to our front end, built with modern JavaScript frameworks such as React or Angular, and to AI-enabled features built on Generative AI and Large Language Models.

The ideal candidate has already delivered production code, is comfortable owning a well-scoped feature with light oversight, debugs problems methodically, and is curious about applying emerging AI capabilities to real products.

In This Role You Will...

Design, develop, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs in C# / .NET Core, deployed on AWS.
Write, review, and optimize SQL — queries, stored procedures, views, and schema changes — and diagnose performance issues through execution plans and indexing.
Build and deploy cloud-native components on AWS using services such as Lambda, ECS/Fargate, API Gateway, S3, RDS, and CloudWatch.
Develop front-end features using React, Angular, or a comparable modern framework, and integrate them with backend APIs.
Own delivery of assigned features end to end: technical design input, implementation, unit and integration tests, code review, and deployment through CI/CD.
Monitor, debug, and improve application performance, security, and reliability, including participation in production support and incident triage.
Investigate functional and technical issues, drive root cause analysis, and implement durable fixes rather than symptom patches.
Participate actively in agile ceremonies, contribute to estimation and technical design reviews, and give constructive feedback in peer code reviews.
Develop and integrate AI-powered features using services such as AWS Bedrock and modern LLM frameworks.
Collaborate across QA, product, operations, IT security, and release management, and communicate status and risks proactively.

You Have Got What It Takes If You Have...

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

1–2 years of professional software development experience building applications in C# and .NET (.NET Core / .NET 6+ or .NET Framework).
Demonstrated experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
Strong SQL skills against a relational database such as SQL Server: data modeling, joins, stored procedures, indexing, and query optimization.
Hands-on experience deploying or operating workloads on AWS, with working knowledge of at least three commonly used services.
Solid grasp of object-oriented design, SOLID principles, and common design patterns, with the judgment to know when to apply them.
Working experience with a modern front-end framework such as React or Angular, along with strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals.
Experience with Git-based workflows, branching strategies, and pull request review.
Experience writing automated unit tests with xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest.
Understanding of secure coding practices and awareness of common vulnerability classes such as those in the OWASP Top 10.
Foundational knowledge of AI, Generative AI, and LLMs, including prompt engineering and practical applications in software development.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and clear written and verbal communication.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Entity Framework Core, Dapper, or another ORM, and proficiency with LINQ.
Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda, S3, ECS/Fargate, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, IAM, or infrastructure-as-code (CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform).
Experience building or maintaining microservices and containerized applications with Docker.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, or Jenkins.

Working knowledge of Python, particularly for AI or data-related tasks.
Experience in an Agile or Scrum environment with regular production releases.
Interest in user experience, accessibility, and responsive web design.
AWS certification (Developer Associate or Solutions Architect Associate) or a relevant Microsoft certification.

new_jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with OAuth
new_jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why.

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.
Take ownership of technical designs and implementation approaches for assigned capabilities, identifying dependencies, risks and trade-offs and following work through to a production-ready outcome.
Lead focused technical work packages and provide practical guidance to other engineers contributing to the same capability.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.
Promote engineering best practices including Clean Code, automated testing and secure software development.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers and Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
Support less experienced engineers through constructive reviews, knowledge sharing and technical mentoring.

Operations & Collaboration

Participate in third-line production support and on-call rotation.
Investigate production issues and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
Work closely with multiple product teams integrating with the platform.
Share knowledge and contribute to establishing long-term Endava ownership of the Authentication & Authorization capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

6+ years of commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET.
Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications or shared platform services.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or OpenTofu.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience developing Angular applications using TypeScript.
Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration and API testing).
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple product teams.
Ability to influence technical outcomes across team boundaries, communicate delivery risks and contribute to decisions affecting shared platform consumers.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Auth0
Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA)
Google Zanzibar authorization model
Azure API Management (APIM)
SCIM integrations
Identity Federation Datadog
Playwright
Trivy
GitLeaks
Invicti
Experience building reusable developer platforms
Experience working with enterprise shared services

Our benefits offering typically include private medical insurance, dental plan, and glasses reimbursement. The figure represents the initial remuneration we expect to offer for this role and does not limit the right to equal pay for women and men performing the same work or work of equal value. All remuneration and benefits decisions are based on non-discriminatory, gender-neutral criteria, and in accordance with the Polish Labour Code amendments implementing Directive on pay transparency, we do not request or consider candidates’ current or past remuneration during the recruitment process.”

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Desktop
new_jobs.description:
What is Box?

Box (NYSE: BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together — and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

Why Box needs you:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Desktop Applications team at Box, you'll be at the heart of building and evolving the products that millions of users rely on every day - Box Drive, Box Tools, and Box for Office on both Windows and macOS. You'll work across the full depth of the desktop stack, from virtual file systems and OS integrations to sync, networking, and UI, helping shape how enterprise content comes to life on the desktop. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA engineers, and designers to deliver features that are fast, reliable, and secure - and you'll bring a growth mindset and a passion for leveraging AI tools to accelerate your impact.

What you'll do:

Design, develop, and ship high-quality features for Box's desktop applications (Box Drive, Box Tools, Box for Office) on Windows and macOS, ensuring they are performant, user-friendly, and secure
Work across the full desktop stack — including virtual file systems, data persistence, OS integrations, network and sync layers, and UI — to solve complex technical challenges at scale
Contribute to cross-platform development using React Native, bridging front-end and native desktop experiences
Collaborate daily with Product Managers, QA engineers, and designers to translate requirements into robust, well-tested software
Lead and participate in design discussions, architecture reviews, and code reviews to uphold engineering quality and share knowledge across the team
Diagnose and resolve complex performance, reliability, and compatibility issues affecting millions of end users
Attend and engage in weekly stand-ups, team meetings, and manager 1:1s
Work collaboratively with other engineers, team members, and across teams
Play a role in developing and fostering Box culture in the Warsaw office and represent Box Poland internally and externally
Participate in our on-call rotation, available at all times while on-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise

Who you are:

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

5+ years of professional desktop software development experience
Proficient in C++, C#, and/or Swift, with a strong command of software design and architecture principles
Demonstrated experience building and shipping desktop applications on Windows and/or macOS
Comfortable working across the full desktop stack: virtual file systems, OS integrations, networking, sync, and UI
Experienced with unit testing and functional testing practices in an agile team environment
Passionate about building software that is user-friendly, performant, and secure
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
Able to assess, communicate, and complete project milestones with your manager and team members in a time-sensitive manner
Must speak English proficiently

Preferred Skills:

Experience with Windows systems-level programming (Win32 APIs, multi-threading, IPC, COM)
Cross-platform development experience across both macOS and Windows
Prior experience using AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of your daily workflow

Percentage of Time Spent:

15% design and architecture
60% coding, code reviews, and testing
15% bug fixes
5% documentation
5% meetings

Methodology:

Agile management — Scrum
Issue tracking — Jira
Knowledge repository — Box / Confluence / GitHub Enterprise
Code reviews — GitHub Enterprise
Version control — GIT
CI/CD — Jenkins
Communication — Slack / Zoom

Benefits

Check out the overview of Life at Box which include general perks and benefits.

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. About the job:

Are you excited about leading high-scale platform engineering in the core fintech sector? We are searching for a dynamic Engineering Manager who leads the platform engineering team responsible for JVM and .NET platform health, DevOps tooling, CI/CD, observability, and deployment infrastructure across all FinTech products.

You will be accountable for platform reliability, cost efficiency, developer velocity, and AI readiness across the FinTech engineering organization. For this position, the candidate must be an engineer specializing in either .NET or Java.

Important things for you:

Flexible working hours
in the hybrid model (4/1) — working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
Depending on your annual assessment and the company's results we offer:
Annual bonus
based on your annual performance and company results.
Long term discretionary incentive plan
based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).
Our team is based in Warsaw
.

Your responsibilities:

Leads and manages a cross-functional platform engineering team.
Drives platform adoption and removes technical and operational blockers across product teams.
Oversees infrastructure provisioning, cloud resource management, and container orchestration on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Coordinates fleet-scale migrations, including JVM and .NET platform development, Java, .NET, and Spring Boot upgrades.
Optimizes CI/CD pipelines, GitOps deployment safety (canary releases, configuration versioning), and infrastructure cost efficiency.
Integrates AI tools into platform engineering workflows to accelerate developer velocity company-wide.
Manages capacity, sequencing, and cloud budgeting (Azure).
Runs team ceremonies, conducts 1:1 sessions, provides performance feedback, and leads talent acquisition.

Main challenges in this role:

High cloud logging and observability costs requiring validation and deployment of alternative logging backends like VictoriaLogs.
Scaling pipeline throughput and deployment safety to match the accelerated development speed driven by AI tools.
Modernizing JVM and .NET platform and tracking library adoption across products.
Balancing tight roadmap deadlines with team capacity and high operational interrupt volumes.

This is the right job for you if:

You are a strong leader with competencies in People Management, Talent Development, Strategic Thinking, Problem-Solving & Decision-Making, and Stakeholder Management.
You have crucial job-specific skills including Back-End Programming, Business Continuity and Resilience Planning, Software Architecture, DevOps and CI/CD, Agile Methodologies, and Scalability and Resilience.
You possess knowledge in Cloud Infrastructure Management (Microsoft Azure), Container Orchestration (AKS, Istio Service Mesh), Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi), and JVM and .NET Platform Management.
You exhibit general competencies such as Communication, Change Agility, Risk Savvy, Change Management, Continuous Improvement & Innovation, Resilience and Adaptability, AI Literacy, and Analytical Thinking.
You are fluent in Polish (C1) and have a strong command of English (B2).

What's in it for you:

Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.
A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.

#goodtobehere means that:

You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.
You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.

new_jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Onsite Messaging
new_jobs.description:
We’re excited to welcome our first Staff Software Engineer to the newly forming Onsite Messaging team at Voyado.

Onsite Messaging (OSM) is one of Voyado’s most important customer engagement channels. Instead of communicating through email or SMS, OSM enables retailers to engage customers directly on their websites with personalized experiences based on real-time behavior. Every interaction can be measured, understood and optimized, making OSM a key part of creating seamless customer journeys.

We’re now bringing OSM onto Voyado’s Engage platform, and this role will play a central part in making that happen. You’ll join at the beginning of that journey, helping shape both the technical direction and the engineering practices while building a brand-new team in Stockholm together with colleagues in India.

About The Role

This is a Staff Engineer role for someone who enjoys leading through technology.

You'll act as the technical driver for Onsite Messaging. The frontend is moving into Voyado's Engage platform, while the backend continues to run and evolve on AWS — so you'll own both sides of that seam and make sure it holds together well. The transition is one chapter, not the job description. Although the role comes with significant technical ownership, it remains deeply hands-on. You’ll write code, review code, challenge architectural decisions and help the team make sound engineering choices every day.

Initially, much of the focus will be understanding the existing solution, reviewing code and working closely with our engineering team in India as knowledge and ownership gradually move to Stockholm. As the transition progresses, your focus will shift towards driving the technical roadmap, enabling new product development and shaping the future Onsite platform.

Onsite Messaging also sits on a shared JavaScript foundation that several Voyado products load on retailer sites. Getting that foundation into good shape — as a platform other teams can build on — is part of this role.

Who you are

We're looking for someone operating at around 8-10 years of engineering experience, who has been the person other engineers turn to on hard system design questions.

You don’t need experience from our exact technology stack, but we believe you’ve worked with several of the following:

Modern backend development in C#, .NET (out tech stack), or Comfortable moving between languages; Java, Kotlin, Go or similar
JavaScript and TypeScript, with experience working across both frontend and backend when needed
AWS, and serverless architecture in particular — our backend runs on that. Experience with Azure or GCP equivalents is fine if you're happy to work in AWS
Distributed systems, scalable web applications and high-traffic products
System design, software architecture and large technical migrations
CI/CD, observability, automated testing and engineering best practices

We also think you:

have successfully led complex technical initiatives or migration projects
enjoy reviewing code and helping other engineers grow
communicate confidently across teams, cultures and technical disciplines
thrive in environments where not everything has been defined yet
enjoy collaborating with distributed engineering teams
use AI coding tools as a natural part of software development and know how to review and quality-assure AI-generated code

High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.

You’ll join a company with strong momentum, modern technology, and a collaborative culture where ideas and initiatives are encouraged.

At Voyado, we care about creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and enjoy the journey together. We move quickly, challenge ideas, and work closely across teams to deliver meaningful impact.

Some of our benefits:

30 days of vacation
Wellness allowance
Personal development opportunities
Summits and team activities
Four days from the office and one day from home

About Voyado

Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.

More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail-trained AI that acts on real-time shopper intent.

By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.

We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.

Ready to make an impact?

Fantastic! 🎉

Applying is easy — submit your LinkedIn profile or upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.

Additional information

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.

Making it personal with AI

We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.

There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.

In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.

As the Agentic CX Suite for Retail we help retailers achieve a unified customer view through AI-powered CRM, loyalty management, product discovery, and advertising to increase customer lifetime value.

new_jobs.title: CLOUD & INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER TILL AKADEMISKA HUS
new_jobs.description:
Har du byggt och vidareutvecklat Azureplattformar i komplexa hybridmiljöer och vill fortsätta arbeta nära tekniken? Hos Akademiska Hus får du en tekniskt ledande och hands-on roll med stort inflytande över hur vår framtida infrastruktur ska standardiseras, automatiseras och säkras. Här bidrar du både till långsiktiga tekniska vägval och till att lösningarna faktiskt implementeras och fungerar.

DU KOMMER ATT

Akademiska Hus har gjort en omfattande förflyttning från traditionell on-prem-infrastruktur till Microsoft Azure. Samtidigt finns en stor, verksamhetskritisk systemmiljö kvar on-prem. Resultatet är en komplex hybridinfrastruktur där molntjänster och traditionell IT behöver fungera tillsammans – säkert, stabilt och effektivt.

Nu går vi in i nästa fas. Det innebär ökad automatisering och repeterbarhet, tydligare standarder och plattformsmönster, förbättrad governance och säkerhetsstyrning samt en mer enhetlig hybrid- och Azureplattform med mindre beroende av manuella arbetssätt.

Som Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer får du en central roll i denna utveckling. Det är en tekniskt ledande engineer-roll där tyngdpunkten ligger på eget genomförande. Du designar, implementerar och felsöker lösningar samtidigt som du samlar teamet kring tekniska frågor, skapar framdrift och stöttar kollegor genom kunskapsdelning och vägledning.

Teamet består av tolv personer i Göteborg och Stockholm, däribland fyra IT-teknikspecialister och tre nätverkstekniker. Tillsammans finns bred kompetens inom bland annat Azure, IAM, serverhallar och virtualisering, VDI, övervakning, brandväggar, SOC, VPN och nätverk. Du arbetar även nära arkitekter och har mandat att påverka tekniska lösningar, arbetssätt och plattformens fortsatta utveckling.

Du kommer bland annat att:

Designa, implementera och vidareutveckla lösningar i Azure och den hybrida infrastrukturen.
Arbeta hands-on med bland annat Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity och Security.
Utveckla automation och Infrastructure as Code för repeterbara och standardiserade leveranser.
Arbeta med Active Directory, Entra ID och Conditional Access i en komplex hybridmiljö.
Felsöka avancerade tekniska problem och driva lösningar från analys till genomförande.
Bidra till plattformsmönster, tekniska standarder, arkitektur och långsiktiga vägval.
Arbeta med governance, loggning, säkerhetsstyrning och kostnadsoptimering.
Ta ett tekniskt ledarskap och bidra till teamets gemensamma kompetens och utveckling.

DIN PROFIL

Vi söker dig med gedigen erfarenhet av IT-infrastruktur och av förflyttningen från traditionell on-prem till Azure och hybrid cloud. new_jobs.description:
We are strengthening our architecture capabilities and are looking for a System Architect for Core & Credits. In this role, you will help shape the technical direction of our credit solutions while working closely with Team Credit and fellow architects across the organization. You will combine hands-on development with architectural responsibility, contributing both to day-to-day delivery and to the long-term evolution of our products.

Personal Skills

We are looking for a proactive and self-driven person with strong analytical skills, integrity, and the ability to see the bigger picture. You communicate clearly, collaborate well with others, and combine a business-oriented mindset with solid technical understanding.

Main Responsibilities

As System Architect, you will take part in both hands-on development and architectural work. You will support the team by clarifying requirements, designing technical solutions, guiding implementation, and helping ensure that our systems remain secure, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with the product roadmap.

Define And Analyze System Requirements

– Define and analyze functional and non-functional system requirements in close collaboration with system users, product owners, and other stakeholders.

– Translate requirements into clear guidance for developers and application managers through models, prototypes, guidelines, and instructions.

Develop Technical Roadmap

– Develop, maintain, and communicate the technical roadmap for your area of responsibility.

– Actively reduce existing technical debt and help prevent new technical debt from being introduced.

– Drive system changes in line with the roadmap and help ensure that development progresses in a coordinated and sustainable way.

Evaluate Cost and Time

– Assess cost, time, and value when evaluating manual routines, hardware, third-party products, existing software, or new development.

Architectural Design and System Decomposition

– Design and evolve the fundamental system structure that supports ongoing product development.

– Support developers and application managers in resolving issues in a way that is consistent with the architectural direction.

– Make technical decisions within your area of responsibility, in alignment with the roadmap and relevant stakeholders.

– Align with your immediate manager before decisions that may involve additional costs. Decisions of a significant nature are made by the company's Chief Architect or Management team.

– Guide teams in evaluating both human-created and AI-assisted design or code suggestions, ensuring that solutions are sound, secure, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with the overall architecture.

Customer and Sales Engagement

– Support new sales and upselling activities for both new and existing customers.

– Help answer solution-related questions and contribute technical insight in customer dialogue.

Desired Education And Experience

– University-level education in software development, or equivalent practical experience.

– Extensive experience and strong expertise in software design and development.

– Must have experience: working in an IBM i environment and with RPGLE as a programming language.

– Merited experience: Working with a Java technology stack and frameworks such as Spring Boot and Spring for building production-ready environments and REST APIs.

– Merited experience: AWS or other cloud public clouds.

Business domain knowledge within credits is merited.
Proficiency in agile software development.
Proficiency in data security.
Fluency in English is required. Swedish is desirable, and Finnish is considered a bonus.
You have a pragmatic AI-first mindset and are positive about using AI as support for productivity and analysis, while applying professional judgment and taking ownership of the final result.

Could this be your next step? If you are motivated by combining hands-on development with architectural responsibility, we would be happy to hear from you.

The role can be based in either Mariehamn, Helsinki, Turku, Stockholm

For further information, please contact Technical Development Manager Sebastian Skogman by email at sebastian.skogman@crosskey.fi or HR Manager Monika Sigmark by email at monika.sigmark@crosskey.fi We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please send your application as soon as possible, but no later than 30 September 2026.
