new_jobs.description:
Are you passionate about the infrastructure of scalable, secure, and future-proof data platforms that power analytics, AI, and business-critical insights? Do you thrive in environments where automation, cloud technologies, and platform reliability are at the core of everything you do? We're looking for a Data Platform Engineer who wants to play a pivotal role in shaping and operating a modern Azure and Databricks-based data platform that enables data-driven decision-making, advanced analytics, and AI innovation at scale.

About The Role

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure that supports analytics, reporting, AI, and data product development. You will help establish platform standards, develop automation capabilities, and ensure the platform remains secure, scalable, and resilient. Working closely with Data Architects, Data Engineers, Enterprise Architects, and Security teams, you will drive the evolution of a modern cloud-based platform that enables seamless data ingestion, processing, and consumption across the organization.

As a key member of the team, you will manage and optimize Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake, networking, and supporting platform services. You will implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, and create observability frameworks that provide transparency into platform health, performance, and cost efficiency. You will also play an important role in troubleshooting complex issues, improving operational excellence, supporting disaster recovery planning, and enabling AI and machine learning capabilities through robust platform engineering practices.

Beyond the technical responsibilities, you will act as a trusted subject matter expert, helping engineering teams adopt cloud platform best practices while continuously driving improvements in reliability, security, governance, and operational efficiency.

We're looking for someone who combines a strong engineering foundation with hands-on experience building and operating the infrastructure of enterprise-scale cloud platforms.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or similar roles.
Proven experience designing, implementing, and operating secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure in Azure.
Experience supporting modern data platforms, analytics, AI, and machine learning workloads.

Key Technical Skills

We're looking for someone with strong expertise across several of the following areas:

Azure cloud and data platforms, including Azure Databricks Administration, Azure Data Lake, data integration services, and analytics workloads.
Infrastructure as Code and platform automation, including Terraform, Git, CI/CD, automated provisioning, and configuration management.
Containerized and cloud-native environments, including Kubernetes and Docker.
Cloud networking and identity management, including Azure Networking, Entra ID/IAM, DNS, connectivity, private networking, routing, and firewalls.
Security, compliance, and governance, including implementation of security controls and governance frameworks within regulated environments.
Observability and platform operations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, high availability, platform reliability, and cost optimization (FinOps).
Scripting and automation, using Python, PowerShell, or Bash.

Nice to have

Experience with any of the following would be considered an advantage:

Microsoft Purview and Apache Airflow.
MLOps and Azure AI Services.
Multi-cloud environments.
Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, or Databricks Platform Administrator certifications.
Experience from the logistics industry.

Language Requirements

Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Swedish, Danish, Finnish, or Norwegian is considered an advantage

Who you are

You are a curious and proactive engineer who enjoys solving complex challenges and building reliable platforms that create value at scale. With a strong analytical mindset and a passion for troubleshooting, you thrive in environments where continuous improvement, automation, and operational excellence are key. You take a structured approach to problem-solving, have a natural sense of ownership, and are committed to delivering high-quality solutions. At the same time, you're a collaborative team player who builds strong relationships across Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Business teams, enabling effective stakeholder engagement and driving results through cross-functional collaboration.

We appreciate your patience and understanding. If you have any questions or concerns, please email recruiting manager Linda Njeru at linda.njeru@postnord.com.

At Erinion, part of the Scania Group, we are leading the global shift towards a more sustainable transport system by shaping the future within charging and e-mobility.

Our business

We offer private and semi-public charging solutions to build, own and operate infrastructure at customer sites to enhance their operational efficiency, minimize cost and increase flexibility. We're looking for an experienced engineer who combines strong backend expertise with architectural thinking. AI-assisted development tools are part of our daily workflow, but we value engineers who can independently drive technical decisions and build robust, scalable systems.

and the flexibility to contribute across the stack when needed.

Build and enhance backend services using Python and Node.js/TypeScript.
Design scalable APIs, integrations, and event-driven architectures.
Develop solutions for smart charging, energy management, and fleet platforms.
Integrate Erinion Connect with TMS, FMS, ERP, and telematics systems.

Experience designing and building cloud-native applications on AWS.

Join our passionate team in Stockholm city, at Drottninggatan 29, and be a driving force in the future of sustainable transportation. new_jobs.title: AI Software Developer i Stockholm
new_jobs.description:
Vi tror på- och vill förverkliga en AI- och datadriven framtid. Vi söker AI Software Developers som vill vara med och hjälpa våra kunder inom olika branscher att omvandla AI-experiment till skalbara, säkra och värdeskapande lösningar.

Hos oss blir du del av ett växande område med runt 20 konsulter inom Cloud, AI och systemutveckling. Samtidigt får du kollegor från hela Solita med expertis i allt från data, strategi och mycket mer att dela kunskap och perspektiv med, läs mer om det här.

När vi växer gör dina möjligheter också det, du får vara med och påverka kulturen, affären och din roll.

En dag på Solita

En dag på Solita kan börja med ett standup-möte med ditt team på kunduppdraget, ibland består det av fler kollegor från Solita. Är det fredag kanske du jobbar från Solitas kontor i Stockholm för att starta dagen med frukost. Andra dagar jobbar du från kundens kontor eller hemifrån.

Sen kliver du in i ditt arbete: när du stöter på ett problem söker du upp en lång diskussionstråd i slack med insikter från kollegor som haft samma problem. Andra gånger passar du på att fråga en kollega vid kaffemaskinen om deras perspektiv för att komma vidare. Du kan också delta i våra interna utbildningsmöten, där vi delar kunskap om allt från nya teknologier och arbetssätt till välmående. Vissa dagar avslutar du med AW, filmkväll, brädspel eller annan aktivitet du och kollegor tycker är kul.

Din roll som AI Software Developer

Du är med i hela utvecklingscykeln, inte sällan från tidigt pre-sales stadie eller i förstudier, för att utveckla, driftsätta och optimera agent-baserade och datadrivna system som hjälper kunder fatta bättre beslut eller automatisera processer på ett intelligent sätt. Exempelvis kan du arbeta med prompt optimering, designa och implementera RAG-arkitektur, utveckla AI-agenter, MCP-servrar, APIer och backend lösningar för att integrera befintliga system till LLM-tjänster. Läs mer om att jobba med AI på Solita här.

Utöver moderna systemutveckling-tekniker kommer du arbeta med diverse AI-verktyg och ramverk som exempelvis LangChain, Tensorflow, AI Foundry och Semantic Kernel för att nämna några. Då vi jobbar teknikagnostiskt får du stor frihet att forma teknikval och arkitektur för att möta affärsbehov. Läs mer om hur kollegor jobbar och diskuterar kring olika teknikval i vår Dev blog här.

Känner du igen dig i följande?

Du kan kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är ett plus om du varit konsult tidigare men det huvudsakliga är din förmåga att snabbt komma in i nya sammanhang och lära dig. Du är trygg i rollen tack vare din erfarenhet av både systemutveckling (särskilt om du jobbat i C# .NET eller Java Spring Boot) samt:

RAG- eller AI-agentarkitektur
Att bygga AI-drivna applikationer med moderna ramverk som ex. Semantic Kernel, LangChain eller liknande.
Att implementera molnbaserade AI-tjänster och produktionssätta AI-lösningar med hjälp av DevSecOps och IaC.

Vi letar inte bara efter tekniska skills, vi vill jobba med dig som tar ansvar för att bygga rätt lösningar på rätt sätt genom att utmana med omtanke. Du ser kod som ett hantverk, inte bara ett medel till funktion: du bryr dig om kvalitet, läsbarhet och hållbarhet. Du kommer trivas hos oss om du tycker om att dela med dig av din kunskap lika mycket som du är nyfiken på- och lyfter andras. .

Vad vi erbjuder

Overview

Make Microsoft Advertising part of your career story. Microsoft Advertising supports advertisers and partners across search, audience, retail media, commerce, and emerging AI-powered experiences, helping businesses connect with customers across the Microsoft ecosystem. Global Support is a critical partner to customers, sales, product, and engineering teams, ensuring advertisers can adopt, operate, and optimise Microsoft Advertising solutions with confidence. As a Service Engineer, you will provide advanced technical support for complex platform and customer issues, using telemetry, diagnostics, data analysis, automation, and AI-assisted tools to investigate root cause, restore service health, and improve the customer experience. You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to turn customer signals into product improvements, scalable troubleshooting guidance, proactive monitoring, and readiness for new features. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical curiosity, solid judgement, customer empathy, and a bias for continuous improvement in a fast-moving digital advertising environment.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities

Investigate and resolve complex Microsoft Advertising product, escalation, policy, fraud, and service health issues using telemetry, logs, customer signals, ticket trends, and platform diagnostics to isolate root cause and validate resolution quality.
Apply an automation-first mindset to identify repeatable manual work, recurring issue patterns, and high-volume support scenarios that can be simplified, standardized, scripted, or automated. Design, improve, and maintain automation, dashboards, proactive checks, alerting signals, diagnostic workflows, and AI-assisted support tools that reduce manual troubleshooting, improve consistency, and accelerate issue resolution.
Own complex customer, partner, sales, and support escalations by balancing urgency, quality, business impact, SLA expectations, and technical evidence while keeping stakeholders informed through clear and timely communication. Drive root cause analysis and service improvement in partnership with Product and Engineering, ensuring fixes, mitigations, tooling gaps, automation opportunities, and supportability improvements are prioritized, validated, and landed effectively.
Create and maintain scalable support assets, including diagnostic playbooks, troubleshooting guides, knowledge base articles, escalation templates, and readiness content that enable teams to resolve issues consistently.
Measure and improve support effectiveness through indicators such as reduced manual effort, faster triage, improved MTTR, fewer repeat contacts, fewer unnecessary escalations, more solid SLA stability, and improved customer support quality.
Act as the voice of the customer and support organization by providing actionable feedback to Product, Engineering, Account Management, Support leadership, and Trust and Safety stakeholders on customer experience, supportability gaps, operational risk, and automation opportunities. Participate in operational coverage, including occasional night and weekend on-call support, to maintain service health, timely escalation response, and continuity for critical monitoring or automation workflows.

Location: Hybrid, Dublin

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Principal Engineer to define and own the end to end technical architecture of the Bentley Developer Platform, which includes the front end developer experience, the API gateway, standards, authentication, metering, and billing infrastructure that powers Bentley's portfolio of developer APIs and MCP servers.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will set the architectural direction for the platform, write production code, review pull requests, and act as the senior technical authority the engineering team relies on for difficult decisions. You will also work closely with both the Product team to set the API standards along with engineering teams across the API portfolio to develop and maintain the platform's API design standards, security models, and integration patterns. If you’re an engineer who enjoys both deep technical work and influencing standards across a global organization, this role offers significant scope and impact.

Responsibilities

Define the architecture of the developer platform, including the API gateway, authentication, metering, billing integration, and settlement, ensuring it is sound, extensible, and cloud-native from the outset.
Own the end-to-end platform architecture from the developer experience through to the registry, including all aspects of commercialization, adoption, support, monitoring, and analytics.
Work with the Product team to set API standards that will allow for monitoring, authentication, metering, and registration.
Write production code and review pull requests; remain the senior hands-on technical contributor on the team and unblock engineers on the critical path.
Serve as the primary technical interface between the Developer Platform, Product & Technology and product engineering teams, building credibility as the go-to person for platform questions.
Jointly develop and publish API Design Standards v1, working collaboratively with product teams so that standards reflect the technical reality of what those teams are building and are adopted in practice.
Own platform standards and governance: define the telemetry schema, maintain hub listing requirements, and establish the security and integration patterns applied across all API families.
Establish IMS OAuth as the standard authentication model across all platform surfaces.
Define and document migration paths for existing APIs to meet platform standards.
Ensure AI and MCP surfaces are first-class citizens in the platform architecture and taxonomy, with documented agent integration patterns alongside traditional REST APIs.
Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical hiring, team structure, and delivery sequencing.
Partner with the CIO organization on enterprise application and ERP integration and unified architecture.

Qualifications

12+ years of software engineering experience and significant time spent architecting large-scale systems.
Proven ability to own the comprehensive developer platform architecture spanning from the front-end developer experience down to the API registry encompassing commercialization, adoption, support and analytics.
Demonstrated experience partnering closely with Product teams to define and establish global API standards that enable monitoring, authentication, metering and registration.
Experience managing enterprise IT architectures coupled with a proven track record of building and shipping custom, customer-facing API-driven software.
Strong technical expertise in OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, token handling, and underlying platform security models.
Hands-on experience engineering distributed systems, event streaming, API gateways, routing, usage-based billing pipelines, and ERP/settlement integrations.
Unique blend of hands-on coding ability and the communication skills to work credibly and collaboratively with multiple distinct product engineering teams.
Familiarity with AI/agent integration patterns and MCP is a strong plus.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to align senior stakeholders and engineers across organizational boundaries.

An attractive salary and benefits package.

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

new_jobs.description:
Are you a subject-matter-oriented Solution Architect ready to shape digital transformation in complex environments? Do you enjoy tackling business challenges in an international setting and collaborating closely with customers and fellow experts? Then this role might be just right for you.

Nortal is currently looking for a Solution Architect to join impactful projects with our enterprise customers. In this role, you will collaborate closely with both our customers and internal development teams, focusing on understanding business needs through active stakeholder discussions and shaping them into high-value solution opportunities. You play a key role in engaging with stakeholders, gathering and refining requirements, demonstrating solutions, and proactively identifying how we can best support business goals.

What you will do

Support customers in their digital transformation across areas such as data modelling and architecture, system integrations, platform modernization, and AI-driven solutions.
Engage in regular discussions with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
Translate high-level architectural directions into concrete guidance for development teams.
Own and prioritize the backlog, ensuring alignment between business value and technical feasibility.
Produce documentation, technical diagrams, architectural notes, and decision records.
Work closely with developers to clarify technical implications, even if you don’t write code yourself.
Collaborate closely with Nortal colleagues, including development, project management, and data/architecture experts.

Our tech environment
In this role you don’t need to program hands-on, but a background in software engineering is essential. Technologies in use include Azure (Azure SQL, Functions, Data Lake, Container Apps etc.), MS Fabric, C#, React, and API management.

What will help you to succeed

Ability to understand business needs and ways of working, enabling smooth collaboration.
Solid technical understanding and ability to discuss architectural-level topics such as software and data architectures, integrations, and AI.
A background in software development (hands-on coding experience at some stage).
Ownership mindset and ability to drive initiatives forward.
Consultant-like approach: proactive, solution-oriented, comfortable in the client interface, willingness to ask questions.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English.

If you’re not yet familiar with Nortal, we are a global leader in strategic change and technology. Our 2,500+ employees worldwide share the vision of creating a better future through seamless digital transformation, and we're constantly on the lookout for new talents to join us on this journey. We maintain offices in Helsinki, Oulu, Turku, Jyväskylä, and Uusikaupunki. We highly value flexibility, giving you the option to work from home, your local office, or find a balance that suits your needs.

Why join us?

You’ll play a central role in driving digital transformation for our customers. You’ll gain broad visibility into complex ecosystems—and real ownership of key areas. You’ll work closely with a friendly and experienced team.
We value individuals not just for their skills, but also for their cultural alignment. Our core values include a commitment to delivering value and results, taking ownership, empowering oneself and others, and owning your future and growth. In addition to our professionalism, we appreciate a touch of good humor!
We prioritize your growth and development. At Nortal, we actively support constant improvement and knowledge sharing, both internal and external training opportunities, self-learning, a mentorship program, and strong 1:1 culture.
We prioritize your health and well-being by offering a flexible range of benefits, including adaptable working hours, access to high-quality occupational healthcare, massage services, and bicycle benefit. We are also a remote friendly company.

Salary range: 5200-7800€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

If you’re interested in learning more, please feel free to reach out to me for additional information:
Virpi Kivinen
+358 40 6616 338
virpi.kivinen(at)nortal.com

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, culture or minority group.

We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

What You Can Expect

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Cloud Engineer to support the provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of cloud infrastructure within our Microsoft Azure environment. In this hands-on role, you will work alongside experienced engineers to automate deployments, manage containerized workloads, and contribute to secure, scalable, and efficient cloud operations. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically curious individual eager to build a career in cloud engineering.

How You'll Create Impact

Provision, configure, and maintain Azure cloud resources across development, QA, staging, and production environments.
Implement and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Bicep and ARM templates, following established standards and approval processes.
Monitor cloud environments for performance, availability, cost optimization, and application health using Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure Application Insights.
Assist in analyzing logs, metrics, traces, and alerts to support incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
Participate in day-to-day cloud operations including incident response, change management, access reviews, and cloud resource tagging.
Deploy, operate, and support containerized applications on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with an emphasis on secure-by-default and safety-focused configurations.
Support AKS safety and security features including:
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and least-privilege access
Network policies and private cluster configurations
Pod and container security best practices
Cluster and workload observability using logs, metrics, and alerts
Patch management and Kubernetes version upgrades under guidance

Perform scaling, health monitoring, and basic troubleshooting of Kubernetes workloads using kubectl, Helm, and Azure CLI.
Contribute to CI/CD workflows and deployment automation in collaboration with developers using GitHub Actions, with attention to deployment safety, validation, and rollback strategies.
Create and maintain documentation for cloud infrastructure, deployment processes, observability standards, security controls, and operational procedures.
Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, retrospectives, and internal knowledge-sharing sessions.

Your Background

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and core services such as Virtual Machines, App Services, Storage, Networking, and identity services.
Practical understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals (pods, deployments, services, namespaces) and container orchestration concepts.
Experience using Docker and container deployment tools such as Helm.
Familiarity with application monitoring and observability tools, including Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure Application Insights.
Experience with scripting or automation using PowerShell, Bash, or programming languages such as Python or C#.
Understanding of cloud security fundamentals including RBAC, identity management, network segmentation, and least-privilege principles.
Ability to follow defined processes and controls while progressively taking ownership of assigned systems and tasks.
Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset.

Travel Expectations

Occasional overnight travel as necessary.

This is a full-time position and it may reasonably require additional hours during the week and weekend; specific requirements will be determined with Manager.

new_jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
new_jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Plenty of developers have tried an AI agent. Fewer have run several in parallel, built their own tooling to keep them on track, and worked out exactly where they shine and where they still fall over. If you are on top of these things and want to contribute to the build-up of an agentic software organization, we should talk.

Getinge is looking for Senior .NET Developers in Copenhagen. You will be building software that hospitals around the world depend on every day, and you will be helping shape how a large software organization adopts AI. We have several positions open.

What You Would Be Building

Getinge is a global MedTech company, and our teams in Copenhagen, Hamburg and Aarhus build software that runs at the heart of a modern hospital. Our solutions track surgical instruments through sterile reprocessing with full traceability, orchestrate fleets of robots and reprocessing equipment, plan and optimize the surgical day, coordinate patient flow and staff in real time, and keep thousands of connected medical devices running in the field.

Our software is mission-critical, deeply integrated with hospital IT and physical equipment, and built to a high standard of quality. It is also software where the impact is immediate and real: better use of an operating room, an instrument set that arrives on time, a surgery that goes ahead instead of being cancelled. Not everyone gets to end the week knowing their work helped someone get treated.

What We Work With

Our teams work primarily in C#/.Net &Blazor, with focus on containerization and cloud deployment to Azure, across the organization that spans web and mobile applications, cloud services, real-time systems, and integration with physical equipment.

We are not looking for a checklist match for all of it. What matters is that you are strong in .NET, that you are comfortable working across a stack rather than in one corner of it, and that you pick new things up quickly. The exact mix varies by team, and we will find the right fit together.

Where we are with AI

We are currently in the process of accelerating our software factory with AI. Our teams have been exploring AI-assisted and agentic development processes for some time and are implementing our learnings. However, we are seeking additional fresh perspectives on the matter. This is where you come in.

If you have real experience here and strong opinions about what works, you will find both room to use them and colleagues who will argue back.

Our developers have access to the latest models and a meaningful budget for AI tooling and usage, and we are also looking at introducing new and improved methods and tools to improve our way of working.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and maintain robust .NET services and applications for mission-critical hospital software.
Build and integrate agentic AI capabilities – designing, orchestrating, and evaluating AI agents and LLM-driven workflows in our products and in how we work.
Drive AI adoption in your team and across the organization, setting the standard for how modern tooling improves quality, speed, and value delivered.
Contribute to system architecture, code quality, and engineering practices.
Work closely with product owners, architects, UX/UI, and developers across multiple sites.

You will bring

Strong .NET expertise – deep, hands-on experience building and maintaining production software in C# and modern .NET.
Breadth and adaptability – you are happy to work across the stack and into the cloud, and you are not thrown by a technology you have not used before.
Real depth with AI in practice – you use AI tools in your daily work, you are hands-on with agents and LLM-driven workflows, and you can point to things you have actually built with them. We care more about what you have done and how you think about it than about years on a CV.
A proactive, positive, and constructive mindset – you take ownership from start to finish, communicate openly, and make the people around you better.
The ability to build maintainable, high-quality solutions and to work independently as well as in a team.

Nice to have

Experience with hardware–software integration, robotics, or embedded systems.
Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging, or distributed systems.
Experience working in Agile teams on regulated or safety-critical products.

What We Offer

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that improve healthcare quality and efficiency, with the ambition to be the most desired MedTech company in the world. You would join our Digital Health Solutions department, which counts around 165 people across Denmark, Germany, and the UK, plus a further 100 colleagues in Getinge offices globally.

A smart working environment with shared desks, several work-from-home days per week, and a budget for your home office setup.
Flexible working hours.
Competitive benefits including health insurance and pension.
Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
A collaborative, inclusive, and motivating culture.

Application

Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 17-10-2026

We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

About Us 

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

new_jobs.description:
Start your software development career building real products used by professionals around the world.

Are you about to finish – or have you recently finished – your Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or a related field?

At Dalux, you will join a product team where you can develop your technical skills while taking real responsibility from the the outset. You will work alongside experienced developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers to build software used across the global construction industry.

Your role

As a Full-Stack Software Developer, you will work across our technology stack and take part in developing features end-to-end – from understanding the problem and designing a solution to implementation and delivery.

You will not be expected to know everything when you join.

Instead, we expect you to be curious, willing to learn, and ready to take increasing ownership as your skills develop. You will have experienced colleagues around you for daily technical sparring, code reviews, and support.

Your work will include:

Designing and developing new product functionality
Working across both front-end and back-end technologies
Collaborating with developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers
Writing maintainable, reliable, and high-quality software
Learning our products, architecture, and engineering practices
Taking increasing ownership of features and technical decisions as you develop
Contributing ideas for how we can improve our products and the way we build them

Developing software with AI

AI-assisted development is becoming an increasingly important part of how we build software at Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can help developers understand code, explore solutions, implement and refactor functionality, create tests, debug problems, and automate repetitive work.

You do not need to be an AI expert. But we are looking for developers who are curious about these tools, willing to experiment, and able to think critically about when AI improves a solution – and when it does not.

If you have already experimented with AI-assisted development through your studies, student job, personal projects, or other work, we would be interested to hear what you learned.

Technologies we work with

Our main full-stack technologies include:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
GitHub CoPilot
MSSQL
Elasticsearch
Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You are not expected to know our entire stack when you join. Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn are more important.

Product development at Dalux

Our developers do more than implement specifications.

You will work in a product team together with a Product Manager and Product Designer, combining different perspectives on user value, usability, technical feasibility, and business viability.

This means understanding why we build something, contributing to how we solve the problem, and seeing your work become part of a product used by professionals worldwide.

We work according to agile principles and maintain a strong focus on quality, stability, and long-term maintainability.

Your background

We expect that you:

Have, or are about to complete, a Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or a similar technical field
Have a solid foundation in software development and computer science
Are curious and motivated to learn new technologies
Enjoy solving problems and understanding how things work
Care about building good software, not simply making code compile
Are comfortable asking questions, receiving feedback, and challenging yourself
Want to take ownership and responsibility as your skills grow

Professional experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What matters most is your technical potential, curiosity, interest in software craftsmanship, and willingness to learn.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart, and software development is central to what we do.

You can expect:

Meaningful product responsibility early in your career
Daily sparring with skilled and experienced developers
Short paths between ideas, technical decisions, and implementation
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
Close collaboration with Product Management and Design
The opportunity to learn how AI-assisted development is changing software engineering
A social development environment with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All our software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. We believe working together makes learning, technical collaboration, and knowledge sharing significantly easier – particularly at the beginning of your career.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house at Dalux.

Ready to start your development career?

If you are looking for a place where you can learn quickly, take real responsibility, and build software with visible impact, we would like to hear from you.

Our recruitment process is ongoing and typically consists of:

Application
Screening
First interview
Second interview
Job offer

We hire several Software Developers throughout the year as Dalux continues to grow.

new_jobs.description:
Vi søger en backend-udvikler til Product Engineering, der har lyst til at være med fra bunden – og som samtidig kan bygge løsninger, der holder, når belastningen topper.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor app og backend arbejder som ét hold. Her er der kort fra idé til kode, og du får mandat til at træffe de arkitekturvalg, der skal bære os de næste mange år.

Om jobbet

Som .NET-udvikler sidder du tæt på både app-udviklerne, produktet og forretningen. Du kommer blandt andet til at:

Designe og udvikle skalerbare, sikre og hurtige API’er i C# og moderne .NET
Bygge det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser
Sikre fremdrift i app-teamet med mock-API’er og prototyper, mens den robuste løsning modnes
Bruge moderne AI-kodeværktøjer til at effektivisere boilerplate, test og optimering
Sikre driftssikkerhed og performance i løsninger, der skal klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du genkender dig selv i flere af nedenstående punkter:

Dyb .NET-ekspertise: Du er en stærk håndværker i C# og moderne .NET, og du forstår at bygge skalerbare, sikre og lynhurtige API’er.
Frontend-empati: Du forstår, at dit API er fundamentet for app-oplevelsen. Du tænker over latency og smarte payloads og bygger API’er, der gør livet let og hurtigt for den iOS-udvikler, der skal konsumere dem.
Pragmatisk fremdrift: Du kender vigtigheden af at sikre fremdrift for dine aftagere. Du leverer hurtigt mock-API’er og prototyper, der sikrer fremdrift, mens du bygger den langsigtede og robuste arkitektur under kølerhjelmen.
Agentic AI-kompetence: Du har praktisk erfaring med – eller stor nysgerrighed for – at udnytte agentic workflows, prompt engineering og AI-værktøjer til at accelerere din kode- og udviklingsproces.
Product Engineer-mindset: Du tænker som en Product Engineer. Du koder ikke bare kravspecifikationer, men engagerer dig i brugerrejsen og forretningsværdien.

Om Product Engineering

Product Engineering er produktfokuseret, eksekverende, samarbejdsorienteret, autonom og ambitiøs. Vi bygger for brugeren frem for systemets skyld, vi arbejder som ét team på tværs af app og backend, og vi har mandatet til selv at træffe de rigtige arkitekturvalg. Ambitionen er driftssikre løsninger, der kan håndtere massiv skala.

Hvorfor Danske Spil?

Hos Danske Spil får du en ret unik mulighed: startup-viben ved at være med til at bygge et nyt, stærkt in-house app-udviklingsmiljø op fra bunden – men med skalaen, tyngden og volumen fra en af Danmarks største digitale forretninger.

Som backend-udvikler i Product Engineering bliver du ikke gemt væk i en silo. Du sidder helt tæt på app-udviklerne og forretningen og får direkte indflydelse på det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser. Du arbejder agilt og autonomt med moderne, AI-støttede værktøjer. Det er den perfekte legeplads, hvis du motiveres af at bygge API’er, der både kræver høj fart og innovation i hverdagen, og som samtidig skal kunne klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger uden at blinke.

Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?

Vi læser ansøgninger igennem løbende, men deadline for at søge er den 9. oktober 2026. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Persson på jepe@danskespil.dk. Hvis du har spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner, Mette Overgaard Holm på MEHO@danskespil.dk.

Til glæde og til gavn

Du kender sikkert vores navn og nogle af vores spil. Men ved du også, hvordan Danske Spil er til glæde og til gavn for hele Danmark?

Vi er markedsleder inden for lotteri, sportsspil og casino i Danmark – og det er staten og de store idrætsforeninger, DGI og DIF, der ejer Danske Spil. Med andre ord ejer vi alle sammen Danske Spil.

Og med det ejerskab følger et særligt ansvar. Et ansvar for at finansiere det idræts-, kultur- og foreningsliv, vi er rundet af. Og et ansvar for at modarbejde spilafhængighed og sørge for, at det hele går ordentligt til.

Vores historie begyndte i 1948, da 20.000 idrætsfolk demonstrerede på Rådhuspladsen for en ny lov, som gav sporten del i overskuddet fra væddemål. Året efter blev Danske Spil grundlagt – og siden har vi hvert år sendt hele vores overskud tilbage til fællesskabet. I 2024 betød det hele 1,8 milliarder til idræt, kultur og foreningsliv i Danmark - og 3,28 milliarder i samlet samfundsbidrag.

Hvert år spiller mere end 1,9 millioner danskere hos os – online eller hos en af vores 3.700 forhandlere. Og vi er knap 500 medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder med at balancere konkurrencedygtighed og ansvarlighed. For vi er hele Danmarks spilleselskab – til glæde og til gavn

Job Description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective
Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job Requirements

The Ideal Candidate

Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)
Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems

new_jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Plenty of developers have tried an AI agent. Fewer have run several in parallel, built their own tooling to keep them on track, and worked out exactly where they shine and where they still fall over. If you are on top of these things and want to contribute to the build-up of an agentic software organization, we should talk.

Getinge is looking for Senior .NET Developers in Copenhagen. You will be building software that hospitals around the world depend on every day, and you will be helping shape how a large software organization adopts AI. We have several positions open.

What You Would Be Building

Getinge is a global MedTech company, and our teams in Copenhagen, Hamburg and Aarhus build software that runs at the heart of a modern hospital. Our solutions track surgical instruments through sterile reprocessing with full traceability, orchestrate fleets of robots and reprocessing equipment, plan and optimize the surgical day, coordinate patient flow and staff in real time, and keep thousands of connected medical devices running in the field.

Our software is mission-critical, deeply integrated with hospital IT and physical equipment, and built to a high standard of quality. It is also software where the impact is immediate and real: better use of an operating room, an instrument set that arrives on time, a surgery that goes ahead instead of being cancelled. Not everyone gets to end the week knowing their work helped someone get treated.

What We Work With

Our teams work primarily in C#/.Net &Blazor, with focus on containerization and cloud deployment to Azure, across the organization that spans web and mobile applications, cloud services, real-time systems, and integration with physical equipment.

We are not looking for a checklist match for all of it. What matters is that you are strong in .NET, that you are comfortable working across a stack rather than in one corner of it, and that you pick new things up quickly. The exact mix varies by team, and we will find the right fit together.

Where we are with AI

We are currently in the process of accelerating our software factory with AI. Our teams have been exploring AI-assisted and agentic development processes for some time and are implementing our learnings. However, we are seeking additional fresh perspectives on the matter. This is where you come in.

If you have real experience here and strong opinions about what works, you will find both room to use them and colleagues who will argue back.

Our developers have access to the latest models and a meaningful budget for AI tooling and usage, and we are also looking at introducing new and improved methods and tools to improve our way of working.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and maintain robust .NET services and applications for mission-critical hospital software.
Build and integrate agentic AI capabilities – designing, orchestrating, and evaluating AI agents and LLM-driven workflows in our products and in how we work.
Drive AI adoption in your team and across the organization, setting the standard for how modern tooling improves quality, speed, and value delivered.
Contribute to system architecture, code quality, and engineering practices.
Work closely with product owners, architects, UX/UI, and developers across multiple sites.

You will bring

Strong .NET expertise – deep, hands-on experience building and maintaining production software in C# and modern .NET.
Breadth and adaptability – you are happy to work across the stack and into the cloud, and you are not thrown by a technology you have not used before.
Real depth with AI in practice – you use AI tools in your daily work, you are hands-on with agents and LLM-driven workflows, and you can point to things you have actually built with them. We care more about what you have done and how you think about it than about years on a CV.
A proactive, positive, and constructive mindset – you take ownership from start to finish, communicate openly, and make the people around you better.
The ability to build maintainable, high-quality solutions and to work independently as well as in a team.

Nice to have

Experience with hardware–software integration, robotics, or embedded systems.
Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging, or distributed systems.
Experience working in Agile teams on regulated or safety-critical products.

What We Offer

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that improve healthcare quality and efficiency, with the ambition to be the most desired MedTech company in the world. You would join our Digital Health Solutions department, which counts around 165 people across Denmark, Germany, and the UK, plus a further 100 colleagues in Getinge offices globally.

A smart working environment with shared desks, several work-from-home days per week, and a budget for your home office setup.
Flexible working hours.
Competitive benefits including health insurance and pension.
Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
A collaborative, inclusive, and motivating culture.

Application

Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 17-10-2026

We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

About Us 

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

Duties/Responsibilities

Support troubleshooting and root cause investigations related to manufacturing equipment, automation systems, test stations, and production software.

new_jobs.title: AVP/VP, Product Engineer (Developer Acceleration), Technology Group
new_jobs.description:
About GIC

GIC is one of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world's industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we work at the Point of Impact for Singapore's financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

Technology Group

We experiment, design, and lead a 24×7 global business where we support core capabilities in asset management, trading, investment operations, and risk management. We deliver secure, reliable, and integrated solutions, and provide insights on new and emerging technologies.

Strategy, Architecture, and Transformation Group

The Strategy, Architecture & Transformation (SAT) group shapes and drives GIC’s technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business priorities and enterprise goals. Bringing together expertise in strategy, architecture, engineering, and transformation, the team strengthens governance, promotes consistency, and accelerates delivery across the Technology Group. Through modern practices and close collaboration, SAT leads the development of an architectural strategy that reinforces oversight and accountability while enabling reliable, scalable solutions and informed decision making across the Technology Group and, more broadly, across GIC.

Developer Experience

The Developer Experience team builds and operates the products and platforms that support the developer experience across GIC's Technology Group. The team is organised around three product pillars:

Project Management Tooling — Platforms such as Jira and Confluence that support project tracking, collaboration, and workflow management across the Technology Group.
Cloud Development Environments & IDEs — Cloud-based development environments, AI-assisted coding tools, developer toolchains (CLIs, SDKs, IDE extensions, devcontainer features), and agentic development capabilities.
DevSecOps & CI/CD — CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, security scanning integration, infrastructure-as-code, and secure software delivery tooling.

What impact can you make in this role?

As a Product Engineer responsible for Developer Acceleration, you will build and operate the infrastructure that enables hundreds of employees to be productive through our agentic cloud development platform. By joining this team, you will have a direct impact on the velocity and quality of software engineering at GIC. You will evolve our agentic cloud development platform, shape the next generation of the agentic SDLC, and transform how software is built and delivered across GIC.

You are a platform engineer who is also an AI-native developer: you use coding agents as core engineering tools across specification, design, implementation, testing, and review, while applying sound engineering judgement and remaining accountable for the quality, security, and operability of the software you ship.

What will you do as a Product Engineer (Developer Acceleration)?

You will work across three connected areas: platform and infrastructure engineering, developer tooling and governance, and AI-native development and agent enablement.
Operate and evolve the agentic cloud development platform, covering infrastructure, networking, deployment automation, devcontainer lifecycle, observability, security, and governance.
Address developer needs, resolve platform issues, and build processes and integrations that connect the platform with enterprise development services and systems.
Govern the developer tools estate — evaluate, onboard, secure, and manage the lifecycle of IDEs, extensions, SDKs, CLIs, and AI coding tools through clear guardrails and paved paths.
Drive AI-native development across GIC — establish reusable practices, context engineering, MCP integrations, and reference workflows, and provide clear guidance and enablement to accelerate adoption across teams.
Build and integrate the agentic SDLC platform — develop agent execution and human review workflows that connect project management tools, source control, and CI/CD to enable end-to-end delivery.
Collaborate with infra and security teams to ensure platform capabilities meet requirements for observability, resilience, and compliance.

What makes you a successful candidate?

Experience
6+ years of experience in software, platform, or infrastructure engineering, including hands-on ownership of developer platforms or large-scale distributed systems in production.
2+ years of experience leading complex, cross-team engineering initiatives as an engineer or technical lead.
Strong programming proficiency in one or more of Python, Java, C#/.NET, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
Strong AWS expertise, including EC2, VPC networking, IAM, EKS or ECS, CloudWatch, and S3.
Strong experience with infrastructure as code and automation using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, and GitOps practices.
Deep familiarity with containerised development, including devcontainers, image build pipelines, and dependency management.
Security-first engineering experience covering network segmentation, least-privilege access, and operation in regulated technology environments.
Demonstrated AI-native development practice — hands-on use of coding agents across the software development lifecycle, with the ability to recognise their limitations and validate AI-generated code before release.
Clear technical communication — able to write guidance, run enablement sessions, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Product & Delivery Mindset
Demonstrated ability to think about engineering work through a product lens — understanding users, measuring outcomes, and iterating based on feedback.
Comfortable owning a product backlog and making prioritisation decisions.
Experience working in agile teams with a focus on incremental delivery.

Governance & Ways of Working
Ability to balance developer experience and autonomy with enterprise requirements for security, standardisation, and cost control.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across engineering, platform, and cybersecurity teams.
Comfortable navigating competing priorities and driving alignment.

Personal Attributes
Clear and effective communicator, both written and verbal.
Pragmatic, structured, and outcome-focused.
Consistently demonstrates GIC's PRIME values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit, and Excellence.

Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

Flexibility at GIC

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

GIC is an equal opportunity employer

GIC is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Learn more about our Technology Group here:

https://gic.careers/group/technology-group/
Our PRIME Values

GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all .

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As an AI Reimagination Engineer in Micron's Generative AI Center of Excellence (GenAI COE), you have an outstanding chance to transform how businesses function. You will partner with different business areas to break down large, manual, multi-step processes and redesign them into effective, autonomous systems. This position combines process reimagination with AI systems engineering, making you a key part of the transformation journey. You will collaborate closely with the GenAI COE, IT architecture, security, and project teams. You will lead projects from the initial redesign to the final build, delivering solutions that business teams can adopt and scale.

Responsibilities

Decompose end-to-end processes: Map current-state flows, quantify effort and risk, and lead eliminate/simplify/agentify analysis before automation.
Architect the agentic solution: Build future-state flows and AI architecture, including task and agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool and data access, memory and context strategy, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Translate inventions into buildable solutions by developing agent workflows, composing prompt and context strategies, MCP/connector and integration requirements, and evaluation criteria. Follow Micron's “Secure by Design” and data-classification standards.
Prototype and build: Construct working agentic solutions, or direct their build with platform engineers, validating fit and value prior to full delivery.
Engineer trust and control: Define testable human-in-the-loop controls and least-privilege permissions for each process step.
Drive multi-functional delivery: Collaborate across the client function, IT architecture, security, platform engineers, and the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) through first production release.
Measure value and codify patterns: Capture value baselines during discovery, support 30/90-day post-release measurement, and turn findings into reference flows, decomposition patterns, and playbooks. Mentor engineers and grow the network of agentic champions.

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, AI/ML, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience blending technical delivery with business process work.
Hybrid Experience: Proven track record in both decomposing complex business processes and crafting or building technical solutions.
Agentic Delivery: 8+ years of overall experience and 3+ years in AI/ML. Recently, hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-based systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Process Redesign: Experience leading workshop-based process redesign and translating findings into requirements. Familiar with AI governance, responsible-AI, security fundamentals, and validation/testing strategies for autonomous behavior.
Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with enterprise AI and automation platforms, and proficiency across Python, .NET/C#, SQL, and APIs. Depth in agent orchestration and multi-agent development, context management, and long-horizon tasks.
Communication: Excellent facilitation, written, and executive interpersonal skills. Proficient in running discovery with business leaders and driving alignment across business, engineering, and risk teams.

We are looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our Application Support team. This role is suitable for entry-level candidates and junior professionals who are passionate about technology and eager to build their careers in software engineering.

Strong knowledge of Java (mandatory).

Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Suvoda is a global clinical trial technology company shaping digital experiences that enable clinical trial sponsor and site professionals to take full command over the inherent logistical complexity behind mission-critical and time-sensitive patient interactions in life-sustaining studies for therapeutic areas such as oncology, central nervous system, and rare disease.

Supporting clinical trials means supporting unique experiments that are inherently complex, high-stakes, and dynamic. It is imperative that Suvoda staff working with clients, end-users, or the systems that client and end-users interact with understand the clinical trial industry, regulations, Suvoda’s software products and processes, and especially the specificities of the unique trial in question before taking any actions they may alter the data of the system in question.

Work within a cross-functional project team to develop Interactive Response Technology (IRT) for randomization and drug supply management
Review user requirements specifications, verifying that all requirements can be implemented with the Suvoda software in the required timeframe
Assist with the creation of implementation design and technical design documentation
Develop software systems that are reliable, maintainable, and efficient, with emphasis on patient safety and integrity of clinical study data
Manage the deployment of Suvoda IRT systems into all environments, completing all required documentation
Assist the support team with troubleshooting and resolution of issues reported on production systems
Participate in the product research and development process by providing the engineering team with new solutions and ideas based on project experience
Generate ideas for innovative technological solutions to increase the quality of Suvoda system
Perform other related duties as required

Bachelor’s degree preferred
At least 2 years of experience in a similar role
Prior working experience in developing web applications with C#, .NET (Framework or Core), SQL Server, Model View Controller (MVC) and Entity Framework (EF)
High achieving personality
Desire to learn and grow
Strong work ethic
Sense of ownership

A Snapshot of Your Day

In this role, you stay updated on the latest trends in software development, implementing best practices to enhance team performance. You conduct code reviews and merge request evaluations, sharing knowledge with fellow team members to foster a collaborative environment. Experiență cu backend (ideal .NET Core, dar nu obligatoriu);

Capacitatea de a lucra pe probleme care nu sunt complet definite;

Salariu competitiv (în funcție de nivel);

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

new_jobs.title: Agentic Software Delivery Architect
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Inetum is a European leader supporting organizations as they navigate continuous technological change.

With deep industry expertise, a strong innovation culture, and a scalable international model, we help clients transform their operations and generate sustainable impact across business and society.

Guided by European values, we empower local businesses to create positive impact and unlock society’s full potential. This vision drives us to deliver on our promises, attract the best talent, and turn uncertainty into opportunity, building a future where technology unleashes the possibilities within us all.

Job Description

Software engineering is being fundamentally redefined.

Artificial Intelligence is no longer a supporting tool that helps developers write code faster. It is becoming an active participant in how software is designed, built, tested, secured, modernized, deployed and operated.

Organizations that succeed in the coming years will not simply adopt AI tools. They will transform how software delivery works by combining human expertise, intelligent agents, automation and modern engineering practices into a new operating model.

At Inetum Belgium, we are building that future through our Agentic Software Delivery Factory
.

We envision an environment where architects, engineers, AI agents and delivery teams collaborate to accelerate innovation, improve quality, increase predictability and create greater business value. Beyond transforming software delivery, we help organizations design and build the next generation of Agentic and AI-infused applications, combining intelligent agents, enterprise data and modern cloud platforms to deliver adaptive and business-aware solutions.

To help shape this transformation, the Cloud & Application Unit
within our Technology Division is looking for an Agentic Software Delivery Architect
.

This is not a traditional architecture role.

This is a leadership role focused on defining, implementing and scaling AI-enabled software delivery, while architecting the next generation of Agentic and AI-infused applications that combine human expertise, intelligent agents, enterprise data and modern cloud services.

You will help customers and teams navigate one of the biggest technology shifts of our generation and define what software engineering looks like in the age of Agentic AI.

Your Mission

As an Agentic Software Delivery Architect
, your primary mission is to accelerate the adoption of AI-native software engineering and help organizations evolve towards next-generation delivery models.

You will help organizations evolve their software and solution delivery capabilities across the spectrum of AI-assisted, AI-augmented and AI-native engineering
, enabling teams to leverage AI as a true force multiplier throughout the software development lifecycle.

You will act as a bridge between business strategy, engineering excellence, AI innovation and delivery transformation.

You will help define how AI agents, engineering platforms, automation capabilities and human expertise work together throughout the Software Development Lifecycle.

While architecture remains an important part of the role, your impact will be measured by your ability to transform software delivery, drive adoption and create tangible business outcomes through AI-enabled engineering.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You lead by example, working alongside delivery teams, architects and engineers to validate emerging practices, experiment with new AI capabilities and turn innovation into scalable delivery outcomes. You operate at the frontline of AI innovation, continuously exploring how Agentic AI can reshape the way software is designed, built, tested and operated.

You will not simply design solutions.

You will design the future of software delivery itself.

What You Will Do

AI & Agentic Software Delivery Leadership

Drive the evolution of our Agentic Software Delivery Factory.
Define and promote AI-native software delivery practices.
Identify opportunities where AI agents can augment engineering teams and delivery processes.
Establish reusable frameworks, methodologies and patterns for AI-enabled delivery.
Help delivery teams operationalize AI throughout the Software Development Lifecycle.
Drive measurable improvements in productivity, quality, predictability and customer outcomes.
Promote responsible, secure and governed use of AI.

Software Delivery Transformation

Help customers redefine their software delivery operating models.
Guide organizations through AI adoption and engineering transformation journeys.
Identify opportunities to optimize delivery processes using automation and intelligent agents.
Support the implementation of modern engineering practices and platform-based delivery models.
Help organizations move from traditional software development approaches towards AI-assisted and AI-native engineering.

Architecture & Modernization

Design modern solution architectures that enable AI-enabled delivery and business innovation.
Guide application modernization initiatives leveraging cloud, automation and AI.
Support architecture decisions across cloud-native, distributed and enterprise platforms.
Define scalable, secure and maintainable technology landscapes.
Ensure architectural decisions support long-term business objectives and delivery efficiency.

AI Strategy & Innovation

Track emerging developments in AI, Agentic Systems and software engineering.
Translate innovation into practical customer solutions.
Experiment with new approaches that improve engineering effectiveness.
Contribute to the creation of new services, offerings and differentiators around AI-enabled delivery.
Support strategic initiatives that position Inetum as a leader in AI-driven software engineering.

Customer Advisory & Pre-Sales

Act as a trusted advisor to customers and stakeholders.
Facilitate workshops on AI adoption, delivery transformation and modernization.
Help customers understand the impact of Agentic AI on software delivery organizations.
Shape solution approaches and transformation roadmaps.
Support pre-sales activities and contribute to winning new business opportunities.
Translate technical capabilities into measurable business value.

Community & Thought Leadership

Lead knowledge-sharing initiatives across engineering communities.
Mentor architects, engineers and technical leaders.
Create reusable assets, accelerators and best practices.
Promote a culture of experimentation, learning and innovation.
Represent Inetum in customer engagements, industry events and technical communities.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for technology leaders who understand that software engineering is entering a new era.

You do not need to have all the answers.

But you should be excited by the opportunity to help shape them.

Essential Experience

Proven experience as a Software Architect, Technical Leader, Engineering Lead, Transformation Consultant or Senior Technology Advisor.
Strong understanding of modern software engineering and software delivery practices.
Experience with cloud-native platforms, DevOps, CI/CD and automation.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical transformation initiatives.
Strong stakeholder management and customer-facing skills.
Ability to connect technology decisions with business outcomes.
Experience driving change across teams, departments or organizations.
Strong communication, workshop facilitation and advisory capabilities.
Passion for innovation and continuous learning.

AI-Focused Capabilities

Strong interest in AI-enabled software engineering and Agentic AI.
Understanding of how AI can transform software delivery and engineering organizations.
Experience with GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted development tools or software engineering automation platforms.
Ability to identify practical opportunities for AI adoption.
Understanding of responsible AI, governance, security and risk considerations.
Ability to guide organizations through the people, process and technology aspects of AI transformation.
Curiosity regarding emerging AI capabilities and future engineering practices.

Experience In One Or More Of The Following Areas

Microsoft Azure and .NET ecosystems.
Java and cloud-native platforms.
Integration and API platforms.
Event-driven architecture and distributed systems.
Platform engineering.
Application modernization.
Software Quality Engineering.
DevOps and DevSecOps practices.
Cloud transformation programs.

What Makes You Successful

You see beyond today's software delivery practices.

You understand that the future is not about replacing people with AI.

It is about creating high-performing engineering systems where people and intelligent agents collaborate effectively.

You

Think strategically while remaining hands-on.
Are comfortable leading change and challenging established ways of working.
Inspire teams to embrace innovation.
Balance experimentation with governance and business value.
Translate emerging technologies into practical outcomes.
Build trust with customers and stakeholders.
Focus on measurable impact rather than technology for technology's sake.
Continuously explore new possibilities and share what you learn.

Most importantly, you are passionate about shaping the future of software engineering.

Additional Information

Why Join Us?

You will help shape some of the most important transformations for our customers.

The transition from traditional organizations toward modern enterprises where people, data and AI work together to create value.

You Will Work At The Intersection Of

Business Transformation
Product Innovation
Digital Strategy
Artificial Intelligence
Modern Operating Models
Human-AI Collaboration
Customer Experience
Software Delivery and Technology

Most importantly, you will help organizations create meaningful business outcomes by combining the best of human expertise, proven delivery practices, and emerging technologies.

Technology is not the destination. Value is.

And your role will be to help customers get there.
